verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।

मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय
verses.transliteration:
dhṛitarāśhtra uvācha
dharma-kṣhetre kuru-kṣhetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāśhchaiva kimakurvata sañjaya
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dhritarashtara ne kaha -- he sanjaya ! dharmabhumi kurukshetra men ekatra hue yuddha ke ichhuka mere aura pandu ke putron ne kya kiya?
verses.english_meaning: Dhritarashtra said, "What did my people and the sons of Pandu do when they had assembled together, eager for battle, on the holy plain of Kurukshetra, O Sanjaya?"

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा।

आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
dṛiṣhṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanastadā
āchāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vachanamabravīt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- pandava-sainya ki vyuha rachana dekhakara raja duryodhana ne acharya drona ke pasa jakara ye vachana kahe
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said: Having seen the army of the Pandavas drawn up in battle array, King Duryodhana approached his teacher, Drona, and spoke these words

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्।

व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता
verses.transliteration:
paśhyaitāṁ pāṇḍu-putrāṇām āchārya mahatīṁ chamūm
vyūḍhāṁ drupada-putreṇa tava śhiṣhyeṇa dhīmatā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He acharya ! apake buddhimana shishya drupadaputra dvara vyuhakara khadai ki gayi pandu putron ki isa mahati sena ko dekhiye
verses.english_meaning: Behold, O Teacher! This mighty army of the sons of Pandu, arrayed by the son of Drupada, thy wise disciple

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि।

युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः
verses.transliteration:
atra śhūrā maheṣhvāsā bhīmārjuna-samā yudhi
yuyudhāno virāṭaśhcha drupadaśhcha mahā-rathaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa sena men mahan dhanurdhari shura yoddha hai , jo yuddha men bhima aura arjuna ke samana hain , jaise -- yuyudhana, virata tatha maharathi raja drupada
verses.english_meaning: Here are heroes, mighty archers, equal in battle to Bhima and Arjuna, Yuyudhana , Virata, and Drupada—all mighty warriors

verses.sanskrit:
धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्।

पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration:
dhṛiṣhṭaketuśhchekitānaḥ kāśhirājaśhcha vīryavān
purujit kuntibhojaśhcha śhaibyaśhcha nara-puṅgavaḥ
yudhāmanyuśhcha vikrānta uttamaujāśhcha vīryavān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dhrishtaketu, chekitana, balavana kashiraja, purujit, kuntibhoja aura manushyon men shreshtha shaibya
verses.english_meaning: Dhrishtaketu, Chekitana, the valiant king of Kasi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Saibya—the best of men

verses.sanskrit:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्।

सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः
verses.transliteration: saubhadro draupadeyāśhcha sarva eva mahā-rathāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parakrami yudhamanyu, balavan uttamauja, subhadraputra aura dropadi ke putra -- ye saba maharathi hain
verses.english_meaning: The strong Yudhamanyu and the brave Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadra , and the sons of Draupadi, all of them great charioteers ."

verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम।

नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration:
asmākaṁ tu viśhiṣhṭā ye tānnibodha dwijottama
nāyakā mama sainyasya sanjñārthaṁ tānbravīmi te
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dvijottama ! hamare paksha men bhi jo vishishta yoddhagana hain , unako apa jana lijiye; apaki janakari ke liye apani sena ke nayakon ke nama main apako batata hun
verses.english_meaning: Know also, O best among the twice-born! the names of those who are the most distinguished amongst ourselves, the leaders of my army; these I name to you for your information

verses.sanskrit:
भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः।

अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration:
bhavānbhīṣhmaśhcha karṇaśhcha kṛipaśhcha samitiñjayaḥ
aśhvatthāmā vikarṇaśhcha saumadattis tathaiva cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Eka to svayan apa, bhishma, karna, aura yuddha vijayi kripacharya tatha ashvatthama, vikarna aura somadatta ka putra hai
verses.english_meaning: "Thou thyself, Bhishma, Karna, Kripa, the victorious in war, Asvatthama, Vikarna, and Bhurisrava, the son of Somadatta—all these are ready for battle."

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः।

नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः
verses.transliteration:
anye cha bahavaḥ śhūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
nānā-śhastra-praharaṇāḥ sarve yuddha-viśhāradāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mere lie prana tyaga karane ke lie taiyara, aneka prakara ke shastarastaron se susajjita tatha yuddha men kushala aura bhi aneka shura vira hain
verses.english_meaning: And also many other heroes, ready to give up their lives for my sake, armed with various weapons and missiles, all well-skilled in battle

verses.sanskrit:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्।

पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्
verses.transliteration:
aparyāptaṁ tadasmākaṁ balaṁ bhīṣhmābhirakṣhitam
paryāptaṁ tvidameteṣhāṁ balaṁ bhīmābhirakṣhitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhishma ke dvara hamari rakshita sena aparyapta hai; kintu bhima dvara rakshita unaki sena paryapta hai athava, bhishma ke dvara rakshita hamari sena aparimita hai kintu bhima ke dvara rakshita unaki sena parimita hi hai
verses.english_meaning: Our army, marshalled by Bhishma, is insufficient, whereas theirs, marshalled by Bhima, is sufficient

verses.sanskrit:
अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः।

भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि
verses.transliteration:
ayaneṣhu cha sarveṣhu yathā-bhāgamavasthitāḥ
bhīṣhmamevābhirakṣhantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vibhinna morchon para apane-apane sthana para sthita rahate hue apa saba loga bhishma pitamaha ki hi saba ora se raksha karen
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, do all of you, stationed in your respective positions in the several divisions of the army, protect Bhishma alone

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः।

सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration:
tasya sañjanayan harṣhaṁ kuru-vṛiddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ
siṁha-nādaṁ vinadyochchaiḥ śhaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa samaya kauravon men vriddha, pratapi pitamaha bhishma ne usa ke hridaya men harsha utpanna karate huye uchcha svara men garaja kara shankhadhvani ki
verses.english_meaning: His glorious grandsire, the oldest of the Kauravas, roared like a lion to cheer Duryodhana and blew his conch

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः।

सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śhaṅkhāśhcha bheryaśhcha paṇavānaka-gomukhāḥ
sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śhabdastumulo ’bhavat
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tatpashchat shankha, nagare, dhola va shringi adi vadya eka satha hi baja uthe, jinaka badaa bhayankara shabda hua
verses.english_meaning: Then, suddenly, conches, kettledrums, tabors, drums, and cow horns blared forth from the Kaurava side, and the sound was tremendous

verses.sanskrit:
ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ।

माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śhvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau
mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaśhchaiva divyau śhaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isake uparanta shveta ashvon se yukta bhavya ratha men baithe huye madhava aura panduputra arjuna ne bhi apane divya shankha bajaye
verses.english_meaning: Then, Madhava and the son of Pandu , seated in the magnificent chariot yoked with white horses, blew divine conches

verses.sanskrit:
पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः।

पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः
verses.transliteration:
pāñchajanyaṁ hṛiṣhīkeśho devadattaṁ dhanañjayaḥ
pauṇḍraṁ dadhmau mahā-śhaṅkhaṁ bhīma-karmā vṛikodaraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhagavan hrishikesha ne panchajanya, dhananjaya ne devadatta tatha bhayankara karma karane vale bhima ne paundu namaka mahashankha bajaya
verses.english_meaning: Hrishikesha blew the Panchajanya, Arjuna blew the Devadatta, and Bhima, the wolf-bellied doer of terrible deeds, blew the great conch Paundra

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।

नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ
verses.transliteration:
anantavijayaṁ rājā kuntī-putro yudhiṣhṭhiraḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaśhcha sughoṣha-maṇipuṣhpakau
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kuntiputra raja yudhishthira ne ananta vijaya namaka shankha aura nakula va sahadeva ne kramasha: sughosha aura manipushpaka namaka shankha bajaye
verses.english_meaning: King Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, blew the Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva blew the Sughosha and the Manipushpaka

verses.sanskrit:
काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः।

धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः
verses.transliteration:
kāśhyaśhcha parameṣhvāsaḥ śhikhaṇḍī cha mahā-rathaḥ
dhṛiṣhṭadyumno virāṭaśhcha sātyakiśh chāparājitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shreshtha dhanushavale kashiraja, maharathi shikhandi, dhrishtadyumna, raja virata aura ajeya satyaki
verses.english_meaning: The king of Kasi, an excellent archer, Sikhandi, the mighty car-warrior, Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, and Satyaki, the unconquered

verses.sanskrit:
द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते।

सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration:
drupado draupadeyāśhcha sarvaśhaḥ pṛithivī-pate
saubhadraśhcha mahā-bāhuḥ śhaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛithak pṛithak
verses.hinglish_meaning: He rajan ! raja drupada, draupadi ke putra aura mahabahu saubhadra ina saba ne alaga-alaga shankha bajaye
verses.english_meaning: Drupada and the sons of Draupadi, O Lord of the Earth, and the son of Subhadra, the mighty-armed, blew their conches each separately

verses.sanskrit:
स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत्।

नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन्
verses.transliteration:
sa ghoṣho dhārtarāṣhṭrāṇāṁ hṛidayāni vyadārayat
nabhaśhcha pṛithivīṁ chaiva tumulo nunādayan
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha bhayankara ghosha akasha aura prithvi para gunjane laga aura usane dhritarashtara ke putron ke hridaya vidirna kara diye
verses.english_meaning: The tumultuous sound rent the hearts of Dhritarashtra's party, reverberating through both heaven and earth

verses.sanskrit:
अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः।

प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः
verses.transliteration:
atha vyavasthitān dṛiṣhṭvā dhārtarāṣhṭrān kapi-dhwajaḥ
pravṛitte śhastra-sampāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ
hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ tadā vākyam idam āha mahī-pate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahipate ! isa prakara jaba yuddha prarambha hone vala hi tha ki kapidhvaja arjuna ne dhritarashtara ke putron ko sthita dekhakara dhanusha uthakara bhagavan hrishikesha se ye shabda kahe
verses.english_meaning: Then, seeing the people of Dhritarashtra's party standing arrayed and the discharge of weapons about to begin, Arjuna, the son of Pandu whose ensign was a monkey, took up his bow and said the following to Krishna, O Lord of the Earth

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
senayor ubhayor madhye rathaṁ sthāpaya me ’chyuta
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he! achyuta mere ratha ko donon senaon ke madhya khadaa kijiye
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, place my chariot in the middle between the two armies, so that I may behold those who stand here, desirous to fight, and know with whom I must fight when the battle is about to commence."

verses.sanskrit:
यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान्।

कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे
verses.transliteration:
yāvadetān nirīkṣhe ’haṁ yoddhu-kāmān avasthitān
kairmayā saha yoddhavyam asmin raṇa-samudyame
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisase main yuddha ki ichha se khadae ina logon ka nirikshana kara sakun ki isa yuddha men mujhe kinake satha yuddha karana hai
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, place my chariot in the middle between the two armies, so that I may behold those who stand here, desirous to fight, and know with whom I must fight when the battle is about to commence."

verses.sanskrit:
योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः।

धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः
verses.transliteration:
yotsyamānān avekṣhe ’haṁ ya ete ’tra samāgatāḥ
dhārtarāṣhṭrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya-chikīrṣhavaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Durbuddhi dhartarashtara ka yuddha men priya chahane vale jo ye raja loga yahan ekatra hue hain, una yuddha karane valon ko main dekhunga
verses.english_meaning: For I desire to observe those who are assembled here to fight, wishing to please in battle the evil-minded Duryodhana—the son of Dhritarashtra

verses.sanskrit:
संजय उवाच

एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
evam ukto hṛiṣhīkeśho guḍākeśhena bhārata
senayor ubhayor madhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- he bharata ! arjuna ke isa prakara kahane para bhagavan hrishikesha ne donon senaon ke madhya uttama ratha ko khadaa karake
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said, Thus addressed by Arjuna, Krishna stationed the best of chariots, O Dhritarashtra, in the midst of the two armies

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्।

उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति
verses.transliteration:
bhīṣhma-droṇa-pramukhataḥ sarveṣhāṁ cha mahī-kṣhitām
uvācha pārtha paśhyaitān samavetān kurūn iti
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhishma, drona tatha prithvi ke samasta shasakon ke samaksha unhonne kaha, "he partha yahan ekatra huye kauravon ko dekho"
verses.english_meaning: In front of Bhishma and Drona, and all the rulers of the earth, he said: "O Arjuna, son of Pritha, behold these Kurus gathered together."

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितृ़नथ पितामहान्।

आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातृ़न्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
tatrāpaśhyat sthitān pārthaḥ pitṝīn atha pitāmahān
āchāryān mātulān bhrātṝīn putrān pautrān sakhīṁs tathā
śhvaśhurān suhṛidaśh chaiva senayor ubhayor api
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vahan arjuna ne una donon senaon men khadae pita ke bhaiyon, pitamahon, acharyon, mamon, bhaiyon, putron, pautron, mitron, shvasuron aura suhridon ko bhi dekha
verses.english_meaning: Then, Arjuna saw there stationed fathers, grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, and friends

verses.sanskrit:
श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि।

तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्
verses.transliteration:
tān samīkṣhya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūn avasthitān
kṛipayā parayāviṣhṭo viṣhīdann idam abravīt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara una saba bandhu-bandhavon ko khadae dekhakara kunti putra arjuna ka mana karuna se bhara gaya aura vishadayukta hokara usane yaha kaha
verses.english_meaning: He saw fathers-in-law and friends in both the armies. The son of Kunti, Arjuna, seeing all those kinsmen thus standing arrayed, spoke sorrowfully, deeply filled with pity

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्।

दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
dṛiṣhṭvemaṁ sva-janaṁ kṛiṣhṇa yuyutsuṁ samupasthitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: 1.28 1.29.arjuna ne kaha -- he krishna ! yuddha ki ichha rakhakara upasthita hue ina svajanon ko dekhakara mere anga shithila huye jate hain, mukha bhi sukha raha hai aura mere sharira men kampa tatha romancha ho raha hai
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, seeing my kinsmen arrayed here, eager to fight,

verses.sanskrit:
सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।

वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते
verses.transliteration:
sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ cha pariśhuṣhyati
vepathuśh cha śharīre me roma-harṣhaśh cha jāyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: 1.28 1.29.arjuna ne kaha -- he krishna ! yuddha ki ichha rakhakara upasthita hue ina svajanon ko dekhakara mere anga shithila huye jate hain, mukha bhi sukha raha hai aura mere sharira men kampa tatha romancha ho raha hai
verses.english_meaning: My limbs fail, my mouth is parched, my body quivers, and my hair stands on end

verses.sanskrit:
गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते।

न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः
verses.transliteration:
gāṇḍīvaṁ sraṁsate hastāt tvak chaiva paridahyate
na cha śhaknomy avasthātuṁ bhramatīva cha me manaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mere hatha se gandiva gira raha hai aura tvacha jala rahi hai. mera mana bhramita sa ho raha hai, aura main khadae rahane men asamartha hun
verses.english_meaning: The Gandiva slips from my hand, and my skin burns all over; I am unable to stand, and my mind is reeling, as it were

verses.sanskrit:
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव।

न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
nimittāni cha paśhyāmi viparītāni keśhava
na cha śhreyo ’nupaśhyāmi hatvā sva-janam āhave
verses.hinglish_meaning: He keshava ! main shakunon ko bhi viparita hi dekha raha hun aura yuddha men apane svajanon ko marakara koi kalyana bhi nahin dekhata hun
verses.english_meaning: And I see ill omens, O Kesava. I do not see any good in slaying my kinsmen in battle

verses.sanskrit:
न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च।

किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा
verses.transliteration:
na kāṅkṣhe vijayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa na cha rājyaṁ sukhāni cha
kiṁ no rājyena govinda kiṁ bhogair jīvitena vā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He krishna ! main na vijaya chahata hun, na rajya aura na sukhon ko hi chahata hun. he govinda ! hamen rajya se athava bhogon se aura jine se bhi kya prayojana hai?
verses.english_meaning: I desire not victory, O Krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures. What use is dominion to us, O Krishna, or pleasures or even life?

verses.sanskrit:
येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।

त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च
verses.transliteration:
yeṣhām arthe kāṅkṣhitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni cha
ta ime ’vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁs tyaktvā dhanāni cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Hamen jinake liye rajya, bhoga aura sukhadi ki ichha hai, ve hi loga dhana aura jivana ki asha ko tyagakara yuddha men khadae hain
verses.english_meaning: Those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments, and pleasures stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth

verses.sanskrit:
आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः।

मातुलाः श्चशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
āchāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva cha pitāmahāḥ
mātulāḥ śhvaśhurāḥ pautrāḥ śhyālāḥ sambandhinas tathā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ve loga gurujana, tau, chacha, putra, pitamaha, shvasura, pote, shyalaka tatha anya sambandhi hain
verses.english_meaning: Teachers, fathers, sons, and grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives—

verses.sanskrit:
एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन।

अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते
verses.transliteration:
etān na hantum ichchhāmi ghnato ’pi madhusūdana
api trailokya-rājyasya hetoḥ kiṁ nu mahī-kṛite
verses.hinglish_meaning: He madhusudana ! inake mujhe marane para athava trailokya ke rajya ke liye bhi main inako marana nahin chahata, phira prithvi ke lie kahana hi kya hai
verses.english_meaning: These I do not wish to kill, O Krishna, even though they kill me, for the sake of dominion over the three worlds; leave alone killing them for the sake of the earth."

verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन।

पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः
verses.transliteration:
nihatya dhārtarāṣhṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana
pāpam evāśhrayed asmān hatvaitān ātatāyinaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He janardana ! dhritarashtara ke putron ki hatya karake hamen kya prasannata hogi? ina atatayiyon ko marakara to hamen kevala papa hi lagega
verses.english_meaning: By killing these sons of Dhritarashtra, what pleasure could be ours, O Janardana? Only sin would accrue to us from killing these felons

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्।

स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव
verses.transliteration:
tasmān nārhā vayaṁ hantuṁ dhārtarāṣhṭrān sa-bāndhavān
sva-janaṁ hi kathaṁ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava
verses.hinglish_meaning: He madhava ! isaliye apane bandhava dhritarashtara ke putron ko marana hamare lie yogya nahin hai, kyonki svajanon ko marakara hama kaise sukhi honge
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, we should not kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, our relatives; for how can we be happy by killing our own kin, O Madhava ?

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः।

कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्
verses.transliteration:
yady apy ete na paśhyanti lobhopahata-chetasaḥ
kula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ mitra-drohe cha pātakam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadyapi lobha se bhrashtachitta huye ye loga kulanashakrita dosha aura mitra droha men papa nahin dekhate hain
verses.english_meaning: Though they, with intelligence overpowered by greed, see no evil in the destruction of families and no sin in hostility to friends,

verses.sanskrit:
कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्।

कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum
kula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ prapaśhyadbhir janārdana
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu, hee janardana ! kulakshaya se hone vale dosha ko janane vale hama logon ko isa papa se virata hone ke lie kyon nahin sochana chahiye
verses.english_meaning: Why should we not, who clearly see the evil in the destruction of families, learn to turn away from this sin, O Janardana ?

verses.sanskrit:
कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः।

धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत
verses.transliteration:
kula-kṣhaye praṇaśhyanti kula-dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
dharme naṣhṭe kulaṁ kṛitsnam adharmo ’bhibhavaty uta
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kula ke nashta hone se sanatana dharma nashta ho jate hain. dharma nashta hone para sampurna kula ko adharma daba leta hai
verses.english_meaning: In the destruction of a family, the immemorial religious rites of that family perish; on the destruction of spirituality, impiety indeed, overwhelms the whole family

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः।

स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः
verses.transliteration:
adharmābhibhavāt kṛiṣhṇa praduṣhyanti kula-striyaḥ
strīṣhu duṣhṭāsu vārṣhṇeya jāyate varṇa-saṅkaraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He krishna ! papa ke adhika badha jane se kula ki stariyan dushita ho jati hain, aura he varshaneya ! stariyon ke dushita hone para varnasankara utpanna hota hai
verses.english_meaning: O Krishna, by the prevalence of impiety, the women of the family become corrupt; and, when women are corrupted, O Varshenya , intermingling of castes arises

verses.sanskrit:
सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च।

पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः
verses.transliteration:
saṅkaro narakāyaiva kula-ghnānāṁ kulasya cha
patanti pitaro hy eṣhāṁ lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha varnasankara kulaghatiyon ko aura kula ko naraka men le jane ka karana banata hai. pinda aura jaladana ki kriya se vanchita inake pitara bhi naraka men gira jate hain
verses.english_meaning: Confusion of castes leads to hell for the slayers of the family, for their forebears fall, deprived of the offerings of rice-balls and libations of water

verses.sanskrit:
दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः।

उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः
verses.transliteration:
doṣhair etaiḥ kula-ghnānāṁ varṇa-saṅkara-kārakaiḥ
utsādyante jāti-dharmāḥ kula-dharmāśh cha śhāśhvatāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ina varnasankara karaka doshon se kulaghati doshon se sanatana kuladharma aura jatidharma nashta ho jate hain
verses.english_meaning: By these evil deeds of the destroyers of the family, which cause confusion of castes, the eternal religious rites of the caste and the family are destroyed

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन।

नरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम
verses.transliteration:
utsanna-kula-dharmāṇāṁ manuṣhyāṇāṁ janārdana
narake ‘niyataṁ vāso bhavatītyanuśhuśhruma
verses.hinglish_meaning: He janardana ! hamane suna hai ki jinake yahan kula dharma nashta ho jata hai, una manushyon ka aniyata kala taka naraka men vasa hota hai
verses.english_meaning: We have heard, O Janardana, that those men in whose families the religious practices have been destroyed are inevitably destined to dwell in hell for an unknown period

verses.sanskrit:
अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।

यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः
verses.transliteration:
aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam
yad rājya-sukha-lobhena hantuṁ sva-janam udyatāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aho ! shoka hai ki hama loga badaa bhari papa karane ka nishchaya kara baithe hain, jo ki isa rajyasukha ke lobha se apane kutumba ka nasha karane ke liye taiyara ho gaye hain
verses.english_meaning: Alas! We are involved in a great sin, for we are prepared to kill our kinsmen, out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom

verses.sanskrit:
यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः।

धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
yadi mām apratīkāram aśhastraṁ śhastra-pāṇayaḥ
dhārtarāṣhṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣhemataraṁ bhavet
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadi mujha shastararahita aura pratikara na karane vale ko ye shastaradhari kaurava rana men maren, to bhi vaha mere liye kalyanakaraka hoga
verses.english_meaning: If the sons of Dhritarashtra, with weapons in hand, should slay me in battle, unresisting and unarmed, that would be better for me

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।

विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
evam uktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśhat
visṛijya sa-śharaṁ chāpaṁ śhoka-saṁvigna-mānasaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- ranabhumi men shoka se udvigna manavala arjuna isa prakara kahakara banasahita dhanusha ko tyaga kara ratha ke pichhale bhaga men baitha gaya
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken in the midst of the battlefield, Arjuna cast away his bow and arrow and, his mind overwhelmed with sorrow, sat down on the seat of the chariot

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

तं तथा कृपयाऽविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम्।

विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
taṁ tathā kṛipayāviṣhṭamaśhru pūrṇākulekṣhaṇam
viṣhīdantamidaṁ vākyam uvācha madhusūdanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- isa prakara karuna aura vishada se abhibhuta, ashrupurita netron vale akula arjuna se madhusudana ne yaha vakya kaha
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said: To him, who was thus overcome with pity, despondent, with eyes full of tears and agitated, Madhusudana or Krishna spoke these words

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम्।

अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
kutastvā kaśhmalamidaṁ viṣhame samupasthitam
anārya-juṣhṭamaswargyam akīrti-karam arjuna
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- he arjuna ! tumako isa vishama sthala men yaha moha kahan se utpanna hua? yaha arya acharana ke viparita na to svarga prapti ka sadhana hi hai aura na kirti karane vala hi hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "From whence has this perilous strait come upon you, this dejection which is unworthy of you, disgraceful, and which will close the gates of heaven upon you, O Arjuna?"

verses.sanskrit:
क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।

क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप
verses.transliteration:
klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate
kṣhudraṁ hṛidaya-daurbalyaṁ tyaktvottiṣhṭha parantapa
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha kliva mata bano. yaha tumhare liye ashobhaniya hai, he ! parantapa hridaya ki kshudra durbalata ko tyagakara khadae ho jao
verses.english_meaning: Do not yield to impotence, O Arjuna, son of Pritha. It does not befit you. Cast off this mean weakness of the heart! Stand up, O conqueror of foes!

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन।

इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
kathaṁ bhīṣhmam ahaṁ sankhye droṇaṁ cha madhusūdana
iṣhubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi pūjārhāvari-sūdana
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he madhusudana ! main ranabhumi men kisa prakara bhishma aura drona ke satha banon se yuddha karunga. he arisudana, ve donon hi pujaniya hain
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Madhusudana, how can I fight in battle with arrows against Bhishma and Drona, who are worthy of being worshipped, O destroyer of enemies?"

verses.sanskrit:
गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्

श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके।

हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव

भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान्
verses.transliteration:
gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān
śhreyo bhoktuṁ bhaikṣhyamapīha loke
hatvārtha-kāmāṁstu gurūnihaiva
bhuñjīya bhogān rudhira-pradigdhān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ina mahanubhava gurujanon ko marane se isa loka men bhiksha ka anna bhi grahana karana adhika kalyana karaka hai, kyonki gurujanon ko marakara main isa loka men raktaranjita artha aura kama rupa bhogon ko hi bhogunga
verses.english_meaning: Better it is, indeed, in this world to accept alms than to slay the most noble teachers. But if I were to kill them, even in this world, all my enjoyments of wealth and fulfilled desires would be stained with their blood

verses.sanskrit:
न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो

यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः।

यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषाम

स्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः
verses.transliteration:
na chaitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo
yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ
yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣhāmas
te ’vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣhṭrāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Hama nahin janate ki hamen kya karana uchita hai. hama yaha bhi nahin janate ki hama jitenge, ya ve hamako jitenge, jinako marakara hama jivita nahin rahana chahate ve hi dhritarashtara ke putra hamare samane yuddha ke lie khadae hain
verses.english_meaning: I can hardly tell which would be better, that we should conquer them or that they should conquer us. Even the sons of Dhritarashtra, whom we do not wish to slay, stand facing us

verses.sanskrit:
कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः

पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः।

यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्िचतं ब्रूहि तन्मे

शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्
verses.transliteration:
kārpaṇya-doṣhopahata-svabhāvaḥ
pṛichchhāmi tvāṁ dharma-sammūḍha-chetāḥ
yach-chhreyaḥ syānniśhchitaṁ brūhi tanme
śhiṣhyaste ’haṁ śhādhi māṁ tvāṁ prapannam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karuna ke kalusha se abhibhuta aura kartavyapatha para sanbhramita hua main apase puchhata hun, ki mere liye jo shreyashkara ho, use apa nishchaya karake kahiye, kyonki main apaka shishya hun; sharana men aye mujhako apa upadesha dijiye
verses.english_meaning: My heart is overpowered by the taint of pity; my mind is confused as to my duty. I ask Thee: Tell me decisively what is good for me. I am Thy disciple; instruct me, who has taken refuge in Thee

verses.sanskrit:
न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्या

द्यच्छोकमुच्छोषणमिन्द्रियाणाम्।

अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धम्

राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम्
verses.transliteration:
na hi prapaśhyāmi mamāpanudyād
yach-chhokam uchchhoṣhaṇam-indriyāṇām
avāpya bhūmāv-asapatnamṛiddhaṁ
rājyaṁ surāṇāmapi chādhipatyam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prithvi para nishkantaka samriddha rajya ko aura devataon ke svamitva ko prapta hokara bhi main usa upaya ko nahin dekhata hun, jo meri indariyon ko sukhane vale isa shoka ko dura kara sake
verses.english_meaning: I do not see that this sorrow that burns up my senses would be removed, even if I were to attain prosperous and unrivaled dominion on earth or lordship over the gods

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप।

न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
evam-uktvā hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ guḍākeśhaḥ parantapa
na yotsya iti govindam uktvā tūṣhṇīṁ babhūva ha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- isa prakara gudakesha parantapa arjuna bhagavan hrishikesha se yaha kahakara ki he govinda "main yuddha nahin karunga" chupa ho gaya
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Hrishikesha, the Lord of the senses, Arjuna, the conqueror of sleep and destroyer of foes, said, "I will not fight," and became silent

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration:
tam-uvācha hṛiṣhīkeśhaḥ prahasanniva bhārata
senayorubhayor-madhye viṣhīdantam-idaṁ vachaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! donon senaon ke bicha men usa shokamagna arjuna ko bhagavan hrishikesha ne hansate hue se yaha vachana kahe
verses.english_meaning: To him who was despondent in the midst of the two armies, Krishna, smiling, O Bharata, spoke these words

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे।

गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
aśhochyān-anvaśhochas-tvaṁ prajñā-vādānśh cha bhāṣhase
gatāsūn-agatāsūnśh-cha nānuśhochanti paṇḍitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- jinake liye shoka karana uchita nahin hai, unake liye tuma shoka karate ho aura gyaaniyon ke se vachanon ko kahate ho, parantu gyaani purusha mrita aura jivita donon ke liye shoka nahin karate hain
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "You have grieved for those who should not be grieved for; yet, you speak words of wisdom. The wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead."

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः।

न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम्
verses.transliteration:
na tvevāhaṁ jātu nāsaṁ na tvaṁ neme janādhipāḥ
na chaiva na bhaviṣhyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vastava men na to aisa hi hai ki main kisi kala men nahin tha athava tuma nahin the athava ye rajaloga nahin the aura na aisa hi hai ki isase age hama saba nahin rahenge
verses.english_meaning: Nor, at any time, was I not, nor thou, nor these rulers of men; nor, verily, shall we ever cease to be hereafter

verses.sanskrit:
देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा।

तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration:
dehino ’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā
tathā dehāntara-prāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise isa deha men dehi jivatma ki kumara, yuva aura vriddhavastha hoti hai, vaise hi usako anya sharira ki prapti hoti hai; dhira purusha isamen mohita nahin hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Just as the embodied soul passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this body, so too does it pass into another body; the steadfast one does not grieve over this

verses.sanskrit:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।

आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत
verses.transliteration:
mātrā-sparśhās tu kaunteya śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ
āgamāpāyino ’nityās tans-titikṣhasva bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kuntiputra ! shita aura ushna aura sukha dukha ko dene vale indariya aura vishayon ke sanyoga ka prarambha aura anta hota hai; ve anitya hain, isalie, he bharata ! unako tuma sahana karo
verses.english_meaning: The contact of the senses with the objects, O son of Kunti, which causes heat and cold, pleasure and pain, has a beginning and an end; they are impermanent; endure them bravely, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ।

समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration:
yaṁ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣhaṁ puruṣharṣhabha
sama-duḥkha-sukhaṁ dhīraṁ so ’mṛitatvāya kalpate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He purushashreshtha ! dukha aura sukha men samana bhava se rahane vale jisa dhira purusha ko ye vyathita nahin kara sakate hain vaha amritatva ka adhikari hota hai
verses.english_meaning: That firm man, whom surely these afflictions do not, O chief among men, to whom pleasure and pain are the same, is fit for attaining immortality

verses.sanskrit:
नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः।

उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration:
nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ
ubhayorapi dṛiṣhṭo ’nta stvanayos tattva-darśhibhiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Asat vastu ka to astitva nahin hai aura sat ka kabhi abhava nahin hai. isa prakara ina donon ka hi tattava, tattavadarshi gyaani purushon ke dvara dekha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: The unreal has no being; there is no non-being of the real; the truth about both has been seen by the knowers of the truth

verses.sanskrit:
अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।

विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित् कर्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
avināśhi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
vināśham avyayasyāsya na kaśhchit kartum arhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa vastu ko tuma avinashi janon, jisase yaha sampurna jagat vyapta hai. isa avyaya ka nasha karane men koi bhi samartha nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: Know that to be indestructible, by which all this is pervaded. No one can cause the destruction of that, the Imperishable

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः।

अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत
verses.transliteration:
antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāḥ śharīriṇaḥ
anāśhino ’prameyasya tasmād yudhyasva bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa nasharahita aprameya nitya dehi atma ke ye saba sharira nashavan kahe gaye hain. isaliye he bharata ! tuma yuddha karo
verses.english_meaning: These bodies of the embodied Self, which are eternal, indestructible, and immeasurable, are said to have an end. Therefore, fight, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्।

उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते
verses.transliteration:
ya enaṁ vetti hantāraṁ yaśh chainaṁ manyate hatam
ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṁ hanti na hanyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo isa atma ko marane vala samajhata hai aura jo isako mara samajhata hai ve donon hi nahin janate hain, kyonki yaha atma na marata hai aura na mara jata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who takes the Self to be the slayer and he who thinks it is slain, neither of them knows. It does not slay, nor is it slain

verses.sanskrit:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचि

न्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।

अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो

न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे
verses.transliteration:
na jāyate mriyate vā kadāchin
nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ
ajo nityaḥ śhāśhvato ’yaṁ purāṇo
na hanyate hanyamāne śharīre
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha atma kisi kala men bhi na janmata hai aura na marata hai aura na yaha eka bara hokara phira abhavarupa hone vala hai. yaha atma ajanma, nitya, shashvata aura puratana hai, sharira ke nasha hone para bhi isaka nasha nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: It is not born, nor does it ever die; after having been, it again does not cease to be; unborn, eternal, changeless, and ancient, it is not killed when the body is killed

verses.sanskrit:
वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्।

कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम्
verses.transliteration:
vedāvināśhinaṁ nityaṁ ya enam ajam avyayam
kathaṁ sa puruṣhaḥ pārtha kaṁ ghātayati hanti kam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jo purusha isa atma ko avinashi, nitya aura avyayasvarupa janata hai, vaha kaise kisako maravayega aura kaise kisako marega?
verses.english_meaning: Whoever knows it to be indestructible, eternal, unborn, and inexhaustible, how can that person slay, O Arjuna, or cause to be slain?

verses.sanskrit:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय

नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि।

तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा

न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही
verses.transliteration:
vāsānsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya
navāni gṛihṇāti naro ’parāṇi
tathā śharīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānya
nyāni sanyāti navāni dehī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise manushya jirna vastaron ko tyagakara dusare naye vastaron ko dharana karata hai, vaise hi dehi jivatma purane shariron ko tyaga kara dusare nae shariron ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Just as a man casts off worn-out clothes and puts on new ones, so too the embodied Self casts off worn-out bodies and enters others that are new

verses.sanskrit:
नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः।

न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः
verses.transliteration:
nainaṁ chhindanti śhastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ
na chainaṁ kledayantyāpo na śhoṣhayati mārutaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa atma ko shastara kata nahin sakate aura na agni ise jala sakati hai ; jala ise gila nahin kara sakata aura vayu ise sukha nahin sakati
verses.english_meaning: Weapons cannot cut it, fire cannot burn it, water cannot wet it, wind cannot dry it

verses.sanskrit:
अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च।

नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः
verses.transliteration:
achchhedyo ’yam adāhyo ’yam akledyo ’śhoṣhya eva cha
nityaḥ sarva-gataḥ sthāṇur achalo ’yaṁ sanātanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki yaha atma achhedya , adahya , akledya aura ashoshya hai; yaha nitya, sarvagata, sthanu , achala aura sanatana hai
verses.english_meaning: This Self cannot be cut, burned, wetted, nor dried up; it is eternal, all-pervasive, stable, immovable, and ancient

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते।

तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
avyakto ’yam achintyo ’yam avikāryo ’yam uchyate
tasmādevaṁ viditvainaṁ nānuśhochitum arhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha atma avyakta, achintaya aura avikari kaha jata hai; isalie isako isa prakara janakara tumako shoka karana uchita nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: This Self is said to be unmanifested, unthinkable, and unchangeable. Therefore, knowing this to be so, you should not grieve

verses.sanskrit:
अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्।

तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam
tathāpi tvaṁ mahā-bāho naivaṁ śhochitum arhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura yadi tuma atma ko nitya janmane aura nitya marane vala mano to bhi, he mahabaho ! isa prakara shoka karana tumhare lie uchita nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: But even if thou thinkest of It as constantly being born and constantly dying, even then, O mighty-armed one, thou shouldst not grieve

verses.sanskrit:
जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।

तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha
tasmād aparihārye ’rthe na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Janmane vale ki mrityu nishchita hai aura marane vale ka janma nishchita hai; isalie jo atala hai apariharya - hai usake vishaya men tumako shoka nahin karana chahiye
verses.english_meaning: For the born, death is certain, and for the dead, birth is certain; therefore, you should not grieve over the inevitable

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत।

अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना
verses.transliteration:
avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyakta-madhyāni bhārata
avyakta-nidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! samasta prani janma se purva aura mrityu ke bada avyakta avastha men rahate hain aura bicha men vyakta hote hain. phira usamen chinta ya shoka ki kya bata hai ?
verses.english_meaning: Beings are unmanifest in their beginning, manifest in their middle state, O Arjuna, and unmanifest again in their end. What is there to grieve about?

verses.sanskrit:
आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन

माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः।

आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति

श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्
verses.transliteration:
āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan
āśhcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chānyaḥ
āśhcharya-vach chainam anyaḥ śhṛiṇoti
śhrutvāpyenaṁ veda na chaiva kaśhchit
verses.hinglish_meaning: Koi ise ashcharya ke samana dekhata hai; koi isake vishaya men ashcharya ke samana kahata hai; aura koi anya purusha ise ashcharya ke samana sunata hai; aura phira koi sunakara bhi nahin janata
verses.english_meaning: One sees this as a wonder; another speaks of it as a wonder; another hears of it as a wonder; yet, having heard, none understands it at all

verses.sanskrit:
देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत।

तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata
tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! yaha dehi atma sabake sharira men sada hi avadhya hai, isalie samasta praniyon ke lie tumhen shoka karana uchita nahin
verses.english_meaning: This indweller in the body of everyone is ever indestructible, O Arjuna; therefore, you should not grieve for any creature

verses.sanskrit:
स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि।

धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi
dharmyāddhi yuddhāch chhreyo ’nyat kṣhatriyasya na vidyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura svadharma ko bhi dekhakara tumako vichalita hona uchita nahin hai, kyonki dharmayukta yuddha se badhakara dusara koi kalyanakaraka kartatavya kshatriya ke liye nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: Further, having regard to your duty, you should not waver, for there is nothing higher for a Kshatriya than a righteous war

verses.sanskrit:
यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्।

सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration:
yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam
sukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura he partha ! apane apa prapta hue aura svarga ke lie khule hue dvararupa isa prakara ke yuddha ko bhagyavana kshatriya loga hi pate hain
verses.english_meaning: Happy are the Kshatriyas, O Arjuna! who are called to fight in such a battle that comes of its own accord as an open door to heaven

verses.sanskrit:
अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।

ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration:
atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi
tataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura yadi tuma isa dharmayuddha ko svikara nahin karoge, to svadharma aura kirti ko khokara papa ko prapta karoge
verses.english_meaning: But if you will not fight this righteous war, then having abandoned your own duty and reputation, you will incur sin

verses.sanskrit:
अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्।

संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते
verses.transliteration:
akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni
kathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām
sambhāvitasya chākīrtir
maraṇād atirichyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura saba loga tumhari bahuta kala taka rahane vali apakirti ko bhi kahate rahenge; aura sammanita purusha ke lie apakirti marana se bhi adhika hoti hai
verses.english_meaning: People will also recount your everlasting dishonor; and for one who has been honored, dishonor is worse than death

verses.sanskrit:
भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः।

येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्
verses.transliteration:
bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ
yeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura jinake lie tuma bahuta mananiya ho unake lie aba tuma tuchhata ko prapta hooge, ve maharathi loga tumhen bhaya ke karana yuddha se nivritta hua manenge
verses.english_meaning: The great chariot-warriors will think that you have withdrawn from the battle out of fear, and you will be held in low esteem by those who have held you in high regard

verses.sanskrit:
अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः।

निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्
verses.transliteration:
avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ
nindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tumhare shatru tumhare sarmathya ki ninda karate hue bahuta se akathaniya vachanon ko kahenge, phira usase adhika du:kha kya hoga ?
verses.english_meaning: Your enemies, scoffing at your power, will speak many abusive words—what could be more painful than this?

verses.sanskrit:
हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।

तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration:
hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm
tasmād uttiṣhṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛita-niśhchayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yuddha men marakara tuma svarga prapta karoge ya jitakara prithvi ko bhogoge; isaliya, he kaunteya ! yuddha ka nishchaya kara tuma khadae ho jao
verses.english_meaning: Slain, you will obtain heaven; victorious, you will enjoy the earth; therefore, stand up, O son of Kunti, resolved to fight

verses.sanskrit:
सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ।

ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration:
sukha-duḥkhe same kṛitvā lābhālābhau jayājayau
tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṁ pāpam avāpsyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sukha-du:kha, labha-hani aura jaya-parajaya ko samana karake yuddha ke liye taiyara ho jao; isa prakara tumako papa nahin hoga
verses.english_meaning: Having made pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat equal, engage in battle for the sake of battle; thus, you shall not incur sin

verses.sanskrit:
एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु।

बुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि
verses.transliteration:
eṣhā te ’bhihitā sānkhye
buddhir yoge tvimāṁ śhṛiṇu
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha
karma-bandhaṁ prahāsyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! tumhen sankhya vishayaka gyaana kaha gaya aura aba isa yoga se sambandhita gyaana ko suno jisa gyaana se yukta hokara tuma karmabandha ka nasha kara sakoge
verses.english_meaning: This, which has been taught to you, is wisdom concerning Sankhya. Now listen to wisdom concerning Yoga, endowed with which, O Arjuna, you shall cast off the bonds of action

verses.sanskrit:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते।

स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्
verses.transliteration:
nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate
svalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isamen kramanasha aura pratyavaya dosha nahin hai. isa dharma ka alpa abhyasa bhi mahan bhaya se rakshana karata hai
verses.english_meaning: In this, there is no loss of effort, nor is there any harm produced, nor any transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects one from great fear

verses.sanskrit:
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन।

बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana
bahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kurunandana ! isa men nishchayatmaka buddhi eka hi hai, agyaani purushon ki buddhiyan bahuta bhedon vali aura ananta hoti hain
verses.english_meaning: Here, O joy of the Kurus, there is only one single-pointed determination; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the indecisive

verses.sanskrit:
यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः।

वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः
verses.transliteration:
yāmimāṁ puṣhpitāṁ vāchaṁ pravadanty-avipaśhchitaḥ
veda-vāda-ratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ
kāmātmānaḥ swarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśheṣha-bahulāṁ bhogaiśhwarya-gatiṁ prati
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha aviveki purusha vedavada men ramate huye jo yaha pushpita vani bolate hain? isase badhakara aura kuchha nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: The unwise, taking pleasure in the eulogizing words of the Vedas, utter flowery speech, saying, "There is nothing else," O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्।

क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
kāmātmānaḥ svarga-parā
janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśeṣa-bahulāṁ
bhogaiśvarya-gatiṁ prati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kamanaon se yukta? svarga ko hi shreshtha manane vale loga bhoga aura aishvarya ko prapta karane vali aneka kriyaon ko batate hain jo janmarupa karmaphala ko dene vali hoti hain
verses.english_meaning: Full of desires, with heaven as their goal, leading to new births as the result of their works, and prescribe various methods abounding in specific actions, for the attainment of pleasure and power

verses.sanskrit:
भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्।

व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते
verses.transliteration:
bhogaiśwvarya-prasaktānāṁ tayāpahṛita-chetasām
vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usase jinaka chitta hara liya gaya hai aise bhoga aura eshravarya ma asakti rakhane vale purushon ke antakarana me nishchayatmak buddhi nahi hati arthata ve dhyana ka abhyasa karane yogya nahi hote
verses.english_meaning: For those who are attached to pleasure and power, whose minds are drawn away by such teachings, their determinate reason is not formed which is steadily bent on meditation and Samadhi

verses.sanskrit:
त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन।

निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
trai-guṇya-viṣhayā vedā nistrai-guṇyo bhavārjuna
nirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kṣhema ātmavān
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna vedon ka vishaya tina gunon se sambandhita hai tuma trigunatita? nirdavandava? nitya sattava men sthita? yogakshema se rahita aura atmavan bano
verses.english_meaning: The Vedas deal with the three attributes; be thou above these three attributes. O Arjuna, free yourself from the pairs of opposites and ever remain in the quality of Sattva, freed from acquisition and preservation, and be established in the Self

verses.sanskrit:
यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके।

तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः
verses.transliteration:
yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ samplutodake
tāvānsarveṣhu vedeṣhu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saba ora se paripurna jalarashi ke hone para manushya ka chhote jalashaya men jitana prayojana rahata hai? atmagyaani brahmana ka sabhi vedon men utana hi prayojana rahata hai
verses.english_meaning: To the Brahmana who has known the Self, all the Vedas are of as much use as a reservoir of water would be in a place where there is a flood

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।

मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karma karane matra men tumhara adhikara hai? phala men kabhi nahin. tuma karmaphala ke hetu vale mata hona aura akarma men bhi tumhari asakti na ho
verses.english_meaning: Your right is only to work, but not to its results; do not let the results of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction

verses.sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।

सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dhananjaya asakti ko tyaga kara tatha siddhi aura asiddhi men samabhava hokara yoga men sthita huye tuma karma karo. yaha samabhava hi yoga kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Perform action, O Arjuna, being steadfast in Yoga, abandoning attachment and balanced in success and failure; evenness of mind is called Yoga

verses.sanskrit:
दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय।

बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः
verses.transliteration:
dūreṇa hy-avaraṁ karma buddhi-yogād dhanañjaya
buddhau śharaṇam anvichchha kṛipaṇāḥ phala-hetavaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa buddhiyoga ki tulana men karma atyanta nikrishta hain? isaliye he dhananjaya tuma baddhi ki sharana lo phala ki ichha karanevale kripana hain
verses.english_meaning: Far lower than the Yoga of wisdom is action, O Arjuna. Seek thou refuge in wisdom; wretched are those whose motive is the fruit

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।

तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
verses.transliteration:
buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite
tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samatvabuddhi yukta purusha yahan punya aura papa ina donon karmon ko tyaga deta hai? isaliye tuma yoga se yukta ho jao. karmon men kushalata yoga hai
verses.english_meaning: Endowed with wisdom and evenness of mind, one casts off in this life both good and evil deeds; therefore, devote yourself to Yoga; Yoga is skill in action

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः।

जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्
verses.transliteration:
karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ
janma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ padaṁ gachchhanty-anāmayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Buddhiyoga yukta manishi loga karmajanya phalon ko tyagakara janmarupa bandhana se mukta huye anamaya arthat nirdosha pada ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: The wise, possessing knowledge, having abandoned the fruits of their actions, and being freed from the bonds of birth, go to the place which is beyond all evil

verses.sanskrit:
यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति।

तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च
verses.transliteration:
yadā te moha-kalilaṁ buddhir vyatitariṣhyati
tadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śhrotavyasya śhrutasya cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba tumhari buddhi moharupa daladala ko tara jayegi taba tuma una saba vastuon se nirveda ko prapta ho jaoge? jo sunane yogya aura suni hui hain
verses.english_meaning: When your intellect passes beyond the mire of delusion, then you will attain indifference to what has been heard and what has yet to be heard

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला।

समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration:
śhruti-vipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niśhchalā
samādhāv-achalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba aneka prakara ke vishayon ko sunane se vichalita hui tumhari buddhi atmasvarupa men achala aura sthira ho jayegi taba tuma yoga ko prapta karoge
verses.english_meaning: When your intellect, which is perplexed by the Vedic texts you have read, stands immovable and steady in the Self, then you will attain Self-realization

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव।

स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
sthita-prajñasya kā bhāṣhā samādhi-sthasya keśhava
sthita-dhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣheta kim āsīta vrajeta kim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he keshava samadhi men sthita sthira buddhi vale purusha ka kya lakshana hai sthira buddhi purusha kaise bolata hai kaise baithata hai kaise chalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, what is the description of one who has steady wisdom and is merged in the superconscious state? How does one of steady wisdom speak, how do they sit, and how do they walk?"

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्।

आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha mano-gatān
ātmany-evātmanā tuṣhṭaḥ sthita-prajñas tadochyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- he partha? jisa samaya purusha mana men sthita saba kamanaon ko tyaga deta hai aura atma se hi atma men santushta rahata hai? usa samaya vaha sthitapragyaa kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "When a man completely casts off, O Arjuna, all the desires of the mind and is satisfied in the Self by the Self, then he is said to be one of steady wisdom."

verses.sanskrit:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः।

वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dukha men jisaka mana udvigna nahin hota sukha men jisaki spriha nivritta ho gayi hai? jisake mana se raga? bhaya aura krodha nashta ho gaye hain? vaha muni sthitapragyaa kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: He whose mind is not shaken by adversity, who does not long for pleasures, and is free from attachment, fear, and anger, is called a sage of steady wisdom

verses.sanskrit:
यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्।

नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham
nābhinandati na dveṣhṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sarvatra ati sneha se rahita hua una shubha tatha ashubha vastuon ko prapta kara na prasanna hota hai aura na dvesha karata hai? usaki pragyaa pratishthita hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is everywhere without attachment, upon encountering anything good or bad, neither rejoices nor hastens; his wisdom is firm

verses.sanskrit:
यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration:
yadā sanharate chāyaṁ kūrmo ’ṅgānīva sarvaśhaḥ
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kachhuva apane angon ko jaise sameta leta hai vaise hi yaha purusha jaba saba ora se apani indariyon ko indariyon ke vishayon se paravritta kara leta hai? taba usaki buddhi sthira hoti hai
verses.english_meaning: When, like the tortoise which withdraws all its limbs on all sides, he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects, then his wisdom becomes steady

verses.sanskrit:
विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः।

रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
viṣhayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ
rasa-varjaṁ raso ’pyasya paraṁ dṛiṣhṭvā nivartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Nirahari dehi purusha se vishaya to nivritta ho jate hain? parantu raga nahin parama tatva ko dekhane para isa ka raga bhi nivritta ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: The objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent man, leaving the longing behind; but his longing also turns away upon seeing the Supreme

verses.sanskrit:
यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः।

इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः
verses.transliteration:
yatato hyapi kaunteya puruṣhasya vipaśhchitaḥ
indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṁ manaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya prayatna karate hue buddhimana purusha ke bhi mana ko ye indariyan balapurvaka hara leti hain
verses.english_meaning: The turbulent senses, O Arjuna, can violently carry away the mind of a wise person, even though they are striving to control them

verses.sanskrit:
तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः।

वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration:
tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
vaśhe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Una saba indariyon ko sanyamita kara yukta aura matpara hove. jisa purusha ki indariyan vasha men hoti hain? usaki pragyaa pratishthita hoti hai
verses.english_meaning: Having restrained them all, he should sit steadfast, intent on Me; his wisdom is steady whose senses are under control

verses.sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।

सङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration:
dhyāyato viṣhayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣhūpajāyate
saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho ’bhijāyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vishayon ka chintana karane vale purusha ki usamen asakti ho jati hai? asakti se ichha aura ichha se krodha utpanna hota hai
verses.english_meaning: When one thinks of objects, attachment to them arises; from attachment, desire is born; from desire, anger arises

verses.sanskrit:
क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः।

स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration:
krodhād bhavati sammohaḥ sammohāt smṛiti-vibhramaḥ
smṛiti-bhranśhād buddhi-nāśho buddhi-nāśhāt praṇaśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Krodha se utpanna hota hai moha aura moha se smriti vibhrama. smriti ke bhramita hone para buddhi ka nasha hota hai aura buddhi ke nasha hone se vaha manushya nashta ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Anger leads to delusion, which causes loss of memory; this, in turn, leads to the destruction of discrimination, resulting in destruction

verses.sanskrit:
रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन्।

आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
rāga-dveṣha-viyuktais tu viṣhayān indriyaiśh charan
ātma-vaśhyair-vidheyātmā prasādam adhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Atmasanyami purusha ragadvesha se rahita apane vasha men ki hui indariyon dvara vishayon ko bhogata hua prasannata prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: But the self-controlled man, moving among objects with the senses restrained and free from attraction and repulsion, attains peace

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते।

प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration:
prasāde sarva-duḥkhānāṁ hānir asyopajāyate
prasanna-chetaso hyāśhu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣhṭhate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prasada ke hone para sampurna dukhon ka anta ho jata hai aura prasannachitta purusha ki buddhi hi shighra hi sthira ho jati hai
verses.english_meaning: In that peace, all pains are destroyed; for the intellect of the tranquil-minded soon becomes steady

verses.sanskrit:
नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना।

न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्
verses.transliteration:
nāsti buddhir-ayuktasya na chāyuktasya bhāvanā
na chābhāvayataḥ śhāntir aśhāntasya kutaḥ sukham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ayukta purusha ko gyaana nahin hota aura ayukta ko bhavana aura dhyana ki kshamata nahin hoti bhavana rahita purusha ko shanti nahin milati ashanta purusha ko sukha kahan
verses.english_meaning: There is no knowledge of the Self for the unsteady, and no meditation is possible for the unsteady, and no peace for the unmeditative, and how can there be happiness for one who has no peace?

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते।

तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि
verses.transliteration:
indriyāṇāṁ hi charatāṁ yan mano ’nuvidhīyate
tadasya harati prajñāṁ vāyur nāvam ivāmbhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jala men vayu jaise nava ko hara leta hai vaise hi vishayon men virachati hui indariyon ke bicha men jisa indariya ka anukarana mana karata hai? vaha eka hi indariya isaki pragyaa ko hara leti hai
verses.english_meaning: For the mind, which follows in the wake of the wandering senses, carries away his discrimination, as the wind carries away a boat on the waters

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration:
tasmād yasya mahā-bāho nigṛihītāni sarvaśhaḥ
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isaliye? he mahabaho jisa purusha ki indariyan saba prakara indariyon ke vishayon ke vasha men ki hui hoti hain? usaki buddhi sthira hoti hai
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, O mighty-armed Arjuna, his knowledge is steady whose senses are completely restrained from sense objects

verses.sanskrit:
या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी।

यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः
verses.transliteration:
yā niśhā sarva-bhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti sanyamī
yasyāṁ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśhā paśhyato muneḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saba praniyon ke lie jo ratri hai? usamen sanyami purusha jagata hai aura jahan saba prani jagate hain? vaha dekhane vale muni ke lie ratri hai
verses.english_meaning: That which is night to all beings, in that the self-controlled man is awake; when all beings are awake, that is night for the sage who sees

verses.sanskrit:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं

समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।

तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे

स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी
verses.transliteration:
āpūryamāṇam achala-pratiṣhṭhaṁ
samudram āpaḥ praviśhanti yadvat
tadvat kāmā yaṁ praviśhanti sarve
sa śhāntim āpnoti na kāma-kāmī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise saba ora se paripurna achala pratishtha vale samudra men jala sama jate hain? vaise hi jisa purusha ke prati kamanaon ke vishaya usamen sama jate hain? vaha purusha shanti prapta karata hai? na ki bhogon ki kamana karane vala purusha
verses.english_meaning: He attains peace into whom all desires enter, just as waters enter the ocean which, filled from all sides, remains unmoved; but not the man who is full of desires

verses.sanskrit:
विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः।

निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शांतिमधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumānśh charati niḥspṛihaḥ
nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sa śhāntim adhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha saba kamanaon ko tyagakara spriharahita? mamabhava rahita aura nirahankara hua vicharana karata hai? vaha shanti prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: That person attains peace who, abandoning all desires, moves about without longing, without the sense of ownership, and without egoism

verses.sanskrit:
एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति।

स्थित्वाऽस्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति
verses.transliteration:
eṣhā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati
sthitvāsyām anta-kāle ’pi brahma-nirvāṇam ṛichchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha yaha brahmi sthiti hai. ise prapta kara purusha mohita nahin hota. antakala men bhi isa nishtha men sthita hokara brahmanirvana ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: O son of Pritha, this is the eternal state, the Brahmic seat. Attaining this, one is not deluded. Being established in it, one attains oneness with Brahman even at the end of life

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन।

तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
jyāyasī chet karmaṇas te matā buddhir janārdana
tat kiṁ karmaṇi ghore māṁ niyojayasi keśhava
verses.hinglish_meaning: He janardana yadi apako yaha manya hai ki karma se gyaana shreshtha hai to phira he keshava apa mujhe isa bhayankara karma men kyon pravritta karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said: If Thou thinkest that knowledge is superior to action, O Krishna, why then, O Kesava, doest Thou ask me to engage in this terrible action?

verses.sanskrit:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे।

तदेकं वद निश्िचत्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration:
vyāmiśhreṇeva vākyena buddhiṁ mohayasīva me
tad ekaṁ vada niśhchitya yena śhreyo ’ham āpnuyām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apa isa mishrita vakya se meri buddhi ko mohitasa karate hain ata apa usa eka ko nishchita rupa se kahiye jisase main parama shreya ko prapta kara sakun
verses.english_meaning: With this seemingly perplexing speech, you seem to be confusing my understanding; therefore, tell me one certain way by which I may attain bliss

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ।

ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
loke’smin dvi-vidhā niṣhṭhā purā proktā mayānagha
jñāna-yogena sāṅkhyānāṁ karma-yogena yoginām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha he nishpapa arjuna isa shloka men do prakara ki nishtha mere dvara pahale kahi gayi hai gyaaniyon ki gyaanayoga se aura yogiyon ki karmayoga se
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "In this world, there is a twofold path, as I said before, O sinless one: the path of knowledge of the Sankhyas and the path of action of the Yogins."

verses.sanskrit:
न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते।

न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣhkarmyaṁ puruṣho ’śhnute
na cha sannyasanād eva siddhiṁ samadhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karmon ke na karane se manushya nairshakamya ko prapta nahin hota aura na karmon ke sannyasa se hi vaha siddhi prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Man does not reach actionlessness by not performing actions; nor does he attain perfection by mere renunciation

verses.sanskrit:
न हि कश्िचत्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्।

कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः
verses.transliteration:
na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit
kāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Koi bhi purusha kabhi kshanamatra bhi bina karma kie nahin raha sakata kyonki prakriti se utpanna gunon ke dvara avasha hue saba se karma karava liya jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Verily, no one can remain for even a moment without performing action; for everyone is made to act helplessly, indeed, by the qualities born of Nature

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।

इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran
indriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo mudha buddhi purusha karmendariyon ka nigraha kara indariyon ke bhogon ka mana se smarana karata rahata hai vaha mithyachari kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who, restraining the organs of action, sits thinking of the sense-objects in his mind, he of deluded understanding is called a hypocrite

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन।

कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration:
yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna
karmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu he arjuna jo purusha mana se indariyon ko vasha men karake anasakta hua karmenndariyon se karmayoga ka acharana karata hai vaha shreshtha hai
verses.english_meaning: But whoever, controlling the senses by the mind, O Arjuna, engages himself in Karma Yoga with the organs of action, without attachment, he excels

verses.sanskrit:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।

शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः
verses.transliteration:
niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
śharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tuma niyata karma karo kyonki akarma se shreshtha karma hai. tumhare akarma hone se sharira nirvaha bhi nahin siddha hoga
verses.english_meaning: Perform your bounden duty, for action is superior to inaction, and even the maintenance of the body would not be possible for you through inaction

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः।

तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर
verses.transliteration:
yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ
tad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅgaḥ samāchara
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yagyaa ke liye kiye hue karma ke atirikta anya karma men pravritta hua yaha purusha karmon dvara bandhata hai isalie he kaunteya asakti ko tyagakara yagyaa ke nimitta hi karma ka samyak acharana karo
verses.english_meaning: The world is bound by actions other than those performed for the sake of sacrifice; do thou, therefore, O son of Kunti , perform actions for that sake alone, free from attachment

verses.sanskrit:
सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।

अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्
verses.transliteration:
saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ
anena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prajapati ne adi men yagyaa sahita praja ka nirmana kara kaha isa yagyaa dvara tuma vriddhi ko prapta ho aura yaha yagyaa tumhare liye ichhita kamanaon ko purna karane vala hove
verses.english_meaning: The Creator, having in the beginning created mankind together with sacrifice, said, "By this shall you propagate; let this be the milch cow of your desires—the cow that yields all the desired objects."

verses.sanskrit:
देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः।

परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ
verses.transliteration:
devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ
parasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tuma loga isa yagyaa dvara devataon ki unnati karo aura ve devatagana tumhari unnati karen. isa prakara paraspara unnati karate huye parama shreya ko tuma prapta hoge
verses.english_meaning: With this, nourish the gods, and may the gods nourish you; thus, nourishing each other, you shall attain the highest good

verses.sanskrit:
इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः।

तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः
verses.transliteration:
iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ
tair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yagyaa dvara poshita devatagana tumhen ishta bhoga pradana karenge. unake dvara diye huye bhogon ko jo purusha unako diye bina hi bhogata hai vaha nishchaya hi chora hai
verses.english_meaning: The gods, nourished by the sacrifice, will give you the desired objects. So, he who enjoys the objects given by the gods without offering anything in return is indeed a thief

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः।

भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्
verses.transliteration:
yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yagyaa ke avashishta anna ko khane vale shreshtha purusha saba papon se mukta ho jate hain kintu jo loga kevala svayan ke liye hi pakate hain ve to papon ko hi khate hain
verses.english_meaning: The righteous who eat the remnants of the sacrifice are freed from all sins; but those sinful ones who cook food solely for their own sake indeed consume sin

verses.sanskrit:
अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः।

यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration:
annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād anna-sambhavaḥ
yajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karma-samudbhavaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samasta prani anna se utpanna hote hain anna ki utpatti parjanya se. parjanya ki utpatti yagyaa se aura yagyaa karmon se utpanna hota hai
verses.english_meaning: From food come forth beings; from rain, food is produced; from sacrifice arises rain, and sacrifice is born of action

verses.sanskrit:
कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्।

तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration:
karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam
tasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karma ki utpatti brahmaji se hoti hai aura brahmaji akshara tattava se vyakta hote hain. isaliye sarva vyapi brahma sada hi yagyaa men pratishthita hai
verses.english_meaning: Know that action comes from Brahma, and Brahma comes from the Imperishable. Therefore, the all-pervasive Brahma ever rests in sacrifice

verses.sanskrit:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः।

अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ pravartitaṁ chakraṁ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ
aghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṁ pārtha sa jīvati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha yahan isa prakara pravartita hue chakra ka anuvartana nahin karata he partha inndariyon men ramane vala vaha papa ayu purusha vyartha hi jita hai
verses.english_meaning: He who does not follow the wheel thus set in motion, who is of sinful life, rejoicing in the senses, lives in vain, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः।

आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ
ātmanyeva cha santuṣhṭas tasya kāryaṁ na vidyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu jo manushya atma men hi ramane vala atma men hi tripta tatha atma men hi santushta ho usake liye koi kartavya nahin rahata
verses.english_meaning: But for that man who rejoices only in the Self, who is satisfied with the Self and is content in the Self alone, indeed there is nothing to do

verses.sanskrit:
नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन।

न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्िचदर्थव्यपाश्रयः
verses.transliteration:
naiva tasya kṛitenārtho nākṛiteneha kaśhchana
na chāsya sarva-bhūteṣhu kaśhchid artha-vyapāśhrayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa jagat men usa purusha ka krita aura akrita se koi prayojana nahin hai aura na vaha kisi vastu ke liye bhutamatra para ashrita hota hai
verses.english_meaning: For him, there is no interest whatsoever in what is done or not done; nor does he depend on any being for any purpose

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।

असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः
verses.transliteration:
tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara
asakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isalie, tuma anasakta hokara sadaiva kartavya karma ka samyak acharana karo; kyoki, anasakta purusha karma karata hua paramatma ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, without attachment, always perform the actions that should be done; for by performing actions without attachment, one reaches the Supreme

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः।

लोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇaiva hi sansiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ
loka-saṅgraham evāpi sampaśhyan kartum arhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Janakadi bhi karma dvara hi sansiddhi ko prapta huye loka sangraha ko bhi dekhate huye; tuma karma karane yogya ho
verses.english_meaning: Janaka and others attained perfection indeed through action alone; even with the intention of protecting the masses, you should perform action

verses.sanskrit:
