यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।

स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ
sa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shreshtha purusha jaisa acharana karata hai, anya loga bhi vaisa hi anukarana karate hain; vaha purusha jo kuchha pramana kara deta hai, loga bhi usaka anusarana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Whatever a great man does, others also do; whatever he establishes as the standard, the world follows

verses.sanskrit:
न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन।

नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि
verses.transliteration:
na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana
nānavāptam avāptavyaṁ varta eva cha karmaṇi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadyapi mujhe trailokya men kuchha bhi kartavya nahin hain tatha kinchita bhi prapta hone yogya vastu aprapta nahin hai, to bhi main karma men hi bartata hun
verses.english_meaning: There is nothing in the three worlds, O Arjuna, that needs to be done by Me, nor is there anything unattained that needs to be attained; yet I engage Myself in action

verses.sanskrit:
यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।

मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadi main savadhana hua kadachita karma men na laga rahun to, he partha ! saba prakara se manushya mere marga ka anusarana karenge
verses.english_meaning: For, should I not ever engage myself in action, unwearied, people would in every way follow my path, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्।

सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration:
utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham
sankarasya cha kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadi main karma na karun, to ye samasta loka nashta ho jayenge; aura main varnasankara ka karta tatha isa praja ka hanana karane vala hounga
verses.english_meaning: These worlds would perish if I did not perform action; I would be the author of confusion of castes and destruction of these beings

verses.sanskrit:
सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत।

कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्िचकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्
verses.transliteration:
saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvānso yathā kurvanti bhārata
kuryād vidvāns tathāsaktaśh chikīrṣhur loka-saṅgraham
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! karma men asakta hue agyaanijana jaise karma karate hain vaise hi vidvan purusha anasakta hokara, lokasangraha ki ichha se karma kare
verses.english_meaning: As the ignorant act out of attachment to action, O Bharata, so should the wise act without attachment, wishing for the welfare of the world

verses.sanskrit:
न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्।

जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्
verses.transliteration:
na buddhi-bhedaṁ janayed ajñānāṁ karma-saṅginām
joṣhayet sarva-karmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācharan
verses.hinglish_meaning: Gyaani purusha, karmon men asakta agyaaniyon ki buddhi men bhrama utpanna na kare, svayan yukta hokara karmon ka samyak acharana kara, unase bhi vaisa hi karaye
verses.english_meaning: Let no wise man unsettle the minds of ignorant people who are attached to action; he should engage them in all actions, himself fulfilling them with devotion

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः।

अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते
verses.transliteration:
prakṛiteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśhaḥ
ahankāra-vimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sampurna karma prakriti ke gunon dvara kiye jate hain, ahankara se mohita hua purusha, "main karta hun" aisa mana leta hai
verses.english_meaning: All actions are wrought in all cases by the qualities of Nature alone. He whose mind is deluded by egoism thinks, "I am the doer."

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः।

गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते
verses.transliteration:
tattva-vit tu mahā-bāho guṇa-karma-vibhāgayoḥ
guṇā guṇeṣhu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu he mahabaho ! guna aura karma ke vibhaga ke satya ko janane vala gyaani purusha yaha janakara ki "guna gunon men bartate hain" asakta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: But he who knows the Truth, O mighty-armed Arjuna, about the divisions of the qualities and their functions, knowing that the Gunas, as senses, move amidst the Gunas, as the sense-objects, is not attached

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु।

तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्
verses.transliteration:
prakṛiter guṇa-sammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇa-karmasu
tān akṛitsna-vido mandān kṛitsna-vin na vichālayet
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prakriti ke gunon se mohita hue purusha guna aura karma men asakta hote hain, una apurna gyaana vale mandabuddhi purushon ko purna gyaana prapta purusha vichalita na kare
verses.english_meaning: Those deluded by the qualities of Nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. The man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish one who is of imperfect knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा।

निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā
nirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sampurna karmon ka mujha men sannyasa karake, asha aura mamata se rahita hokara, santaparahita hue tuma yuddha karo
verses.english_meaning: Renouncing all actions in Me, with the mind centered on the Self, free from hope and egoism, and from mental fever, fight thou

verses.sanskrit:
ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः।

श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः
verses.transliteration:
ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ
śhraddhāvanto ’nasūyanto muchyante te ’pi karmabhiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo manushya dosha buddhi se rahita aura shraddha se yukta hue sada mere isa mata ka anushthanapurvaka palana karate hain, ve karmon se mukta ho jate hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who constantly practice this teaching of Mine with faith and without caviling, they too are freed from actions

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्।

सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः
verses.transliteration:
ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam
sarva-jñāna-vimūḍhāns tān viddhi naṣhṭān achetasaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu jo dosha drishti vale mudha loga isa mere mata ka palana nahin karate, una saba gyaanon men mohita chittavalon ko nashta huye hi tuma samajho
verses.english_meaning: But those who criticize My teaching and do not practice it, deprived of all knowledge and lacking discernment, know them to be doomed to destruction

verses.sanskrit:
सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि।

प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api
prakṛitiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Gyaanavan purusha bhi apani prakriti ke anusara cheshta karata hai. sabhi prani apani prakriti para hi jate hain, phira inamen nigraha kya karega
verses.english_meaning: Even a wise man acts in accordance with his own nature; beings will follow their nature; what can restraint do?

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ।

तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ
verses.transliteration:
indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāga-dveṣhau vyavasthitau
tayor na vaśham āgachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau
verses.hinglish_meaning: Indariyaindariya ke vishaya ke prati ragadvesha rahate hain; manushya ko chahiye ki vaha una donon ke vasha men na ho; kyonki ve isake shatru hain
verses.english_meaning: Attachment and aversion for the objects of the senses abide in the senses; let no one come under their sway; for, they are his enemies

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।

स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः
verses.transliteration:
śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
swa-dharme nidhanaṁ śhreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samyak prakara se anushthita paradharma ki apeksha gunarahita svadharma ka palana shreyashkara hai; svadharma men marana kalyanakaraka hai paradharma bhaya ko dene vala hai
verses.english_meaning: Better is one's own duty, though devoid of merit, than the duty of another well discharged. Better is death in one's own duty; the duty of another is fraught with fear

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः।

अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
atha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ
anichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he varshaneya ! phira yaha purusha balapurvaka badhya kiye huye ke samana anichha hote huye bhi kisake dvara prerita hokara papa ka acharana karata hai?
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "But what compels man to commit sin, even against his wishes, O Varshneya , as if constrained by force?"

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः।

महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
kāma eṣha krodha eṣha rajo-guṇa-samudbhavaḥ
mahāśhano mahā-pāpmā viddhyenam iha vairiṇam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- rajoguna men utpanna hui yaha 'kamana' hai, yahi krodha hai; yaha mahashana aura mahapapi hai, ise hi tuma yahan shatru jano
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "It is desire and it is anger, both of the quality of Rajas, all-devouring and all-sinful; know this as the foe here in this world."

verses.sanskrit:
धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च।

यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्
verses.transliteration:
dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśho malena cha
yatholbenāvṛito garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise dhuyen se agni aura dhuli se darpana dhaka jata hai tatha jaise bhruna garbhashaya se dhaka rahata hai, vaise usa ke dvara yaha avrita hota hai
verses.english_meaning: As fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror is covered by dust, and as an embryo is surrounded by the amniotic sac, so is this enveloped by that

verses.sanskrit:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा।

कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च
verses.transliteration:
āvṛitaṁ jñānam etena jñānino nitya-vairiṇā
kāma-rūpeṇa kaunteya duṣhpūreṇānalena cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! agni ke samana jisako tripta karana kathina hai aise kamarupa, gyaani ke isa nitya shatru dvara gyaana avrita hai
verses.english_meaning: O Arjuna, wisdom is enveloped by this constant enemy of the wise, in the form of desire, which is insatiable like fire

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।

एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्
verses.transliteration:
indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate
etair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Indariyan, mana aura buddhi isake nivasa sthana kahe jate hain; yaha kama inake dvara hi gyaana ko achhadita karake dehi purusha ko mohita karata hai
verses.english_meaning: The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its seat; through these, it deludes the embodied one, veiling their wisdom

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ।

पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha
pāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isaliye, he arjuna ! tuma pahale indariyon ko vasha men karake, gyaana aura vigyaana ke nashaka isa kamarupa papi ko nashta karo
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, O best of the Bharatas, control your senses first and then kill this sinful thing, which destroys knowledge and realization

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।

मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः
verses.transliteration:
indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ
manasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Pare indariyan kahi jati hain; indariyon se pare mana hai aura mana se pare buddhi hai, aura jo buddhi se bhi pare hai, vaha hai atma
verses.english_meaning: They say that the senses are superior to the body; the mind is superior to the senses; the intellect is superior to the mind; and He is superior even to the intellect

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।

जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā
jahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara buddhi se pare atma ko janakara atma ke dvara atma ko vasha men karake, he mahabaho ! tuma isa durjeya kamarupa shatru ko maro
verses.english_meaning: Thus, knowing Him who is superior to the intellect and restraining the self by the Self, slay thou, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the enemy in the form of desire, hard to conquer

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्।

विवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam
vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha --- mainne isa avinashi yoga ko vivasvan se kaha ; vivasvan ne manu se kaha; manu ne ikshavaku se kaha
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "I taught this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan; he then told it to Manu; Manu proclaimed it to Ikshvaku

verses.sanskrit:
एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः।

स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara parampara se prapta huye isa yoga ko rajarshiyon ne jana, he parantapa ! vaha yoga bahuta kala se yahan nashtapraya ho gaya
verses.english_meaning: This, handed down in regular succession by the royal sages, was known. This Yoga, however, has been lost here over time, O Parantapa

verses.sanskrit:
स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।

भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha hi yaha puratana yoga aja mainne tumhen kaha kyonki tuma mere bhakta aura mitra ho. yaha uttama rahasya hai
verses.english_meaning: That same ancient yoga has been today taught to you by me, for you are my devotee and my friend; it is the supreme secret

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः।

कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ
katham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- apaka janma apara arthat pashchata ka hai aura vivasvan ka janma purva ka hai, isaliye yaha main kaise janun ki adi men apane kaha tha?
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "Later was Thy birth, and prior to it was the birth of Vivasvan ; how am I to understand that Thou hast taught this Yoga from the beginning?"

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन।

तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna
tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- he arjuna ! mere aura tumhare bahuta se janma ho chuke hain, he parantapa ! una sabako main janata hun aura tuma nahin janate
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "Many births of Mine have passed, as well as of thine, O Arjuna; I know them all, but thou knowest not, O Parantapa ."

verses.sanskrit:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्।

प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया
verses.transliteration:
ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san
prakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadyapi main ajanma aura avinashi svarupa hun aura bhutamatra ka ishvara hun apani prakriti ko apane adhina rakhakara main apani maya se janma leta hun
verses.english_meaning: Though I am unborn and of imperishable nature, and though I am the Lord of all beings, yet, governing my own nature, I am born by my own Maya

verses.sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।

अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! jaba-jaba dharma ki hani aura adharma ki vriddhi hoti hai, taba-taba main svayan ko prakata karata hun
verses.english_meaning: Whenever there is a decline of righteousness and an increase of unrighteousness, O Arjuna, then I manifest Myself

verses.sanskrit:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्।

धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे
verses.transliteration:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśhāya cha duṣhkṛitām
dharma-sansthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sadhu purushon ke rakshana, dushkritya karane valon ke nasha, tatha dharma sansthapana ke liye, main pratyeka yuga men pragata hota hun
verses.english_meaning: For the protection of the good, for the destruction of the wicked, and for the establishment of righteousness, I am born in every age

verses.sanskrit:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन
verses.transliteration:
janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! mera janma aura karma divya hai, isa prakara jo purusha tattavata: janata hai, vaha sharira ko tyagakara phira janma ko nahin prapta hota; vaha mujhe hi prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He who thus knows, in their true light, My divine birth and actions, having abandoned the body, is not born again; he comes to Me, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।

बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः
verses.transliteration:
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśhritāḥ
bahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Raga bhaya aura krodha se rahita manamaya mere sharana hue bahuta se purusha gyaana rupa tapa se pavitra hue mere svarupa ko prapta hue hain
verses.english_meaning: Freed from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in Me, taking refuge in Me, purified by the fire of knowledge, many have attained My Being

verses.sanskrit:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।

मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo mujhe jaise bhajate hain, main una para vaise hi anugraha karata hun; he partha sabhi manushya saba prakara se, mere hi marga ka anuvartana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: In whatever way men approach Me, even so do I reward them; My path do men tread in all ways, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।

क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा
verses.transliteration:
kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yahan karmon ke phala ko chahate huye devataon ko pujate hain; kyonki manushya loka men karmon ke phala shighra hi prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who long for success in action in this world sacrifice to the gods; for success is quickly attained by men through action

verses.sanskrit:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः।

तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
chātur-varṇyaṁ mayā sṛiṣhṭaṁ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśhaḥ
tasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Guna aura karmon ke vibhaga se chaturvanya mere dvara racha gaya hai. yadyapi main usaka karta hun, tathapi tuma mujhe akarta aura avinashi jano
verses.english_meaning: The fourfold caste has been created by Me according to the differentiation of Guna and Karma; though I am the author of it, know Me as non-doer and immutable

verses.sanskrit:
न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।

इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते
verses.transliteration:
na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā
iti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karma mujhe lipta nahin karate; na mujhe karmaphala men spriha hai. isa prakara mujhe jo janata hai, vaha bhi karmon se nahin bandhata hai
verses.english_meaning: Actions do not taint Me, nor do I have a desire for the fruit of actions. He who knows Me thus is not bound by actions

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः।

कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Purva ke mumuksha purushon dvara bhi isa prakara janakara hi karma kiya gaya hai; isaliye tuma bhi purvajon dvara sada se kiye hue karmon ko hi karo
verses.english_meaning: Having known this, the ancient seekers of freedom also performed action; therefore, do thou also perform action, as the ancients did in days of yore

verses.sanskrit:
किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः।

तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ
tat te karma pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karma kya hai aura akarma kya hai? isa vishaya men buddhimana purusha bhi bhramita ho jate hain. isaliye main tumhen karma kahunga, jisako janakara tuma ashubha se mukta ho jaoge
verses.english_meaning: What is action? What is inaction? Even the wise are confused about this. Therefore, I shall teach you the nature of action and inaction, by knowing which you will be liberated from the evil of Samsara, the wheel of birth and death

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः।

अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ
akarmaṇaśh cha boddhavyaṁ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karma ka janana chahiye aura vikarma ka bhi janana chahiye ; tatha akarma ka bhi janana chahiye karma ki gati gahana hai
verses.english_meaning: For verily, the true nature of action enjoined by the scriptures should be known, as well as that of forbidden or unlawful action, and of inaction; the nature of action is hard to understand

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।

स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ
sa buddhimān manuṣhyeṣhu sa yuktaḥ kṛitsna-karma-kṛit
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha karma men akarma aura akarma men karma dekhata hai, vaha manushyon men buddhimana hai, vaha yogi sampurna karmon ko karane vala hai
verses.english_meaning: He who sees inaction in action and action in inaction, he is wise among men; he is a yogi and performer of all actions

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः।

ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः
verses.transliteration:
yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma-saṅkalpa-varjitāḥ
jñānāgni-dagdha-karmāṇaṁ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṁ budhāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisake samasta karya kamana aura sankalpa se rahita hain, aise usa gyaanarupa agni ke dvara bhasma huye karmon vale purusha ko gyaanijana pandita kahate hain
verses.english_meaning: He whose undertakings are all devoid of desires and selfish purposes, and whose actions have been burned by the fire of knowledge, the wise call him a sage

verses.sanskrit:
त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः।

कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः
verses.transliteration:
tyaktvā karma-phalāsaṅgaṁ nitya-tṛipto nirāśhrayaḥ
karmaṇyabhipravṛitto ’pi naiva kiñchit karoti saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha, karmaphalasakti ko tyagakara, nityatripta aura saba ashrayon se rahita hai vaha karma men pravritta hote hue bhi kuchha bhi nahin karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Having abandoned attachment to the fruits of the action, ever content, depending on nothing, he does not do anything even while being engaged in activity

verses.sanskrit:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः।

शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration:
nirāśhīr yata-chittātmā tyakta-sarva-parigrahaḥ
śhārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo asha rahita hai tatha jisane chitta aura atma ko sanyamita kiya hai, jisane saba parigrahon ka tyaga kiya hai, aisa purusha sharirika karma karate hue bhi papa ko nahin prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Without hope, controlling the mind and the self, having abandoned all covetousness, and performing only bodily actions, one incurs no sin

verses.sanskrit:
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः।

समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते
verses.transliteration:
yadṛichchhā-lābha-santuṣhṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau cha kṛitvāpi na nibadhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadrichhaya jo kuchha prapta ho usamen hi santushta rahane vala, dvandavon se atita tatha matsara se rahita, siddhi va asiddhi men samabhava vala purusha karma karake bhi nahin bandhata hai
verses.english_meaning: Content with what comes to him without effort, free from the pairs of opposites and envy, even-minded in success and failure, he acts yet is not bound

verses.sanskrit:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः।

यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते
verses.transliteration:
gata-saṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthita-chetasaḥ
yajñāyācharataḥ karma samagraṁ pravilīyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo asaktirahita aura mukta hai, jisaka chitta gyaana men sthita hai, yagyaa ke liye acharana karane vale aise purusha ke samasta karma lina ho jate hain
verses.english_meaning: To one who is devoid of attachment, who is liberated, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who works for the sake of sacrifice , the whole action is dissolved

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्।

ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना
verses.transliteration:
brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṁ brahma-karma-samādhinā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arpana brahma hai aura havi bhi brahma hai; brahmarupa agni men brahmarupa karta ke dvara jo havana kiya gaya hai, vaha bhi brahma hi hai. isa prakara brahmarupa karma men samadhistha purusha ka gantavya bhi brahma hi hai
verses.english_meaning: Brahman is the oblation; Brahman is the melted butter ; by Brahman is the oblation poured into the fire of Brahman; Brahman indeed shall be attained by one who always sees Brahman in action

verses.sanskrit:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते।

ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति
verses.transliteration:
daivam evāpare yajñaṁ yoginaḥ paryupāsate
brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṁ yajñenaivopajuhvati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Koi yogijana devataon ke pujanarupa yagyaa ko hi karate hain ; aura dusare brahmarupa agni men yagyaa ke dvara yagyaa ko havana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Some yogis perform sacrifice to the gods alone; while others, who have realized the Self, offer the Self as sacrifice in the fire of Brahman alone

verses.sanskrit:
श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति।

शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति
verses.transliteration:
śhrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye sanyamāgniṣhu juhvati
śhabdādīn viṣhayānanya indriyāgniṣhu juhvati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Anya shrotradika saba indariyon ko sanyamarupa agni men havana karate hain, aura anya shabdadika vishayon ko indariyarupa agni men havana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Some again offer the organ of hearing and other senses as a sacrifice in the fire of restraint; others offer sound and other objects of the senses as a sacrifice in the fire of the senses

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे।

आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते
verses.transliteration:
sarvāṇīndriya-karmāṇi prāṇa-karmāṇi chāpare
ātma-sanyama-yogāgnau juhvati jñāna-dīpite
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dusare sampurna indariyon ke tatha pranon ke karmon ko gyaana se prakashita atmasanyamayogarupa agni men havana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Others again sacrifice all the functions of the senses and those of the breath in the fire of the Yoga of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे।

स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः
verses.transliteration:
dravya-yajñās tapo-yajñā yoga-yajñās tathāpare
swādhyāya-jñāna-yajñāśh cha yatayaḥ sanśhita-vratāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kuchha dravyayagyaa, tapayagyaa aura yogayagyaa karane vale hote hain; aura dusare kathina vrata karane vale svadhyaya aura gyaanayagyaa karane vale yogijana hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Others again offer wealth, austerity, and Yoga as sacrifice, while ascetics of self-restraint and rigid vows offer the study of scriptures and knowledge as sacrifice

verses.sanskrit:
अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे।

प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः
verses.transliteration:
apāne juhvati prāṇaṁ prāṇe ’pānaṁ tathāpare
prāṇāpāna-gatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣhu juhvati
sarve ’pyete yajña-vido yajña-kṣhapita-kalmaṣhāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Anya apanavayu men pranavayu ko havana karate hain, tatha prana men apana ki ahuti dete hain, prana aura apana ki gati ko rokakara, ve pranayama ke hi samalakshaya samajhane vale hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath into the incoming, and the incoming into the outgoing, restraining the flow of the outgoing and the incoming breaths, solely absorbed in the restraint of the breath

verses.sanskrit:
अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति।

सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration:
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān  prāṇeṣu juhvati
sarve py 'ete yajña-vido yajña-kṣapita-kalmaṣāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dusare niyamita ahara karane vale pranon ko pranon men havana karate hain. ye sabhi yagyaa ko janane vale hain, jinake papa yagyaa ke dvara nashta ho chuke hain
verses.english_meaning: Others who regulate their diet offer life-breaths in each life-breath. All these are knowers of sacrifice, whose sins are destroyed through sacrifice

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्।

नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतो़ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
yajña-śhiṣhṭāmṛita-bhujo yānti brahma sanātanam
nāyaṁ loko ’styayajñasya kuto ’nyaḥ kuru-sattama
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kurushreshtha ! yagyaa ke avashishta amrita ko bhogane vale purusha sanatana brahma ko prapta hote hain. yagyaa rahita purusha ko yaha loka bhi nahin milata, phira paraloka kaise milega?
verses.english_meaning: Those who eat the remnants of the sacrifice, which are like nectar, go to the eternal Brahman. This world is not for the one who does not perform sacrifice; how then can they have the other, O Arjuna?

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।

कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣhyase
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aise aneka prakara ke yagyaon ka brahma ke mukha arthat vedon men prasara hai arthat varnita hain. una saba ko karmon se utpanna hue jano; isa prakara janakara tuma mukta ho jaoge
verses.english_meaning: Thus, manifold sacrifices are spread out before Brahman at the face of Brahman. Know them all to be born of action, and thus knowing, you shall be liberated

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप।

सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते
verses.transliteration:
śhreyān dravya-mayād yajñāj jñāna-yajñaḥ parantapa
sarvaṁ karmākhilaṁ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He parantapa ! dravyon se sampanna hone vale yagyaa ki apeksha gyaanayagyaa shreshtha hai. he partha ! sampurna akhila karma gyaana men samapta hote hain, arthat gyaana unaki parakashtha hai
verses.english_meaning: Superior is wisdom-sacrifice to the sacrifice with objects, O Parantapa . All actions in their entirety, O Arjuna, culminate in knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया।

उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration:
tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśhnena sevayā
upadekṣhyanti te jñānaṁ jñāninas tattva-darśhinaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa ko sashtanga pranipata, prashna tatha seva karake jano; ye tattavadarshi gyaani purusha tumhen gyaana ka upadesha karenge
verses.english_meaning: Know that the wise who have realized the truth will instruct thee in that knowledge through long prostration, supplication, and service

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव।

येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि
verses.transliteration:
yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava
yena bhūtānyaśheṣheṇa drakṣhyasyātmanyatho mayi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisako janakara tuma puna isa prakara moha ko nahin prapta hoge, aura he pandava ! jisake dvara tuma bhutamatra ko apane atmasvarupa men tatha mujhamen bhi dekhoge
verses.english_meaning: Knowing that thou shalt not, O Arjuna, again be deluded like this; and by that thou shalt see all beings in thyself and also in me

verses.sanskrit:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः।

सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ
sarvaṁ jñāna-plavenaiva vṛijinaṁ santariṣhyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadi tuma saba papiyon se bhi adhika papa karane vale ho, to bhi gyaanarupi nauka dvara, nishchaya hi sampurna papon ka tuma santarana kara jaoge
verses.english_meaning: Even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners, yet thou shalt surely cross over all sins by the raft of knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन।

ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा
verses.transliteration:
yathaidhānsi samiddho ’gnir bhasma-sāt kurute ’rjuna
jñānāgniḥ sarva-karmāṇi bhasma-sāt kurute tathā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise prajjavalita agni indhana ko bhasmasat kara deti hai, vaise hi, he arjuna ! gyaanarupi agni sampurna karmon ko bhasmasat kara deti hai
verses.english_meaning: As the blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ash

verses.sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।

तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति
verses.transliteration:
na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate
tatsvayaṁ yogasansiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa loka men gyaana ke samana pavitra karane vala, nisandeha, kuchha bhi nahin hai. yoga men sansiddha purusha svayan hi use kala men atma men prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Verily, there is no purifier in this world like knowledge. He who is perfected in Yoga finds it within the Self in due time

verses.sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः।

ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
śhraddhāvān labhate jñānaṁ tat-paraḥ sanyatendriyaḥ
jñānaṁ labdhvā parāṁ śhāntim achireṇādhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shraddhavan, tatpara aura jitendariya purusha gyaana prapta karata hai. gyaana ko prapta karake shighra hi vaha parama shanti ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The one who is full of faith, devoted to it, and has subdued their senses obtains this knowledge; and upon obtaining the knowledge, they attain the supreme peace immediately

verses.sanskrit:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति।

नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
ajñaśh chāśhraddadhānaśh cha sanśhayātmā vinaśhyati
nāyaṁ loko ’sti na paro na sukhaṁ sanśhayātmanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Agyaani tatha shraddharahita aura sanshayayukta purusha nashta ho jata hai, sanshayi purusha ke liye na yaha loka hai, na paraloka aura na sukha
verses.english_meaning: The ignorant, the faithless, and the doubting self go to destruction; there is neither this world nor the other, nor happiness for the doubting one

verses.sanskrit:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्।

आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
verses.transliteration:
yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇaṁ jñāna-sañchhinna-sanśhayam
ātmavantaṁ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisane yogadvara karmon ka sannyasa kiya hai, gyaanadvara jisake sanshaya nashta ho gaye hain, aise atmavan purusha ko, he dhananjaya ! karma nahin bandhate hain
verses.english_meaning: He who has renounced actions through Yoga, whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge, and who is self-possessed—such a one is not bound by actions, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः।

छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत
verses.transliteration:
tasmād ajñāna-sambhūtaṁ hṛit-sthaṁ jñānāsinātmanaḥ
chhittvainaṁ sanśhayaṁ yogam ātiṣhṭhottiṣhṭha bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isaliye apane hridaya men sthita agyaana se utpanna atmavishayaka sanshaya ko gyaana khadga se katakara, he bharata ! yoga ka ashraya lekara khadae ho jao
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge , cut asunder the doubt of the self, born of ignorance, residing in your heart, and take refuge in Yoga. Arise, O Arjuna!

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि।

यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्िचतम्
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
sannyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kṛiṣhṇa punar yogaṁ cha śhansasi
yach chhreya etayor ekaṁ tan me brūhi su-niśhchitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha he -- krishna ! apa karmon ke sannyasa ki aura phira yoga ki prashansa karate hain. ina donon men eka jo nishchaya purvaka shreyaskara hai, usako mere lie kahiye
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, you praise renunciation of actions and also yoga. Please tell me conclusively which is better of the two."

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ।

तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
sannyāsaḥ karma-yogaśh cha niḥśhreyasa-karāvubhau
tayos tu karma-sannyāsāt karma-yogo viśhiṣhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- karmasannyasa aura karmayoga ye donon hi parama kalyanakaraka hain; parantu una donon men karmasannyasa se karmayoga shreshtha hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "Renunciation and the Yoga of action both lead to the highest bliss; but of the two, the Yoga of action is superior to the renunciation of action."

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति।

निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati
nirdvandvo hi mahā-bāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramuchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha na kisi se dvesha karata hai aura na kisi ki akanksha, vaha sada sannyasi hi samajhane yogya hai; kyonki, he mahabaho ! dvandavon se rahita purusha sahaja hi bandhana mukta ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: He should be known as a perpetual Sannyasi who neither hates nor desires; for, free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed Arjuna, he is easily freed from bondage

verses.sanskrit:
सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः।

एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्
verses.transliteration:
sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Balaka arthat balabuddhi ke loga sankhya aura yoga ko paraspara bhinna samajhate hain; kisi eka men bhi samyak prakara se sthita hua purusha donon ke phala ko prapta kara leta hai
verses.english_meaning: Children, not the wise, speak of knowledge and the Yoga of action, or the performance of action, as though they are distinct and different; he who is truly established in one, obtains the fruits of both

verses.sanskrit:
यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते।

एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.transliteration:
yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate
ekaṁ sānkhyaṁ cha yogaṁ cha yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sthana gyaaniyon dvara prapta kiya jata hai, usi sthana para karmayogi bhi pahunchate hain. isalie jo purusha sankhya aura yoga ko eka hi dekhata hai, vahi dekhata hai
verses.english_meaning: That place which is reached by the Sankhyas or the Jnanis is also reached by the Yogis . He who sees knowledge and the performance of action as one, sees truly

verses.sanskrit:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः।

योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ
yoga-yukto munir brahma na chireṇādhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu, he mahabaho ! yoga ke bina sannyasa prapta hona kathina hai; yogayukta mananashila purusha paramatma ko shighra hi prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: But, O mighty-armed Arjuna, renunciation is hard to attain without Yoga; the sage who is in harmony with Yoga quickly goes to Brahman

verses.sanskrit:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः।

सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration:
yoga-yukto viśhuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ
sarva-bhūtātma-bhūtātmā kurvann api na lipyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha yogayukta, vishuddha antakarana vala, sharira ko vasha men kiye hue, jitendariya tatha bhutamatra men sthita atma ke satha ekatva anubhava kiye hue hai vaha karma karate hue bhi unase lipta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: He who is devoted to the path of action, whose mind is pure, who has conquered the self, who has subdued his senses, and who realizes his Self as the Self in all beings, though acting, is not tainted

verses.sanskrit:
नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्।

पश्यन् श्रृणवन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपन् श्वसन्
verses.transliteration:
naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit
paśhyañ śhṛiṇvan spṛiśhañjighrann aśhnangachchhan svapañśhvasan
pralapan visṛijan gṛihṇann unmiṣhan nimiṣhann api
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣhu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tattavavit yukta purusha yaha sochega ki "main kinchit matra karma nahin karata hun" dekhata hua, sunata hua, sparsha karata hua, sunghata hua, khata hua, chalata hua, sota hua, shvasa leta hua,
verses.english_meaning: I do nothing at all," thus would the harmonized knower of Truth think, seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, going, sleeping, and breathing

verses.sanskrit:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि।

इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्
verses.transliteration: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bolata hua, tyagata hua, grahana karata hua tatha ankhon ko kholata aura banda karata hua nishchayatmaka rupa se janata hai ki saba indariyan apane-apane vishayon men vicharana kara rahi hain
verses.english_meaning: Speaking, letting go, seizing, opening, and closing the eyes, one should be convinced that the senses move among the sense-objects

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।

लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha saba karma brahma men arpana karake aura asakti ko tyagakara karata hai, vaha purusha kamala ke patte ke sadrisha papa se lipta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: He who does actions, offering them to Brahman and abandoning attachment, is not tainted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not tainted by water

verses.sanskrit:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि।

योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये
verses.transliteration:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṁ tyaktvātma-śhuddhaye
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yogijana, sharira, mana, buddhi aura indariyon dvara asakti ko tyaga kara atmashuddhi ke lie karma karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Yogis, having abandoned attachment, perform actions only through the body, mind, intellect, and even the senses, for the purification of the self

verses.sanskrit:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्।

अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते
verses.transliteration:
yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm
ayuktaḥ kāma-kāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yukta purusha karmaphala ka tyaga karake parama shanti ko prapta hota hai; aura ayukta purusha phala men asakta hua kamana ke dvara bandhata hai
verses.english_meaning: The one who is united having abandoned the fruit of action attains eternal peace; whereas the one who is not united , impelled by desire and attached to the fruit, is bound

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी।

नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्
verses.transliteration:
sarva-karmāṇi manasā sannyasyāste sukhaṁ vaśhī
nava-dvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saba karmon ka mana se sannyasa karake sanyami purusha navadvara vali sharira rupa nagari men sukha se rahata hua na karma karata hai aura na karavata hai
verses.english_meaning: Mentally renouncing all actions and being self-controlled, the embodied one happily rests in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing others to act

verses.sanskrit:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः।

न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ
na karma-phala-saṅyogaṁ svabhāvas tu pravartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Lokamatra ke lie prabhu na kartritva, na karma aura na karmaphala ke sanyoga ko rachata hai. parantu prakriti karati hai
verses.english_meaning: Neither does the Lord create agency nor actions for the world, nor union with the fruits of actions; rather, it is Nature that acts

verses.sanskrit:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।

अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.transliteration:
nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ
ajñānenāvṛitaṁ jñānaṁ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vibhu paramatma na kisi ke papakarma ko aura na punyakarma ko hi grahana karata hai; agyaana se gyaana dhaka hua hai, isase saba jiva mohita hote hain
verses.english_meaning: The Lord takes neither the demerit nor the merit of any; knowledge is enveloped by ignorance, and beings are deluded

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः।

तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्
verses.transliteration:
jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ
teṣhām āditya-vaj jñānaṁ prakāśhayati tat param
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu jinaka vaha agyaana atmagyaana se nashta ho jata hai, unake lie vaha gyaana, surya ke sadrisha, paramatma ko prakashita karata hai
verses.english_meaning: But to those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the Self, like the sun, knowledge reveals the Supreme Brahman

verses.sanskrit:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः।

गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration:
tad-buddhayas tad-ātmānas tan-niṣhṭhās tat-parāyaṇāḥ
gachchhantyapunar-āvṛittiṁ jñāna-nirdhūta-kalmaṣhāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jinaki buddhi usa men sthita hai, jinaka mana tadrupa hua hai, usamen hi jinaki nishtha hai, vaha hi jinaka parama lakshaya hai, gyaana ke dvara paparahita purusha apunaravritti ko prapta hote hain, arthat unaka punarjanma nahin hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Their intellect absorbed in That, their self being That, established in That, with That as their supreme goal, they go whence there is no return, their sins dispelled by knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि।

शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration:
vidyā-vinaya-sampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini
śhuni chaiva śhva-pāke cha paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśhinaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Gyaanijana vidya aura vinaya se sampanna brahmana, tatha gaya, hathi, shvana aura chandala men bhi sama tattava ko dekhate hain
verses.english_meaning: Sages look with an equal eye on a Brahmana endowed with learning and humility, on a cow, an elephant, a dog, and even an outcaste

verses.sanskrit:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः।

निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ
nirdoṣhaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jinaka mana samatvabhava men sthita hai, unake dvara yahin para yaha sarga jita liya jata hai; kyonki brahma nirdosha aura sama hai isaliye ve brahma men hi sthita hain
verses.english_meaning: Even here in this world, those whose minds rest in reality overcome birth; Brahman is indeed spotless and real; therefore they are established in Brahman

verses.sanskrit:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्।

स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam
sthira-buddhir asammūḍho brahma-vid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sthirabuddhi, sanmoharahita brahmavit purusha brahma men sthita hai, vaha priya vastu ko prapta hokara harshita nahin hota aura apriya ko pakara udvigna nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: Resting in Brahman, with a steady intellect and undeluded, the knower of Brahman neither rejoices upon obtaining what is pleasant nor grieves upon obtaining what is unpleasant

verses.sanskrit:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्।

स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते
verses.transliteration:
bāhya-sparśheṣhvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yat sukham
sa brahma-yoga-yuktātmā sukham akṣhayam aśhnute
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bahya vishayon men asaktirahita anta:karana vala purusha atma men hi sukha prapta karata hai; brahma ke dhyana men samahita chitta vala purusha akshaya sukha prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: With the self unattached to external contacts, he finds happiness in the Self; with the self engaged in the meditation of Brahman, he attains endless happiness

verses.sanskrit:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।

आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः
verses.transliteration:
ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣhu ramate budhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya sanyoga se utpanna hone vale jo bhoga hain ve du:kha ke hi hetu hain, kyonki ve adi-anta vale hain. buddhiman purusha unamen nahin ramata
verses.english_meaning: The enjoyments that arise from contact are only sources of pain, for they have a beginning and an end, O Arjuna; the wise do not rejoice in them

verses.sanskrit:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्।

कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः
verses.transliteration:
śhaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṁ prāk śharīra-vimokṣhaṇāt
kāma-krodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo manushya isi loka men sharira tyagane ke purva hi kama aura krodha se utpanna hue vega ko sahana karane men samartha hai, vaha yogi aura sukhi manushya hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is able, while still here in this world, to withstand the impulse born out of desire and anger before the liberation from the body, he is a Yogi, and he is a happy man

verses.sanskrit:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः।

स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
yo 'ntaḥ-sukho 'ntar-ārāmas tathāntar-jyotir eva yaḥ
sa yogī brahma-nirvāṇaṁ brahma-bhūto 'dhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha antaratma men hi sukha vala, atma men hi arama vala tatha atma men hi gyaana vala hai, vaha yogi brahmarupa banakara brahmanirvana arthat parama moksha ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is happy within, who rejoices within, and who is illuminated within, that Yogi attains absolute freedom, or Moksha, becoming Brahman himself

verses.sanskrit:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः।

छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.transliteration:
labhante brahma-nirvāṇam ṛiṣhayaḥ kṣhīṇa-kalmaṣhāḥ
chhinna-dvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ve rishigana moksha ko prapta hote hain - jinake papa nashta ho gaye hain, jo chhinnasanshaya, sanyami aura bhutamatra ke hita men ramane vale hain
verses.english_meaning: The sages obtain absolute freedom or Moksha when their sins have been destroyed, their dualities have been torn asunder, they are self-controlled, and they are intent on the welfare of all beings

verses.sanskrit:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्।

अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration:
kāma-krodha-viyuktānāṁ yatīnāṁ yata-chetasām
abhito brahma-nirvāṇaṁ vartate viditātmanām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kama aura krodha se rahita, sanyatachitta vale tatha atma ko janane vale yatiyon ke lie saba ora moksha vidyamana rahata hai
verses.english_meaning: Absolute freedom exists on all sides for those self-controlled ascetics who are free from desire and anger, who have controlled their thoughts, and who have realized the Self

verses.sanskrit:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।

प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ
verses.transliteration:
sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ
prāṇāpānau samau kṛitvā nāsābhyantara-chāriṇau
yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokṣha-parāyaṇaḥ
vigatechchhā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bahya vishayon ko bahara hi rakhakara netron ki drishti ko bhriakuti ke bicha men sthita karake tatha nasika men vicharane vale prana aura apanavayu ko sama karake,
verses.english_meaning: Shutting out all external contacts and fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, realizing the outgoing and incoming breaths moving within the nostrils

verses.sanskrit:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः।

विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः
verses.transliteration: yatendriya-mano-buddhir  munir   mokṣa-parāyaṇaḥ vigatecchā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā    mukta   eva saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa purusha ki indariyan, mana aura buddhi sanyata hain, aisa moksha parayana muni ichha, bhaya aura krodha se rahita hai, vaha sada mukta hi hai
verses.english_meaning: With the senses, mind, and intellect ever controlled, having liberation as their supreme goal, free from desire, fear, and anger, the sage is truly liberated forever

verses.sanskrit:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।

सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति
verses.transliteration:
bhoktāraṁ yajña-tapasāṁ sarva-loka-maheśhvaram
suhṛidaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ jñātvā māṁ śhāntim ṛichchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mujhe yagyaa aura tapon ka bhokta aura sampurna lokon ka mahan ishvara tatha bhutamatra ka suhrid janakara shanti ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He who knows Me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great Lord of all the worlds, and the friend of all beings, attains peace

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः।

स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
anāśhritaḥ karma-phalaṁ kāryaṁ karma karoti yaḥ
sa sannyāsī cha yogī cha na niragnir na chākriyaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- jo purusha karmaphala para ashrita na hokara kartavya karma karata hai, vaha sannyasi aura yogi hai, na ki vaha jisane kevala agni ka aura kriyayon ka tyaga kiya hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said: He who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruits of his actions—he is a sannyasi and a yogi, not he who is without fire and without action

verses.sanskrit:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।

न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन
verses.transliteration:
yaṁ sannyāsam iti prāhur yogaṁ taṁ viddhi pāṇḍava
na hyasannyasta-saṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaśhchana
verses.hinglish_meaning: He pandava ! jisako sannyasa kahate hain, usi ko tuma yoga samajho; kyonki sankalpon ko na tyagane vala koi bhi purusha yogi nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: Do you, O Arjuna, know that Yoga is what they call renunciation; no one indeed becomes a Yogi who has not renounced their thoughts

verses.sanskrit:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते।

योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
ārurukṣhor muner yogaṁ karma kāraṇam uchyate
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śhamaḥ kāraṇam uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yoga men arudha hone ki ichha vale muni ke lie karma karana hi hetu kaha hai aura yogarudha ho jane para usi purusha ke lie shama ko sadhana kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: For a sage who wishes to attain to Yoga, action is said to be the means; for the same sage who has attained Yoga, inaction is said to be the means

verses.sanskrit:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।

सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते
verses.transliteration:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣhu na karmasv-anuṣhajjate
sarva-saṅkalpa-sannyāsī yogārūḍhas tadochyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba na indariyon ke vishayon men aura na karmon men asakta hota hai taba sarva sankalpon ke sannyasi ko yogarudha kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: When a person is not attached to the sense-objects or to actions, having renounced all thoughts, then they are said to have attained Yoga

verses.sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।

आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Manushya ko apane dvara apana uddhara karana chahiye aura apana adha: patana nahin karana chahiye; kyonki atma hi atma ka mitra hai aura atma hi atma ka shatru hai
verses.english_meaning: One should raise oneself by one's own self alone; let not one lower oneself; for the self alone is one's own friend, and the self alone is one's own enemy

verses.sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।

अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्
verses.transliteration:
bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ
anātmanas tu śhatrutve vartetātmaiva śhatru-vat
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisane atma ko atma ke dvara jita liya hai, usa purusha ka atma usaka mitra hota hai, parantu ajitendariya ke lie atma shatru ke samana sthita hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The Self is the friend of the self of him by whom the Self has been conquered; but to the unconquered self, this Self stands in the position of an enemy, like an external foe

verses.sanskrit:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।

शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः
verses.transliteration:
jitātmanaḥ praśhāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ
śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shita-ushna, sukha-du:kha tatha mana-apamana men jo prashanta rahata hai, aise jitatma purusha ke liye paramatma samyak prakara se sthita hai, arthat, atmarupa se vidyamana hai
verses.english_meaning: The Supreme Self of him who is self-controlled and peaceful remains balanced in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honor and dishonor

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।

युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः
verses.transliteration:
jñāna-vijñāna-tṛiptātmā kūṭa-stho vijitendriyaḥ
yukta ityuchyate yogī sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo yogi gyaana aura vigyaana se tripta hai, jo vikara rahita aura jitendariya hai, jisako mitti, pashana aura kanchana samana hai, vaha yukta kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Yogi who is satisfied with the knowledge and wisdom of the Self, who has conquered the senses, and to whom a clod of earth, a piece of stone, and gold are all the same, is said to have attained Nirvikalpa Samadhi

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।

साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration:
suhṛin-mitrāryudāsīna-madhyastha-dveṣhya-bandhuṣhu
sādhuṣhvapi cha pāpeṣhu sama-buddhir viśhiṣhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha suhrid, mitra, shatru, udasina, madhyastha, dveshi aura bandhavon men tatha dharmatmaon men aura papiyon men bhi samana bhava vala hai, vaha shreshtha hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is of the same mind towards the good-hearted, friends, enemies, the indifferent, the neutral, the hateful, the relatives, the righteous, and the unrighteous, excels

verses.sanskrit:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः।

एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः
verses.transliteration:
yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṁ rahasi sthitaḥ
ekākī yata-chittātmā nirāśhīr aparigrahaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sharira aura mana ko sanyamita kiya hua yogi ekanta sthana para akela rahata hua asha aura parigraha se mukta hokara nirantara mana ko atma men sthira kare
verses.english_meaning: Let the yogi constantly strive to keep the mind steady, remaining in solitude, alone, with the body and mind controlled, and free from hope and greed

verses.sanskrit:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः।

नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
śhuchau deśhe pratiṣhṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ
nātyuchchhritaṁ nāti-nīchaṁ chailājina-kuśhottaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shuddha bhumi men kusha, mrigashala aura usa para vastara rakha ho aise apane asana ko na ati uncha aura na ati nicha sthira sthapita karake.
verses.english_meaning: In a clean spot, having established a firm seat of his own, neither too high nor too low, made of cloth, skin, and kusha grass layered one over the other

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः।

उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये
verses.transliteration:
tatraikāgraṁ manaḥ kṛitvā yata-chittendriya-kriyaḥ
upaviśhyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātma-viśhuddhaye
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vahan mana ko ekagra karake, chitta aura indariyon ki kriyaon ko vasha men kiye huye atmashuddhi ke lie yoga ka abhyasa kare
verses.english_meaning: There, having made the mind one-pointed, with the actions of the mind and senses controlled, let him, seated on the seat, practice Yoga for the purification of the self

verses.sanskrit:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।

संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्
verses.transliteration:
samaṁ kāya-śhiro-grīvaṁ dhārayann achalaṁ sthiraḥ
samprekṣhya nāsikāgraṁ svaṁ diśhaśh chānavalokayan
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kaya, sira aura griva ko samana aura achala dharana kiye hue sthira hokara apani nasika ke agra bhaga ko dekhakara anya dishaon ko na dekhata hua
verses.english_meaning: Let him firmly hold his body, head, and neck erect and still, gazing at the tip of his nose without looking around

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः।

मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
verses.transliteration:
praśhāntātmā vigata-bhīr brahmachāri-vrate sthitaḥ
manaḥ sanyamya mach-chitto yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prashanta anta:karana, nirbhaya aura brahmacharya brata men sthita hokara, mana ko sanyamita karake chitta ko mujhamen lagakara mujhe hi parama lakshaya samajhakara baithana chahie
verses.english_meaning: Serene-minded, fearless, firm in the vow of a Brahmachari, having controlled their mind, thinking of Me and balanced in mind, let them sit, having Me as their supreme goal

verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः।

शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī niyata-mānasaḥ
śhantiṁ nirvāṇa-paramāṁ mat-sansthām adhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara sada mana ko sthira karane ka prayasa karata hua sanyamita mana ka yogi mujhamen sthita parama nirvana svarupa shanti ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Thus, always keeping the mind balanced, the yogi, with the mind controlled, attains the peace abiding in Me, culminating in liberation

verses.sanskrit:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः।

न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन
verses.transliteration:
nātyaśhnatastu yogo ’sti na chaikāntam anaśhnataḥ
na chāti-svapna-śhīlasya jāgrato naiva chārjuna
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu, he arjuna ! yaha yoga usa purusha ke lie sambhava nahin hota, jo adhika khane vala hai ya bilkula na khane vala hai tatha jo adhika sone vala hai ya sada jagane vala hai
verses.english_meaning: Verily, Yoga is not possible for him who eats too much, nor for him who does not eat at all, nor for him who sleeps too much, nor for him who is always awake, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।

युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा
verses.transliteration:
yuktāhāra-vihārasya yukta-cheṣhṭasya karmasu
yukta-svapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa purusha ke lie yoga du:khanashaka hota hai, jo yukta ahara aura vihara karane vala hai, yathayogya cheshta karane vala hai aura parimita shayana aura jagarana karane vala hai
verses.english_meaning: Yoga becomes the destroyer of pain for him who is moderate in eating and recreation , who exercises moderation in action, and who is moderate in sleep and wakefulness

verses.sanskrit:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते।

निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा
verses.transliteration:
yadā viniyataṁ chittam ātmanyevāvatiṣhṭhate
niḥspṛihaḥ sarva-kāmebhyo yukta ityuchyate tadā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vasha men kiya hua chitta jisa kalamen apane svarupamen hi sthita ho jata hai aura svayan sampurna padarthon ni: spriha ho jata hai, usa kalamen vaha yogi kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: When the perfectly controlled mind rests in the Self alone, free from longing for any of the objects of desire, then it is said, 'He is united'

verses.sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।

योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛitā
yogino yata-chittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise spandanarahita vayuke sthanamen sthita dipakaki lau cheshtarahita ho jati hai, yogaka abhyasa karate hue yatachittavale yogike chittaki vaisi hi upama kahi gayi hai
verses.english_meaning: As a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker, so is the Yogi of a controlled mind, who practices Yoga in the Self, compared

verses.sanskrit:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया।

यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति
verses.transliteration:
yatroparamate chittaṁ niruddhaṁ yoga-sevayā
yatra chaivātmanātmānaṁ paśhyann ātmani tuṣhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yogaka sevana karanese jisa avasthamen nirudhda chitta uparama ho jata hai tatha jisa avasthamen svayan apane-apamen apane-apako dekhata hua apane-apamen santushta ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: When the mind, restrained by the practice of yoga, attains quietude, and when one sees the Self by the Self, they are satisfied in their own Self

verses.sanskrit:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्।

वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
sukham ātyantikaṁ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam
vetti yatra na chaivāyaṁ sthitaśh chalati tattvataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sukha atyantika, atindariya aura budhdigrahma hai, usa sukhaka jisa avasthamen anubhava karata hai aura jisa sukhamen sthita hua yaha dhyanayogi phira kabhi tatvase vichalita nahin hota hai
verses.english_meaning: When he feels that infinite bliss which can be grasped by the pure intellect and which transcends the senses, and is established therein, never moving away from the reality

verses.sanskrit:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।

यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते
verses.transliteration:
yaṁ labdhvā chāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ
yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vichālyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa labhaki prapti honepara usase adhika koi dusara labha usake mananemen bhi nahin ata aura jisamen sthita honepara vaha badae bhari du:kha se bhi vichalita nahin hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Having obtained it, he thinks there is no other gain superior to it; established in it, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow

verses.sanskrit:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्।

स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा
verses.transliteration:
taṁ vidyād duḥkha-sanyoga-viyogaṁ yogasaṅjñitam
sa niśhchayena yoktavyo yogo ’nirviṇṇa-chetasā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Du:kha ke sanyoga se viyoga hai, usiko 'yoga' namase janana chahiye. usa dhyanayoka abhyasa na ukataye hue chittase nishchayapurvaka karana chahiye
verses.english_meaning: Let this be known by the name of Yoga, the severance from union with pain. This Yoga should be practiced with determination and with an undespairing mind

verses.sanskrit:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।

मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
saṅkalpa-prabhavān kāmāns tyaktvā sarvān aśheṣhataḥ
manasaivendriya-grāmaṁ viniyamya samantataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sankalpa se utpanna samasta kamanaon ko ni:shesha rupa se parityaga kara mana ke dvara indariya samudaya ko saba ora se samyak prakara vasha men karake
verses.english_meaning: Abandoning unreservedly all desires born of Sankalpa and completely restraining the whole group of senses by the mind from all sides

verses.sanskrit:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया।

आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration:
śhanaiḥ śhanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛiti-gṛihītayā
ātma-sansthaṁ manaḥ kṛitvā na kiñchid api chintayet
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shanai: shanai: dhairyayukta buddhi ke dvara uparamata ko prapta hove; mana ko atma men sthita karake phira anya kuchha bhi chintana na kare
verses.english_meaning: Little by little, let him attain steadiness of the intellect by holding it firmly; having made the mind establish itself in the Self, let him not think of anything else

verses.sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।

ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्
verses.transliteration:
yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram
tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmanyeva vaśhaṁ nayet
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha chanchala aura asthira mana jina karanon se vicharana karata hai, unase sanyamita karake use atma ke hi vasha men lave arthat atma men sthira kare
verses.english_meaning: From whatever cause the restless and unsteady mind wanders away, let him restrain it from that and bring it under the control of the Self alone

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्।

उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्
verses.transliteration:
praśhānta-manasaṁ hyenaṁ yoginaṁ sukham uttamam
upaiti śhānta-rajasaṁ brahma-bhūtam akalmaṣham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisaka mana prashanta hai, jo paparahita hai aura jisaka rajoguna shanta hua hai, aise brahmarupa hue isa yogi ko uttama sukha prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Supreme Bliss indeed comes to this Yogi whose mind is made peaceful, whose passion is quelled, who has become Brahman, and who is free from sin

verses.sanskrit:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।

सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते
verses.transliteration:
yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī vigata-kalmaṣhaḥ
sukhena brahma-sansparśham atyantaṁ sukham aśhnute
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara mana ko sada atma men sthira karane ka yoga karane vala paparahita yogi sukhapurvaka brahmasansparsha ka parama sukha prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: The yogi, always engaging the mind thus , is freed from sins and easily enjoys the infinite bliss of contact with Brahman

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि।

ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः
verses.transliteration:
sarva-bhūta-stham ātmānaṁ sarva-bhūtāni chātmani
īkṣhate yoga-yuktātmā sarvatra sama-darśhanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yogayukta anta:karana vala aura sarvatra samadarshi yogi atma ko saba bhuton men aura bhutamatra ko atma men dekhata hai
verses.english_meaning: With the mind harmonized by Yoga, he sees the Self abiding in all beings and all beings in the Self; he sees the same everywhere

verses.sanskrit:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।

तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration:
yo māṁ paśhyati sarvatra sarvaṁ cha mayi paśhyati
tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśhyāmi sa cha me na praṇaśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha mujhe sarvatra dekhata hai aura sabako mujhamen dekhata hai, usake lie main nashta nahin hota aura vaha mujhase viyukta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: He who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, never becomes separated from Me, nor do I from him

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।

सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
verses.transliteration:
sarva-bhūta-sthitaṁ yo māṁ bhajatyekatvam āsthitaḥ
sarvathā vartamāno ’pi sa yogī mayi vartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha ekatvabhava mane sthita hua sampurna bhuton men sthita mujhe bhajata hai, vaha yogi saba prakara se vartata hua mujhamen sthita rahata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who, being established in unity, worships Me, who dwells in all beings, that yogi abides in Me, whatever their mode of living may be

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन।

सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः
verses.transliteration:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṁ paśhyati yo ’rjuna
sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! jo purusha apane samana sarvatra sama dekhata hai, chahe vaha sukha ho ya du:kha, vaha parama yogi mana gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: He who, through the likeness of the Self, O Arjuna, sees reality everywhere, be it pleasure or pain, is regarded as the highest Yogi

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन।

एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
yo ’yaṁ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana
etasyāhaṁ na paśhyāmi chañchalatvāt sthitiṁ sthirām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he madhusudana ! jo yaha samya yoga apane kaha, main mana ke chanchala hone se isaki chirasthayi sthiti ko nahin dekhata hun
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O Krishna, I do not see how this Yoga of equanimity, which you have taught me, can be maintained steadily, due to the restlessness of the mind."

verses.sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।

तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration:
chañchalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛiṣhṇa pramāthi balavad dṛiḍham
tasyāhaṁ nigrahaṁ manye vāyor iva su-duṣhkaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki he krishna ! yaha mana chanchala aura pramathana svabhava ka tatha balavan aura dridha hai; usaka nigraha karana main vayu ke samana ati dushkara manata hun
verses.english_meaning: The mind is indeed restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding, O Krishna; I consider it as difficult to control as controlling the wind

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं।

अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
asanśhayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ chalam
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa cha gṛihyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan kahate hain -- he mahabaho ! ni:sandeha mana chanchala aura kathinata se vasha men hone vala hai; parantu, he kuntiputra ! use abhyasa aura vairagya ke dvara vasha men kiya ja sakata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "Undoubtedly, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the mind is difficult to control and restless; but with practice and dispassion, it can be restrained."

verses.sanskrit:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।

वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः
verses.transliteration:
asaṅyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ
vaśhyātmanā tu yatatā śhakyo ’vāptum upāyataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Asanyata mana ke purusha dvara yoga prapta hona kathina hai, parantu svadhina mana vale prayatnashila purusha dvara upaya se yoga prapta hona sanbhava hai, yaha mera mata hai
verses.english_meaning: I think Yoga is hard to be attained by one with an uncontrolled self, but the self-controlled and striving one can attain it by the appropriate means

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः।

अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
ayatiḥ śhraddhayopeto yogāch chalita-mānasaḥ
aprāpya yoga-sansiddhiṁ kāṅ gatiṁ kṛiṣhṇa gachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he krishna ! jisaka mana yoga se chalayamana ho gaya hai, aisa apurna prayatna vala shraddhayukta purusha yoga ki siddhi ko na prapta hokara kisa gati ko prapta hota hai?
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "He who is unable to control himself, even though he has faith, and whose mind wanders away from Yoga, what end does he meet, having failed to attain perfection in Yoga, O Krishna?"

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति।

अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि
verses.transliteration:
kachchin nobhaya-vibhraṣhṭaśh chhinnābhram iva naśhyati
apratiṣhṭho mahā-bāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahabaho ! kya vaha brahma ke marga men mohita tatha ashrayarahita purusha chhinna-bhinna megha ke samana donon ora se bhrashta hua nashta to nahin ho jata hai?
verses.english_meaning: Fallen from both, does he not perish like a rent cloud, supportless, O mighty-armed one, deluded on the path of Brahman?

verses.sanskrit:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः।

त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते
verses.transliteration:
etan me sanśhayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa chhettum arhasyaśheṣhataḥ
tvad-anyaḥ sanśhayasyāsya chhettā na hyupapadyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He krishna ! mere isa sanshaya ko ni:shesha rupa se chhedana karane ke lie apa hi yogya hai; kyonki apake atirikta anya koi isa sanshaya ka chhedana karana vala milana sanbhava nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: O Krishna, please completely dispel this doubt of mine, for it is not possible for anyone but You to do so

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।

नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्िचद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśhas tasya vidyate
na hi kalyāṇa-kṛit kaśhchid durgatiṁ tāta gachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- he partha ! usa purusha ka, na to isa loka men aura na hi paraloka men hi nasha hota hai; he tata ! koi bhi shubha karma karane vala durgati ko nahin prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, neither in this world nor in the next will there be destruction for him; none, indeed, who does good, O my son, ever comes to grief."

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।

शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration:
prāpya puṇya-kṛitāṁ lokān uṣhitvā śhāśhvatīḥ samāḥ
śhuchīnāṁ śhrīmatāṁ gehe yoga-bhraṣhṭo’bhijāyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yogabhrashta purusha punyavanon ke lokon ko prapta hokara vahan dirghakala taka vasa karake shuddha acharana vale shrimanta purushon ke ghara men janma leta hai
verses.english_meaning: Having attained to the worlds of the righteous and having dwelt there for everlasting years, he who fell from Yoga is born in a house of the pure and wealthy

verses.sanskrit:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्।

एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्
verses.transliteration:
atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām
etad dhi durlabhataraṁ loke janma yad īdṛiśham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Athava, gyaanavan yogiyon ke hi kula men janma leta hai, parantu isa prakara ka janma isa loka men ni:sandeha ati durlabha hai
verses.english_meaning: Or he is born in a family of even the wisest of yogis; verily, such a birth is very difficult to obtain in this world

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्।

यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
tatra taṁ buddhi-sanyogaṁ labhate paurva-dehikam
yatate cha tato bhūyaḥ sansiddhau kuru-nandana
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kurunandana ! vaha purusha vahan purva deha men prapta kiye gaye gyaana se sampanna hokara yogasansiddhi ke lie usase bhi adhika prayatna karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Then he comes into contact with the knowledge acquired in his former body and strives even more for perfection, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः।

जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśho ’pi saḥ
jijñāsur api yogasya śhabda-brahmātivartate
