verses.hinglish_meaning: Usi purvabhyasa ke karana vaha avasha hua yoga ki ora akarshita hota hai. yoga ka jo kevala jigyaasu hai vaha shabdabrahma ka atikramana karata hai
verses.english_meaning: By that same former practice, he is borne on in spite of himself. Even he who merely wishes to know Yoga goes beyond the Brahmanic word

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः।

अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī sanśhuddha-kilbiṣhaḥ
aneka-janma-sansiddhas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu prayatnapurvaka abhyasa karane vala yogi sampurna papon se shuddha hokara aneka janmon se siddha hota hua, taba parama gati ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: But the Yogi who strives assiduously, purified of sins and perfected gradually over many births, reaches the highest goal

verses.sanskrit:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।

कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन
verses.transliteration:
tapasvibhyo ’dhiko yogī
jñānibhyo ’pi mato ’dhikaḥ
karmibhyaśh chādhiko yogī
tasmād yogī bhavārjuna
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki yogi tapasviyon se shreshtha hai aura gyaana valon se bhi shreshtha mana gaya hai tatha karma karane valon se bhi yogi shreshtha hai, isalie he arjuna tuma yogi bano
verses.english_meaning: The yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics, even superior to those who have knowledge obtained through the study of scriptures; he is also superior to men of action; therefore, be thou a yogi, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।

श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
verses.transliteration:
yoginām api sarveṣhāṁ mad-gatenāntar-ātmanā
śhraddhāvān bhajate yo māṁ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samasta yogiyon men jo bhi shraddhavan yogi mujha men yukta huye antaratma se manya hai
verses.english_meaning: And among all the Yogis, he who, full of faith and with his inner self merged in Me, worships Me is deemed by Me to be the most devoted

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।

असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
mayyāsakta-manāḥ pārtha yogaṁ yuñjan mad-āśhrayaḥ
asanśhayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tach chhṛiṇu
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! mujhamen asakta hue mana vale tatha madashrita hokara yoga ka abhyasa karate hue jisa prakara tuma mujhe samagrarupa se, bina kisi sanshaya ke, janoge vaha suno
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, hear how you shall, without doubt, know Me fully, with your mind intent on Me, practicing Yoga and taking refuge in Me."

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।

यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते
verses.transliteration:
jñānaṁ te ’haṁ sa-vijñānam idaṁ vakṣhyāmyaśheṣhataḥ
yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo ’nyaj jñātavyam-avaśhiṣhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main tumhare lie vigyaana sahita isa gyaana ko ashesha rupa se kahunga jisako janakara yahan phira aura kuchha janane yogya shesha nahin raha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: I will declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization, after knowing which nothing else remains to be known here

verses.sanskrit:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्िचद्यतति सिद्धये।

यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्िचन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
manuṣhyāṇāṁ sahasreṣhu kaśhchid yatati siddhaye
yatatām api siddhānāṁ kaśhchin māṁ vetti tattvataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sahasron manushyon men koi hi manushya purnatva ki siddhi ke lie prayatna karata hai aura una prayatnashila sadhakon men bhi koi hi purusha mujhe tattava se janata hai
verses.english_meaning: Among thousands of men, one may perchance strive for perfection; even among those successful strivers, only one may perchance know Me in essence

verses.sanskrit:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।

अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा
verses.transliteration:
bhūmir-āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva cha
ahankāra itīyaṁ me bhinnā prakṛitir aṣhṭadhā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prithvi, jala, agni, vayu aura akasha tatha mana, buddhi aura ahankara - yaha atha prakara se vibhakta hui meri prakriti hai
verses.english_meaning: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and egoism—thus is My Nature divided eightfold

verses.sanskrit:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।

जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
verses.transliteration:
apareyam itas tvanyāṁ prakṛitiṁ viddhi me parām
jīva-bhūtāṁ mahā-bāho yayedaṁ dhāryate jagat
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahabaho ! yaha apara prakriti hai. isase bhinna meri jivarupi paraprakriti ko jano, jisase yaha jagat dharana kiya jata hai
verses.english_meaning: O mighty-armed Arjuna, this is the inferior Prakriti; know it as distinct from My higher Prakriti, the very life-element, by which this world is upheld

verses.sanskrit:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।

अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
etad-yonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya
ahaṁ kṛitsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha jano ki samampurna bhuta ina donon prakritiyon se utpatti vale hain. main sampurna jagat ka utpatti tatha pralaya sthana hun
verses.english_meaning: Know that these two are the womb of all beings; thus, I am the source and dissolution of the whole universe

verses.sanskrit:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।

मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.transliteration:
mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñchid asti dhanañjaya
mayi sarvam idaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dhananjaya ! mujhase shreshtha anya kichinmatra vastu nahin hai. yaha sampurna jagat sutra men maniyon ke sadrisha mujhamen piroya hua hai
verses.english_meaning: There is nothing higher than Me, O Arjuna. All this is strung on Me, like clusters of gems on a string

verses.sanskrit:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।

प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
verses.transliteration:
raso ’ham apsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śhaśhi-sūryayoḥ
praṇavaḥ sarva-vedeṣhu śhabdaḥ khe pauruṣhaṁ nṛiṣhu
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! jala men main rasa hun, chandarama aura surya men prakasha hun, saba vedon men pranava hun tatha akasha men shabda aura purushon men purushatva hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the flavor in water, O Arjuna; I am the light in the moon and the sun; I am the syllable Om in all the Vedas, sound in the ether and virility in men

verses.sanskrit:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।

जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु
verses.transliteration:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛithivyāṁ cha tejaśh chāsmi vibhāvasau
jīvanaṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu tapaśh chāsmi tapasviṣhu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prithvi men pavitra gandha hun aura agni men teja hun; sampurna bhuton men jivana hun aura tapasviyon men main tapa hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire, the life in all beings, and I am the austerity of ascetics

verses.sanskrit:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।

बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्
verses.transliteration:
bījaṁ māṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! sampurna bhuton ka sanatana bija mujhe hi jano; main buddhimanon ki buddhi aura tejasviyon ka teja hun
verses.english_meaning: Know Me, O Arjuna, as the eternal seed of all beings; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, and the splendour of the splendid objects

verses.sanskrit:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।

धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
balaṁ balavatāṁ chāhaṁ kāma-rāga-vivarjitam
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣhu kāmo ’smi bharatarṣhabha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata shreshtha ! main balavanon ka kamana tatha asakti se rahita bala hun aura saba bhuton men dharma ke aviruddha arthat anukula kama hun
verses.english_meaning: Of the strong, I am the strength devoid of desire and attachment, and in all beings, I am the desire in accordance with Dharma, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।

मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि
verses.transliteration:
ye chaiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāśh cha ye
matta eveti tān viddhi na tvahaṁ teṣhu te mayi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo bhi sattavika , rajasika aura tamasika bhava hain, una sabako tuma mere se utpanna hue jano; tathapi main unamen nahin hun, ve mujhamen hain
verses.english_meaning: Whatever beings that are pure, active, and inert, know that they proceed from Me. They are in Me, yet I am not in them

verses.sanskrit:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।

मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṁ jagat
mohitaṁ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ param avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Trigunon se utpanna ina bhavon se sampurna jagat mohita hua ina se pare avyaya svarupa mujhe nahin janata hai
verses.english_meaning: Deluded by these Natures, composed of the three qualities of Nature, all this world does not know Me as distinct from them and immutable

verses.sanskrit:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।

मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
verses.transliteration:
daivī hyeṣhā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha daivi trigunamayi meri maya badai dustara hai. parantu jo meri sharana men ate hain, ve isa maya ko para kara jate hain
verses.english_meaning: Verily, this divine illusion of Mine, composed of the three qualities, is difficult to cross over; those who take refuge in Me alone, can cross over this illusion

verses.sanskrit:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।

माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration:
na māṁ duṣhkṛitino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
māyayāpahṛita-jñānā āsuraṁ bhāvam āśhritāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dushkritya karane vale, mudha, naradhama purusha mujhe nahin bhajate hain; maya ke dvara jinaka gyaana hara liya gaya hai, ve asuri bhava ko dharana kiye rahate hain
verses.english_meaning: The evil-doers and the deluded, who are the lowest of men, do not seek Me; those whose knowledge is destroyed by illusion follow the ways of demons

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।

आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
chatur-vidhā bhajante māṁ janāḥ sukṛitino ’rjuna
ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī cha bharatarṣhabha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata shreshtha arjuna ! uttama karma karane vale arta, jigyaasu, artharthi aura gyaani aise chara prakara ke loga mujhe bhajate hain
verses.english_meaning: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna, and they are the distressed, the seekers of knowledge, the seekers of wealth, and the wise, O Lord of the Bharatas

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्ितर्विशिष्यते।

प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
verses.transliteration:
teṣhāṁ jñānī nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir viśhiṣhyate
priyo hi jñānino ’tyartham ahaṁ sa cha mama priyaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Unamen bhi mujha se nityayukta, ananya bhakti vala gyaani shreshtha hai, kyonki gyaani ko main atyanta priya hun aura vaha mujhe atyanta priya hai
verses.english_meaning: Of them, the wise who are ever steadfast and devoted to the One, excel; for I am exceedingly dear to the wise, and they are dear to Me

verses.sanskrit:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।

आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ye saba utkrishta hain, parantu gyaani to mera svarupa hi hai aisa mera mata hai, kyonki vaha sthira buddhi gyaani ati uttama gatisvarupa mujhamen achhi prakara sthita hai
verses.english_meaning: Indeed, all these are noble; however, I consider the wise man as My very Self; for, he is steadfast in mind and established in Me alone as the supreme goal

verses.sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।

वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः
verses.transliteration:
bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bahuta janmon ke anta men gyaana ko prapta hokara ki 'yaha saba vasudeva hai' gyaani bhakta mujhe prapta hota hai; aisa mahatma ati durlabha hai
verses.english_meaning: At the end of many births, the wise man comes to Me, realizing that all this is Vaasudeva ; such a great soul is very hard to find

verses.sanskrit:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।

तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
verses.transliteration:
kāmais tais tair hṛita-jñānāḥ prapadyante ’nya-devatāḥ
taṁ taṁ niyamam āsthāya prakṛityā niyatāḥ svayā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhogavishesha ki kamana se jinaka gyaana hara liya gaya hai, aise purusha apane svabhava se prerita hue anya devataon ko vishishta niyama ka palana karate hue bhajate hain
verses.english_meaning: Those whose wisdom has been taken away by this or that desire, go to other gods, following this or that rite, led by their own nature

verses.sanskrit:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।

तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati
tasya tasyāchalāṁ śhraddhāṁ tām eva vidadhāmyaham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo-jo bhakta jisa-jisa rupa ko shraddha se pujana chahata hai, usa-usa ki main usa hi devata ke prati shraddha ko sthira karata hun
verses.english_meaning: Whatever form any devotee desires to worship with faith, I make that same faith of his firm and unflinching

verses.sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।

लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्
verses.transliteration:
sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate
labhate cha tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha usa shraddha se yukta hokara usa devata ka pujana karata hai aura usase mere dvara vidhana kiye huye ichhita bhogon ko ni:sandeha prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Endowed with that faith, he engages in the worship of that form and obtains his desired outcome, which is ordained by Me alone

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।

देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि
verses.transliteration:
antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām
devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu una alpa buddhi purushon ka vaha phala nashavan hota hai. devataon ke pujaka devataon ko prapta hote hain aura mere bhakta mujhe hi prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Verily, the reward that accrues to those men of small intelligence is finite. The worshippers of the gods go to them, whereas My devotees come to Me

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्ितमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।

परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mamāvyayam anuttamam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Buddhihina purusha mere anuttama avyaya parama bhava ko na janate hue mujha avyakta ko vyakta manate hain
verses.english_meaning: The foolish think of Me, the Unmanifest, as having manifestation, not knowing My higher, immutable, and most excellent nature

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।

मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
nāhaṁ prakāśhaḥ sarvasya yoga-māyā-samāvṛitaḥ
mūḍho ’yaṁ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apani yogamaya se avritta main sabako pratyaksha nahin hota hun. yaha mohita loka mujha janmarahita, avinashi ko nahin janata hai
verses.english_meaning: I am not manifest to all, veiled as I am by the Yoga-Maya. This deluded world does not know Me, who am unborn and imperishable

verses.sanskrit:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।

भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
verses.transliteration:
vedāhaṁ samatītāni vartamānāni chārjuna
bhaviṣhyāṇi cha bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaśhchana
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! purva men vyatita hue aura vartamana men sthita tatha bhavishya men hone vale bhutamatra ko main janata hun, parantu mujhe koi bhi purusha nahin janata hain
verses.english_meaning: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the past, the present, and the future; however, no one knows Me

verses.sanskrit:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।

सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप
verses.transliteration:
ichchhā-dveṣha-samutthena dvandva-mohena bhārata
sarva-bhūtāni sammohaṁ sarge yānti parantapa
verses.hinglish_meaning: He parantapa bharata ! ichha aura dvesha se utpanna dvandavamoha se bhutamatra utpatti kala men hi sanmoha ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: O Bharata, all beings are subject to delusion at birth due to the delusion of the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion, O Parantapa

verses.sanskrit:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्।

ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः
verses.transliteration:
yeṣhāṁ tvanta-gataṁ pāpaṁ janānāṁ puṇya-karmaṇām
te dvandva-moha-nirmuktā bhajante māṁ dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu jina punyakarmi purushon ka papa nashta ho gaya hai, ve dvandavamoha se nirmukta aura dridhavati purusha mujhe bhajate hain
verses.english_meaning: But those men of virtuous deeds, whose sins have come to an end and who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship Me steadfastly, with their vows

verses.sanskrit:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।

ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
verses.transliteration:
jarā-maraṇa-mokṣhāya mām āśhritya yatanti ye
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛitsnam adhyātmaṁ karma chākhilam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo mere sharanagata hokara jara aura marana se mukti pane ke lie yatna karate hain, ve purusha usa brahma ko, sampurna adhyatma ko aura sampurna karma ko janate hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who strive for liberation from old age and death, taking refuge in Me, realize in full that Brahman, the whole knowledge of the Self, and all action

verses.sanskrit:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।

प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः
verses.transliteration:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ cha ye viduḥ
prayāṇa-kāle ’pi cha māṁ te vidur yukta-chetasaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha adhibhuta aura adhidaiva tatha adhiyagyaa ke sahita mujhe janate hain, ve yuktachitta vale purusha antakala men bhi mujhe janate hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who know Me with the Adhibhuta , Adhidaiva , and the Adhiyajna know Me even at the time of death, remaining steadfast in mind

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम।

अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
kiṁ tad brahma kim adhyātmaṁ kiṁ karma puruṣhottama
adhibhūtaṁ cha kiṁ proktam adhidaivaṁ kim uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -he purushottama ! vaha brahma kya hai adhyatma kya hai? tatha karma kya hai? aura adhibhuta nama se kya kaha gaya hai? tatha adhidaiva nama se kya kaha jata hai,
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "What is Brahman? What is Adhyatma? What is action, O best among men? What is Adhibhuta declared to be? And, what is Adhidaiva said to be?"

verses.sanskrit:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन।

प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṁ ko ’tra dehe ’smin madhusūdana
prayāṇa-kāle cha kathaṁ jñeyo ’si niyatātmabhiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura he madhusudana ! yahan adhiyagyaa kauna hai? aura vaha isa sharira men kaise hai? aura sanyata chitta vale purushon dvara anta samaya men apa kisa prakara jane jate hain,
verses.english_meaning: Who and how is Adhiyajna here in this body, O destroyer of Madhu? And how, at the time of death, are You to be known by the self-controlled?

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते।

भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
akṣharaṁ brahma paramaṁ svabhāvo ’dhyātmam uchyate
bhūta-bhāvodbhava-karo visargaḥ karma-sanjñitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- parama akshara tattava brahma hai; svabhava adhyatma kaha jata hai; bhuton ke bhavon ko utpanna karane vala visarga karma nama se jana jata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "Brahman is the Imperishable, the Supreme; its essential nature is called Self-knowledge; the offering that causes the existence and manifestation of beings and sustains them is called action."

verses.sanskrit:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्।

अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर
verses.transliteration:
adhibhūtaṁ kṣharo bhāvaḥ puruṣhaśh chādhidaivatam
adhiyajño ’ham evātra dehe deha-bhṛitāṁ vara
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dehadhariyon men shreshtha arjuna ! nashvara vastu adhibhuta aura purusha adhidaiva hai; isa sharira men main hi adhiyagyaa hun
verses.english_meaning: Adhibhuta—knowledge of the elements—pertains to My perishable nature, and the Purusha, or the Soul, is the Adhidaiva; I alone am the Adhiyajna here in this body, O best among the embodied

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्।

यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
anta-kāle cha mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṁ yāti nāstyatra sanśhayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura jo koi purusha antakala men mujhe hi smarana karata hua sharira ko tyaga kara jata hai, vaha mere svarupa ko prapta hota hai, isamen kuchha bhi sanshaya nahin
verses.english_meaning: And whoever, leaving their body, goes forth remembering Me alone at the time of death, they will attain My Being; there is no doubt about this

verses.sanskrit:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।

तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः
verses.transliteration:
yaṁ yaṁ vāpi smaran bhāvaṁ tyajatyante kalevaram
taṁ tam evaiti kaunteya sadā tad-bhāva-bhāvitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! antakala men jisa kisi bhi bhava ko smarana karata hua sharira ko tyagata hai, vaha sadaiva usa bhava ke chintana ke phalasvarupa usi bhava ko hi prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Whoever at the end leaves the body, thinking of any being, to that being only does he go, O son of Kunti , due to his constant thought of that being

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च।

मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu mām anusmara yudhya cha
mayyarpita-mano-buddhir mām evaiṣhyasyasanśhayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isalie, tuma saba kala men mera nirantara smarana karo; aura yuddha karo mujhamen arpana kiye mana, buddhi se yukta hue nihsandeha tuma mujhe hi prapta hooge
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, at all times, remember Me only and fight. With your mind and intellect fixed on Me, you will undoubtedly come to Me alone

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना।

परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration:
abhyāsa-yoga-yuktena chetasā nānya-gāminā
paramaṁ puruṣhaṁ divyaṁ yāti pārthānuchintayan
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! abhyasayoga se yukta anyatra na jane vale chitta se nirantara chintana karata hua parama divya purusha ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: With the mind not moving towards any other thing, made steadfast through the practice of habitual meditation, and constantly meditating, one goes to the Supreme Person, the Resplendent, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार

मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः।

सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप

मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्
verses.transliteration:
kaviṁ purāṇam anuśhāsitāram
aṇor aṇīyānsam anusmared yaḥ
sarvasya dhātāram achintya-rūpam
āditya-varṇaṁ tamasaḥ parastāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha sarvagyaa, prachina , sabake niyanta, sukshama se bhi sukshamatara, saba ke dhata, achintayarupa, surya ke samana prakasha rupa aura andhakara se pare tattava ka anusmarana karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Whosoever meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, the Ruler of the whole world, minuter than an atom, the supporter of all, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun and beyond the darkness of ignorance

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन

भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव।

भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्

स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्
verses.transliteration:
prayāṇa-kāle manasāchalena
bhaktyā yukto yoga-balena chaiva
bhruvor madhye prāṇam āveśhya samyak
sa taṁ paraṁ puruṣham upaiti divyam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha antakala men yogabala se prana ko bhrakuti ke madhya samyak prakara sthapana karake nishchala mana se bhakti yukta hokara usa parama divya purusha ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: At the time of death, with an unwavering mind, endowed with devotion, by the power of Yoga, fixing the whole life-breath in the middle of the two eyebrows, he reaches that resplendent Supreme Person

verses.sanskrit:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति

विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।

यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति

तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये
verses.transliteration:
yad akṣharaṁ veda-vido vadanti
viśhanti yad yatayo vīta-rāgāḥ
yad ichchhanto brahmacharyaṁ charanti
tat te padaṁ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣhye
verses.hinglish_meaning: Veda ke janane vale vidvana jise akshara kahate hain; ragarahita yatnashila purusha jisamen pravesha karate hain; jisaki ichha se brahmacharya ka palana karate hain - usa pada ko main tumhen sankshepa men kahunga
verses.english_meaning: That which is declared to be Imperishable by those who know the Vedas, that which the self-controlled and passion-free enter, that goal, desiring which celibacy is practised, I will declare to thee in brief

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च।

मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्
verses.transliteration:
sarva-dvārāṇi sanyamya mano hṛidi nirudhya cha
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇam āsthito yoga-dhāraṇām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saba dvaron ko sanyamita kara mana ko hridaya men sthira karake aura prana ko mastaka men sthapita karake yogadharana men sthita hua
verses.english_meaning: Having closed all the gates, confined the mind in the heart, and fixed the life-breath in the head, engage in the practice of concentration

verses.sanskrit:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्।

यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
oṁ ityekākṣharaṁ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran
yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṁ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha om isa eka akshara brahma ka uchcharana karata hua aura mera smarana karata hua sharira ka tyaga karata hai, vaha parama gati ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Uttering the one-syllabled Om, the Brahman, and remembering Me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains the Supreme Goal

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।

तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration:
ananya-chetāḥ satataṁ yo māṁ smarati nityaśhaḥ
tasyāhaṁ sulabhaḥ pārtha nitya-yuktasya yoginaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jo ananyachitta vala purusha mera smarana karata hai, usa nityayukta yogi ke lie main sulabha hun arthat sahaja hi prapta ho jata hun
verses.english_meaning: I am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast yogi who constantly and daily remembers me for a long time, not thinking of anything else with a single-minded or one-pointed focus, O Partha

verses.sanskrit:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्।

नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः
verses.transliteration:
mām upetya punar janma duḥkhālayam aśhāśhvatam
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ sansiddhiṁ paramāṁ gatāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parama siddhi ko prapta huye mahatmajana mujhe prapta kara anitya duhkha ke alayarupa punarjanma ko nahin prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Having attained Me, these great souls do not take birth again here—a place of pain and impermanence—but have reached the highest perfection of liberation

verses.sanskrit:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन।

मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
ā-brahma-bhuvanāl lokāḥ punar āvartino ’rjuna
mām upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! brahma loka taka ke saba loga punaravarti svabhava vale hain. parantu, he kaunteya ! mujhe prapta hone para punarjanma nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: All the worlds, including the world of Brahma, are subject to return again, O Arjuna; but he who reaches Me, O son of Kunti, has no rebirth

verses.sanskrit:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः।

रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration:
sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaṇo viduḥ
rātriṁ yuga-sahasrāntāṁ te ’ho-rātra-vido janāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo loga brahma ji ke eka dina ki avadhi janate hain jo ki sahasra varsha ki hai tatha eka sahasra varsha ki avadhi ki eka ratri ko janate hain ve dina aura ratri ko janane vale purusha hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who know the day of Brahma, which lasts a thousand Yugas, and the night, which also lasts a thousand Yugas, know day and night

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे।

रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके
verses.transliteration:
avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyahar-āgame
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyakta-sanjñake
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dina ka udaya hone para avyakta se vyakta utpanna hota hai; aura ratri ke agamana para usi avyakta men lina ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: From the Unmanifested, all the manifested worlds proceed upon the arrival of the 'day'; upon the arrival of the 'night', they dissolve indeed into that which is known as the Unmanifested

verses.sanskrit:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।

रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे
verses.transliteration:
bhūta-grāmaḥ sa evāyaṁ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
rātryāgame ’vaśhaḥ pārtha prabhavatyahar-āgame
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! vahi yaha bhutasamudaya, hai jo punah punah utpanna hokara lina hota hai. avasha hua ratri ke agamana para lina tatha dina ke udaya hone para vyakta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: This same multitude of beings, being born again and again, helplessly dissolves, O Arjuna, into the Unmanifested at the coming of the night and comes forth at the coming of the day

verses.sanskrit:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः।

यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
verses.transliteration:
paras tasmāt tu bhāvo ’nyo ’vyakto ’vyaktāt sanātanaḥ
yaḥ sa sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu naśhyatsu na vinaśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu usa avyakta se pare anya jo sanatana avyakta bhava hai, vaha samasta bhuton ke nashta hone para bhi nashta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: But verily, there exists higher than this Unmanifested, another Unmanifested Eternal, which is not destroyed even when all beings are destroyed

verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्।

यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.transliteration:
avyakto ’kṣhara ityuktas tam āhuḥ paramāṁ gatim
yaṁ prāpya na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo avyakta akshara kaha gaya hai, vahi parama gati hai. jise prapta hokara punah nahin lautate, vaha mera parama dhama hai
verses.english_meaning: What is known as the Unmanifested and the Imperishable, That is said to be the highest goal. Those who reach It do not return . That is My supreme abode

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।

यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration:
puruṣhaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tvananyayā
yasyāntaḥ-sthāni bhūtāni yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jisa ke antargata samasta bhuta hain aura jisase yaha sampurna vyapta hai, vaha parama purusha ananya bhakti se hi prapta karane yogya hai
verses.english_meaning: That highest Purusha, O Arjuna, is attainable by unswerving devotion to Him alone, within Whom all beings dwell and by Whom all this is pervaded

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः।

प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛittim āvṛittiṁ chaiva yoginaḥ
prayātā yānti taṁ kālaṁ vakṣhyāmi bharatarṣhabha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharatashreshtha ! jisa kala men sharira tyaga kara gaye hue yogijana apunaravritti ko, aura punaravritti ko prapta hote hain, vaha kala main tumhen bataunga
verses.english_meaning: Now I will tell you, O chief of the Bharatas, the times of departure at which the Yogis will return or not return

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्।

तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration:
agnir jyotir ahaḥ śhuklaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā uttarāyaṇam
tatra prayātā gachchhanti brahma brahma-vido janāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo brahmavid sadhakajana maranoparanta agni, jyoti, dina, shuklapaksha aura uttarayana ke chhah masa vale marga se jate hain, ve brahma ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path of the sun departing, then men who know Brahman go to Brahman

verses.sanskrit:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।

तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
dhūmo rātris tathā kṛiṣhṇaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā dakṣhiṇāyanam
tatra chāndramasaṁ jyotir yogī prāpya nivartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dhuma, ratri, krishnapaksha aura dakshinayana ke chhah masa vale marga se chandarama ki jyoti ko prapta kara, yogi lautata hai
verses.english_meaning: Attaining the lunar light through smoke, night time, the dark fortnight, and the six months of the southern path of the sun , the yogi returns

verses.sanskrit:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।

एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः
verses.transliteration:
śhukla-kṛiṣhṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śhāśhvate mate
ekayā yātyanāvṛittim anyayāvartate punaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jagat ke ye do prakara ke shukla aura krishna marga sanatana mane gaye hain. inamen eka ke dvara apunaravritti ko tatha anya ke dvara punaravritti ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The bright and dark paths of the world are thought to be eternal; one leads to no return, and the other leads to return

verses.sanskrit:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।

तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन
verses.transliteration:
naite sṛitī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaśhchana
tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu yoga-yukto bhavārjuna
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ina do margon ko janane vala koi bhi yogi mohita nahin hota. isalie, he arjuna ! tuma saba kala men yogayukta bano
verses.english_meaning: Knowing these paths, O Arjuna, no yogi is deluded; therefore, at all times, be steadfast in yoga

verses.sanskrit:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव

दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्।

अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा

योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्
verses.transliteration:
vedeṣhu yajñeṣhu tapaḥsu chaiva
dāneṣhu yat puṇya-phalaṁ pradiṣhṭam
atyeti tat sarvam idaṁ viditvā
yogī paraṁ sthānam upaiti chādyam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yogi purusha yaha saba janakara vedadhyayana, yagyaa, tapa aura dana karane men jo punya phala kaha gaya hai, usa sabaka ullanghana kara jata hai aura adya , parama sthana ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Whatever fruit of merit is declared to accrue from the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities, and gifts, beyond all this goes the Yogi, having known this; and he attains to the Supreme, Primeval Abode

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।

ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
idaṁ tu te guhyatamaṁ pravakṣhyāmyanasūyave
jñānaṁ vijñāna-sahitaṁ yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- tuma anasuyu ke lie main isa guhyatama gyaana ko vigyaana ke sahita kahunga, jisako janakara tuma ashubha se mukta ho jaoge
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "I shall now declare to thee, who does not cavil, the greatest secret—the knowledge combined with experience . Having known this, thou shalt be free from evil."

verses.sanskrit:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।

प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
rāja-vidyā rāja-guhyaṁ pavitram idam uttamam
pratyakṣhāvagamaṁ dharmyaṁ su-sukhaṁ kartum avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha gyaana rajavidya aura rajaguhya evan pavitra, uttama, pratyaksha gyaanavala aura dharmayukta hai, tatha karane men sarala aura avyaya hai
verses.english_meaning: This is the royal science, the royal secret, the supreme purifier, realizable by direct intuitive knowledge, according to righteousness, very easy to perform and imperishable

verses.sanskrit:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।

अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि
verses.transliteration:
aśhraddadhānāḥ puruṣhā dharmasyāsya parantapa
aprāpya māṁ nivartante mṛityu-samsāra-vartmani
verses.hinglish_meaning: He parantapa ! isa dharma men shraddharahita purusha mujhe prapta na hokara mrityurupi sansara men rahate hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who have no faith in this Dharma, O Parantapa, return to the path of this world without attaining Me

verses.sanskrit:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।

मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
mayā tatam idaṁ sarvaṁ jagad avyakta-mūrtinā
mat-sthāni sarva-bhūtāni na chāhaṁ teṣhvavasthitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha sampurna jagat mujha ke avyakta svarupa se vyapta hai; bhutamatra mujhamen sthita hai, parantu main unamen sthita nahin hun
verses.english_meaning: All of this world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest aspect; all beings exist within Me, but I do not dwell within them

verses.sanskrit:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।

भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः
verses.transliteration:
na cha mat-sthāni bhūtāni paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
bhūta-bhṛin na cha bhūta-stho mamātmā bhūta-bhāvanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura bhutamatra mujha men sthita nahin hai; mere ishvariya yoga ko dekho ki bhuton ko dharana karane vali aura bhuton ko utpanna karane vali meri atma una bhuton men sthita nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: Nor do beings exist in Me ; behold, My divine Yoga, which supports all beings, but does not dwell in them, is My Self, the efficient cause of beings

verses.sanskrit:
यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।

तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय
verses.transliteration:
yathākāśha-sthito nityaṁ vāyuḥ sarvatra-go mahān
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mat-sthānītyupadhāraya
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise sarvatra vicharana karane vali mahan vayu sada akasha men sthita rahati hain, vaise hi sampurna bhuta mujhamen sthita hain, aisa tuma jano
verses.english_meaning: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in the ether, so too, know that all beings rest in Me

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।

कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
sarva-bhūtāni kaunteya prakṛitiṁ yānti māmikām
kalpa-kṣhaye punas tāni kalpādau visṛijāmyaham
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! kalpa ke anta men samasta bhuta meri prakriti ko prapta hote hain; aura kalpa ke prarambha men unako main phira rachata hun
verses.english_meaning: All beings, O Arjuna, go into My Nature at the end of a Kalpa; I send them forth again at the beginning of the next Kalpa

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः।

भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्
verses.transliteration:
prakṛitiṁ svām avaṣhṭabhya visṛijāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūta-grāmam imaṁ kṛitsnam avaśhaṁ prakṛiter vaśhāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prakriti ko apane vasha men karake svabhava ke vasha se paratantara hue isa sampurna bhuta samudaya ko main puna:-puna: rachata hun
verses.english_meaning: Animating My Nature, I again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless under the force of Nature

verses.sanskrit:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।

उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु
verses.transliteration:
na cha māṁ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
udāsīna-vad āsīnam asaktaṁ teṣhu karmasu
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dhananjaya ! una karmon men asakti rahita aura udasina ke samana sthita mujha ko ve karma nahin bandhate hain
verses.english_meaning: These acts do not bind Me, O Arjuna, sitting as one indifferent, unattached to those acts

verses.sanskrit:
मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्।

हेतुनाऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
mayādhyakṣheṇa prakṛitiḥ sūyate sa-charācharam
hetunānena kaunteya jagad viparivartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! mujha adhyaksha ke karana prakriti charachara jagat ko utpanna karati hai; isa karana yaha jagat ghumata rahata hai
verses.english_meaning: Under Me, as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; therefore, O Arjuna, the world revolves

verses.sanskrit:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्।

परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣhīṁ tanum āśhritam
paraṁ bhāvam ajānanto mama bhūta-maheśhvaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samasta bhuton ke mahan ishvara rupa mere parama bhava ko nahin janate hue mudha loga manushya shariradhari mujha paramatma ka anadara karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Fools disregard Me, clad in human form, not knowing My higher Being as the great Lord of all beings

verses.sanskrit:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः।

राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः
verses.transliteration:
moghāśhā mogha-karmāṇo mogha-jñānā vichetasaḥ
rākṣhasīm āsurīṁ chaiva prakṛitiṁ mohinīṁ śhritāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vritha asha, vritha karma aura vritha gyaana vale avicharijana rakshason ke aura asuron ke mohita karane vale svabhava ko dharana kiye rahate hain
verses.english_meaning: They are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings, filled with vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that is senseless

verses.sanskrit:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।

भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ
bhajantyananya-manaso jñātvā bhūtādim avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! parantu daivi prakriti ke ashrita mahatma purusha mujhe samasta bhuton ka adikarana aura avyayasvarupa janakara ananyamana se yukta hokara mujhe bhajate hain
verses.english_meaning: But the great souls, O Arjuna, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single-minded devotion, knowing Me as the imperishable source of all beings

verses.sanskrit:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।

नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
verses.transliteration:
satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
namasyantaśh cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya-yuktā upāsate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Satata mera kirtana karate hue, prayatnashila, dadhavrati purusha mujhe namaskara karate hue, nityayukta hokara bhaktipurvaka meri upasana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Always glorifying Me, striving, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with steadfast devotion

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।

एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.transliteration:
jñāna-yajñena chāpyanye yajanto mām upāsate
ekatvena pṛithaktvena bahudhā viśhvato-mukham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Koi mujhe gyaanayagyaa ke dvara pujana karate hue ekatvabhava se upasate hain, koi prithaka bhava se, koi bahuta prakara se mujha virata svarupa ko upasate hain
verses.english_meaning: Others also, sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice, worship Me, the All-Faced, as one, distinct, and manifold

verses.sanskrit:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम्।

मंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham
mantro ’ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṁ hutam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main rikratu hun; main yagyaa hun; svadha aura aushadha main hun, main mantara hun, ghi hun, main agni hun aura hutan arthat havana karma main hun
verses.english_meaning: I am Kratu; I am Yajna; I am the offering to the manes; I am the medicinal herbs and all plants; I am the Mantra; I am also the ghee or melted butter; I am the fire; I am the oblation

verses.sanskrit:
पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।

वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च
verses.transliteration:
pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṁ pavitram oṁkāra ṛik sāma yajur eva cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main hi isa jagat ka pita, mata, dhata aura pitamaha hunmain vedya vastu hun, pavitra, onkara, rigveda, samaveda aura yajurveda bhi main hi hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions, and the grandfather; the one thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable , and also the Rik, Sama, and Yajur Vedas

verses.sanskrit:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।

प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṁ nidhānaṁ bījam avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Gati , bharana-poshana karane vala, prabhu , sakshi, nivasa, sharanasthana tatha mitra aura utpatti, pralayarupa tatha sthana , nidhana aura avyaya karana bhi main hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house, and the imperishable seed

verses.sanskrit:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।

अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन
verses.transliteration:
tapāmyaham ahaṁ varṣhaṁ nigṛihṇāmyutsṛijāmi cha
amṛitaṁ chaiva mṛityuśh cha sad asach chāham arjuna
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! main hi tapata hun; main varsha ka nigraha aura utsarjana karata hun. main hi amrita aura mrityu evan sat aura asat hun
verses.english_meaning: As the sun, I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा

यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।

ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक

मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्
verses.transliteration:
trai-vidyā māṁ soma-pāḥ pūta-pāpā
yajñair iṣhṭvā svar-gatiṁ prārthayante
te puṇyam āsādya surendra-lokam
aśhnanti divyān divi deva-bhogān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tinon vedon ke gyaata , somapana karane vale evan papon se pavitra hue purusha mujhe yagyaon ke dvara pujakara svarga prapti chahate hain; ve purusha apane punyon ke phalarupa indaraloka ko prapta kara svarga men divya devataon ke bhoga bhogate hain
verses.english_meaning: The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of all sins, worshipping Me through sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of the gods and enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods in heaven

verses.sanskrit:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं

क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।

एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना

गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते
verses.transliteration:
te taṁ bhuktvā swarga-lokaṁ viśhālaṁ
kṣhīṇe puṇye martya-lokaṁ viśhanti
evaṁ trayī-dharmam anuprapannā
gatāgataṁ kāma-kāmā labhante
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ve usa vishala svargaloka ko bhogakara, punyakshina hone para, mrityuloka ko prapta hote hain. isa prakara tinon vedon men kahe gaye karma ke sharana hue aura bhogon ki kamana vale purusha avagamana ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: They, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three and desiring objects of desires, they attain to the state of coming and going

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।

तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣhāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣhemaṁ vahāmyaham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ananya bhava se mera chintana karate hue jo bhaktajana meri hi upasana karate hain, una nityayukta purushon ka yogakshema main vahana karata hun
verses.english_meaning: For those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no one else, for those ever-united, I secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess

verses.sanskrit:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।

तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration:
ye ’pyanya-devatā-bhaktā yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
te ’pi mām eva kaunteya yajantyavidhi-pūrvakam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! shraddha se yukta jo bhakta anya devataon ko pujate hain, ve bhi mujhe hi avidhipurvaka pujate hain
verses.english_meaning: Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, but by the wrong method

verses.sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।

न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha
na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaśh chyavanti te
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki saba yagyaon ka bhokta aura svami main hi hun, parantu ve mujhe tattavata: nahin janate hain, isalie ve girate hain, arthat sansara ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: For I alone am the enjoyer and Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality, and thus they return to this mortal world

verses.sanskrit:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृ़न्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।

भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
verses.transliteration:
yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti mad-yājino ’pi mām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Devataon ke pujaka devataon ko prapta hote hain, pitarapujaka pitaron ko jate hain, bhuton ka yajana karane vale bhuton ko prapta hote hain aura mujhe pujane vale bhakta mujhe hi prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: The worshippers of the gods go to them; the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes; the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them; but My devotees come to Me

verses.sanskrit:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।

तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati
tadahaṁ bhaktyupahṛitam aśhnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo koi bhi bhakta mere lie patra, pushpa, phala, jala adi bhakti se arpana karata hai, usa shuddha mana ke bhakta ka vaha bhaktipurvaka arpana kiya hua main bhogata hun arthat svikara karata hun
verses.english_meaning: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or a little water, that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, I accept

verses.sanskrit:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।

यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्
verses.transliteration:
yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat
yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣhva mad-arpaṇam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! tuma jo kuchha karma karate ho, jo kuchha khate ho, jo kuchha havana karate ho, jo kuchha dana dete ho aura jo kuchha tapa karate ho, vaha saba tuma mujhe arpana karo
verses.english_meaning: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do it as an offering to Me

verses.sanskrit:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः।

संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
śhubhāśhubha-phalair evaṁ mokṣhyase karma-bandhanaiḥ
sannyāsa-yoga-yuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣhyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara tuma shubhashubha phalasvarupa karmabandhanon se mukta ho jaoge; aura sannyasayoga se yuktachitta hue tuma vimukta hokara mujhe hi prapta ho jaoge
verses.english_meaning: Thus, you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, you shall come to Me

verses.sanskrit:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।

ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣhu chāpyaham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main samasta bhuton men sama hun; na koi mujhe apriya hai aura na priya; parantu jo mujhe bhaktipurvaka bhajate hain, ve mujhamen aura main bhi unamen hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the same to all beings; there is none hateful or dear to Me; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me, and I am also in them

verses.sanskrit:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।

साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
verses.transliteration:
api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk
sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadi koi atishaya durachari bhi ananyabhava se mera bhakta hokara mujhe bhajata hai, vaha sadhu hi manane yogya hai, kyonki vaha yathartha nishchaya vala hai
verses.english_meaning: Even if the most sinful worships Me, with devotion to no one else, he should indeed be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।

कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration:
kṣhipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā śhaśhvach-chhāntiṁ nigachchhati
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya, vaha shighra hi dharmatma bana jata hai aura shashvata shanti ko prapta hota hai. tuma nishchayapurvaka satya jano ki mera bhakta kabhi nashta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: Soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace; O Arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that My devotee never perishes

verses.sanskrit:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।

स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
striyo vaiśhyās tathā śhūdrās te ’pi yānti parāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! stari, vaishya aura shudra ye jo koi papayoni vale hon, ve bhi mujha para ashrita hokara parama gati ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: For, taking refuge in Me, they who, O Arjuna, may be of a sinful birth—women, Vaisyas, and Sudras—attain the Supreme Goal

verses.sanskrit:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।

अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā
anityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Phira kya kahana hai ki punyashila brahmana aura rajarshi bhaktajana ; isa anitya aura sukharahita loka ko prapta hokara tuma bhaktipurvaka meri hi puja karo
verses.english_meaning: How much more easily, then, do Brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal? Having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship Me

verses.sanskrit:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।

मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः
verses.transliteration:
man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
mām evaiṣhyasi yuktvaivam ātmānaṁ mat-parāyaṇaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mujhamen sthira mana vale bano; mere bhakta aura mere pujana karane vale bano; mujhe namaskara karo; isa prakara matparayana hokara atma ko mujhase yukta karake tuma mujhe hi prapta hooge
verses.english_meaning: Fix your mind on Me; be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; bow down to Me; having thus united your whole self to Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।

यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
bhūya eva mahā-bāho śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
yatte ’haṁ prīyamāṇāya vakṣhyāmi hita-kāmyayā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- he mahabaho ! puna: tuma mere parama vachanon ka shravana karo, jo main tujha atishaya prema rakhane vale ke liye hita ki ichha se kahunga
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to my supreme word which I will declare to you, who are beloved, for your welfare

verses.sanskrit:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।

अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣhayaḥ
aham ādir hi devānāṁ maharṣhīṇāṁ cha sarvaśhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Meri utpatti ko na devatagana janate hain aura na maharshijana; kyonki main saba prakara se devataon aura maharshiyon ka bhi adikarana hun
verses.english_meaning: Neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know My origin; for I am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way

verses.sanskrit:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।

असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
yo māmajam anādiṁ cha vetti loka-maheśhvaram
asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣhu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramuchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo mujhe ajanma, anadi aura lokon ke mahan ishvara ke rupa men janata hai, rmatya manushyon men aisa sanmoharahita purusha saba papon se mukta ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who knows Me as unborn and beginningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।

सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
verses.transliteration:
buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣhamā satyaṁ damaḥ śhamaḥ
sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo ’bhāvo bhayaṁ chābhayameva cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Buddhi, gyaana, moha ka abhava, kshama, satya, dama , shama , sukha, du:kha, janma aura mrityu, bhaya aura abhaya
verses.english_meaning: Intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, existence or birth, non-existence or death, fear, and also fearlessness

verses.sanskrit:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।

भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
verses.transliteration: ahiṁsā   samatā  tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ   yaśo    'yaśaḥ  bhavanti    bhāvā   bhūtānāṁ    matta   eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ahinsa, samata, santosha, tapa, dana. yasha aura apayasha aise ye praniyon ke nanavidha bhava mujha se hi prakata hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and ill-fame—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone

verses.sanskrit:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।

मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration:
maharṣhayaḥ sapta pūrve chatvāro manavas tathā
mad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣhāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sata maharshijana, purvakala ke chara tatha manu ye mere prabhava vale mere sankalpa se utpanna hue hain, jinaki sansara men yaha praja hai
verses.english_meaning: The seven great sages, the ancient four, and the Manus, possessing powers like Mine , were born from My mind; from them, these creatures have been born in this world

verses.sanskrit:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ cha mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
so ’vikampena yogena yujyate nātra sanśhayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha isa meri vibhuti aura yoga ko tattava se janata hai, vaha purusha avikampa yoga se yukta ho jata hai, isamen kuchha bhi sanshaya nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: He who truly knows these manifold manifestations of My Being and this Yoga-power of Mine, becomes established in unshakable Yoga; there is no doubt about it

verses.sanskrit:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।

इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main hi sabaka prabhava sthana hun; mujhase hi saba vikasa ko prapta hota hai, isa prakara janakara budhajana bhakti bhava se yukta hokara mujhe hi bhajate hain
verses.english_meaning: I am the source of all; from me everything evolves; Understanding this, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship me

verses.sanskrit:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।

कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
mach-chittā mad-gata-prāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam
kathayantaśh cha māṁ nityaṁ tuṣhyanti cha ramanti cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mujhamen hi chitta ko sthira karane vale aura mujhamen hi pranon ko arpita karane vale bhaktajana, sadaiva paraspara mera bodha karate hue, mere hi vishaya men kathana karate hue santushta hote hain aura ramate hain
verses.english_meaning: With their minds and lives wholly absorbed in Me, they enlighten each other and ever speak of Me, being satisfied and delighted

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।

ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
verses.transliteration:
teṣhāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam
dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ yena mām upayānti te
verses.hinglish_meaning: Una nitya yukta hue aura premapurvaka mera bhajana karane vale bhakton ko, main vaha 'buddhiyoga' deta hun jisase ve mujhe prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: To those who are ever steadfast, worshipping me with love, I give the yoga of discrimination, by which they come to me

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।

नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
verses.transliteration:
teṣhām evānukampārtham aham ajñāna-jaṁ tamaḥ
nāśhayāmyātma-bhāva-stho jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Unake upara anugraha karane ke lie main unake anta:karana men sthita hokara, agyaanajanita andhakara ko prakashamaya gyaana ke dipaka dvara nashta karata hun
verses.english_meaning: Out of mere compassion for them, I, dwelling within their selves, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।

पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
paraṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān
puruṣhaṁ śhāśhvataṁ divyam ādi-devam ajaṁ vibhum
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha apa -parama brahma, parama dhama aura parama pavitra hanai; sanatana divya purusha, devon ke bhi adi deva, janma rahita aura sarvavyapi hain
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, eternal, divine Person, the primeval God, unborn, and omnipresent."

verses.sanskrit:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा।

असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
verses.transliteration:
āhus tvām ṛiṣhayaḥ sarve devarṣhir nāradas tathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ chaiva bravīṣhi me
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aisa apako samasta rishijana kahate hain; vaise hi devarshi narada, asita, devala rishi tatha vyasa aura svayan apa bhi mere prati kahate hain
verses.english_meaning: All the sages have thus declared Thee, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now Thou Thyself dost say so to me

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।

न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
verses.transliteration:
sarvam etad ṛitaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśhava
na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidur devā na dānavāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He keshava ! jo kuchha bhi apa mere prati kahate hain, isa sabako main satya manata hun. he bhagavan, apake svarupa ko na devata janate hain aura na danava
verses.english_meaning: I believe all that You have said to me to be true, O Krishna; indeed, O blessed Lord! Neither the gods nor the demons know Your manifestation

verses.sanskrit:
स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।

भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते
verses.transliteration:
swayam evātmanātmānaṁ vettha tvaṁ puruṣhottama
bhūta-bhāvana bhūteśha deva-deva jagat-pate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He purushottama ! he bhutabhavana ! he bhutesha ! he devon ke deva ! he jagat ke svami ! apa svayan hi apane apa ko janate hain
verses.english_meaning: Verily, Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Supreme Person, O source and Lord of all beings, O God of gods, O ruler of the world!

verses.sanskrit:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि
verses.transliteration:
vaktum arhasyaśheṣheṇa divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ
yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṁs tvaṁ vyāpya tiṣhṭhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apa hi una apani divya vibhutiyon ko asheshata: kahane ke lie yogya hain, jina vibhutiyon ke dvara ina samasta lokon ko apa vyapta karake sthita hain
verses.english_meaning: You should indeed tell, without reserve, of your divine glories by which you exist, pervading all these worlds

verses.sanskrit:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।

केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogins tvāṁ sadā parichintayan
keṣhu keṣhu cha bhāveṣhu chintyo ’si bhagavan mayā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He yogeshvara ! main kisa prakara nirantara chintana karata hua apako janun, aura he bhagavan ! apa kinakina bhavon men mere dvara chintana karane yogya hain
verses.english_meaning: How shall I, ever meditating, know you, O Yogin? In what aspects or things, O blessed Lord, should I think of you?

verses.sanskrit:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।

भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
verses.transliteration:
vistareṇātmano yogaṁ vibhūtiṁ cha janārdana
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛiptir hi śhṛiṇvato nāsti me ’mṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He janardana ! apani yoga shakti aura vibhuti ko puna: vistarapurvaka kahie, kyonki apake amritamaya vachanon ko sunate hue mujhe tripti nahin hoti
verses.english_meaning: Tell me again in detail, O Krishna, of your yogic power and glory; for I am not satiated with what I have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे
verses.transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
hanta te kathayiṣhyāmi divyā hyātma-vibhūtayaḥ
prādhānyataḥ kuru-śhreṣhṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -hanta aba main tumhen apani divya vibhutiyon ko pradhanata se kahunga. he kurushreshtha mere vistara ka anta nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "Very well! Now I will declare to you My divine glories in their prominence, O Arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description."

verses.sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।

अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
verses.transliteration:
aham ātmā guḍākeśha sarva-bhūtāśhaya-sthitaḥ
aham ādiśh cha madhyaṁ cha bhūtānām anta eva cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He gudakesha ! main samasta bhuton ke hridaya men sthita sabaki atma hun tatha sampurna bhuton ka adi, madhya aura anta bhi main hi hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।

मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी
verses.transliteration:
ādityānām ahaṁ viṣhṇur jyotiṣhāṁ ravir anśhumān
marīchir marutām asmi nakṣhatrāṇām ahaṁ śhaśhī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main adityon men vishnu aura jyotiyon men anshuman surya hun; main maruton men marichi hun aura nakshatron men shashi hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the twelve Adityas, I am Vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; among the seven or forty-nine Maruts, I am Marichi; among stars, I am the moon

verses.sanskrit:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।

इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना
verses.transliteration:
vedānāṁ sāma-vedo ’smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ
indriyāṇāṁ manaśh chāsmi bhūtānām asmi chetanā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main vedon men samaveda hun, devon men vasava hun; main indariyon men mana aura bhutapraniyon men chetana hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Vasava; among the senses, I am the mind; and among living beings, I am intelligence

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।

वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्
verses.transliteration:
rudrāṇāṁ śhaṅkaraśh chāsmi vitteśho yakṣha-rakṣhasām
vasūnāṁ pāvakaśh chāsmi meruḥ śhikhariṇām aham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main rudron men shankara hun aura yaksha tatha rakshason men dhanapati kubera hun; vasuon men agni hun tatha shikhara vale parvaton men meru hun
verses.english_meaning: And among the Rudras, I am Sankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, the Lord of Wealth ; among the Vasus, I am Pavaka ; and among the seven mountains, I am Meru

verses.sanskrit:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।

सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः
verses.transliteration:
purodhasāṁ cha mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛihaspatim
senānīnām ahaṁ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! purohiton men mujhe brihaspati jano; main senapatiyon men skanda aura jalashayon men samudra hun
verses.english_meaning: And, among the household priests of kings, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among the army generals, I am Skanda; among lakes, I am the ocean

verses.sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।

यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः
verses.transliteration:
maharṣhīṇāṁ bhṛigur ahaṁ girām asmyekam akṣharam
yajñānāṁ japa-yajño ’smi sthāvarāṇāṁ himālayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main maharshiyon men bhriagu aura vani men ekakshara onkara hun. main yagyaon men japayagyaa aura sthavaron men himalaya hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among words, I am the one syllable ; among sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things, I am the Himalayas

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।

गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
aśhvatthaḥ sarva-vṛikṣhāṇāṁ devarṣhīṇāṁ cha nāradaḥ
gandharvāṇāṁ chitrarathaḥ siddhānāṁ kapilo muniḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main samasta vrikshon men ashvattha hun aura devarshiyon men narada hun; main gandharvon men chitraratha aura siddha purushon men kapila muni hun
verses.english_meaning: Among all the trees, I am the Peepul; among the divine sages, I am Narada; among the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; among the perfected, I am the sage Kapila

verses.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।

ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
uchchaiḥśhravasam aśhvānāṁ viddhi mām amṛitodbhavam
airāvataṁ gajendrāṇāṁ narāṇāṁ cha narādhipam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ashvon men amrita se utpanna hue uchchaishrava namaka ashva, hathiyon men airavata aura manushyon men raja mujhe hi jano
verses.english_meaning: Know Me as Ucchaisravas, born of nectar, among horses; Airavata among lordly elephants; and the king among men

verses.sanskrit:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।

प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः
verses.transliteration:
āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk
prajanaśh chāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main shastaron men vajra aura dhenuon men kamadhenu hun, praja utpatti ka hetu kandarpa main hun aura sarpon men vasuki hun
verses.english_meaning: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow called Kamadhenu; I am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents, I am Vasuki

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।

पितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्
verses.transliteration:
anantaśh chāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham
pitṝīṇām aryamā chāsmi yamaḥ sanyamatām aham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main nagon men ananta hun aura jala devataon men varuna hun; main pitaron men aryama han aura niyamana karane valon men yama hun
verses.english_meaning: I am Ananta among the Nagas; I am Varuna among water-deities; Aryaman among the Manes; I am Yama among the governors

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।

मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
prahlādaśh chāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham
mṛigāṇāṁ cha mṛigendro ’haṁ vainateyaśh cha pakṣhiṇām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main daityon men prahlada aura ganana karane valon men kala hun, main 'pashuon' men sinha aura pakshiyon men garuda hun
verses.english_meaning: And I am Prahlada among the demons, I am Time among reckoners, I am the lion among beasts, and Vainateya among birds

verses.sanskrit:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।

झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी
verses.transliteration:
pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śhastra-bhṛitām aham
jhaṣhāṇāṁ makaraśh chāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main pavitra karane valon men vayu hun aura shastaradhariyon men rama hun; tatha matsyon men main magaramachha aura nadiyon men main ganga hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the purifiers, I am the wind; among the warriors, I am Rama; among the fishes, I am the shark; among the streams, I am the Ganga

verses.sanskrit:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।

अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्
verses.transliteration:
sargāṇām ādir antaśh cha madhyaṁ chaivāham arjuna
adhyātma-vidyā vidyānāṁ vādaḥ pravadatām aham
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! srishtiyon ka adi, anta aura madhya bhi main hi hun, main vidyaon men adhyatmavidya aura vivada karane valon men main vada hun
verses.english_meaning: Among creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna; among the sciences, I am the science of the Self; and I am the logic among controversialists

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।

अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः
verses.transliteration:
अहमेवाक्षय: कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुख: || 33||
akṣharāṇām a-kāro ’smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya cha
aham evākṣhayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṁ viśhvato-mukhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main aksharon men akara aura samason men dvandava hun; main akshaya kala aura vishvatomukha dhata hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the letters of the alphabet, I am the letter 'A' and the dual among compounds. I am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time; I am the dispenser of the fruits of actions, having faces in all directions

verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।

कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
verses.transliteration:
mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām
kīrtiḥ śhrīr vāk cha nārīṇāṁ smṛitir medhā dhṛitiḥ kṣhamā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main sarvabhakshaka mrityu aura bhavishya men hone valon ki utpatti ka karana hun; stariyon men kirti, shri, vaka , smriti, medha, dhriti aura kshama hun
verses.english_meaning: And I am the all-devouring Death, and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine qualities, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, firmness, and forgiveness

verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।

मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः
verses.transliteration:
bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham
māsānāṁ mārga-śhīrṣho ’ham ṛitūnāṁ kusumākaraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samon men main brihatsama aura chhandon men gayatri chhanda hun; main mason men margashirsha aura rituon men vasanta hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the hymns, I am the Brihatsaman; among meters, I am Gayatri; among months, I am Margasirsha; among seasons, I am the flowery season

verses.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।

जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्
verses.transliteration:
dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
jayo ’smi vyavasāyo ’smi sattvaṁ sattvavatām aham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main chhala karane valon men dyuta hun aura tejasviyon men teja hun, main vijaya hun; main vyavasaya hun aura satvika purushon ka satvika bhava hun
verses.english_meaning: I am the gambling of the deceitful; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am the resolve of the resolute; I am the goodness of the good

verses.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।

मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः
verses.transliteration:
vṛiṣhṇīnāṁ vāsudevo ’smi pāṇḍavānāṁ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnām apyahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśhanā kaviḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main vrishniyon men vasudeva hun aura pandavon men dhananjaya, main muniyon men vyasa aura kaviyon men ushana kavi hun
verses.english_meaning: Among the Vrishnis, I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; among the sages, I am Vyasa; among the poets, I am Usanas, the poet

verses.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।

मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्
verses.transliteration:
daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām
maunaṁ chaivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main damana karane valon ka danda hun aura vijayechhuon ki niti hun; main guhyon men mauna hun aura gyaanavanon ka gyaana hun
verses.english_meaning: Of those who punish, I am the scepter; among those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; and among secrets, I am silence; I am knowledge among knowers

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।

न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration:
yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna
na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ charācharam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! jo samasta bhuton ki utpatti ka bija hai, vaha bhi men hi hun, kyonki aisa koi chara aura achara bhuta nahin hai, jo mujhase rahita hai
verses.english_meaning: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, be it moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me

verses.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।

एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया
verses.transliteration:
nānto ’sti mama divyānāṁ vibhūtīnāṁ parantapa
eṣha tūddeśhataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He parantapa ! meri divya vibhutiyon ka anta nahin hai; apani vibhutiyon ka yaha vistara mainne eka desha se arthat sankshepa men kaha hai
verses.english_meaning: There is no end to My divine glories, O Arjuna, but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glory

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।

तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्
verses.transliteration:
yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā
tat tad evāvagachchha tvaṁ mama tejo ’nśha-sambhavam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo koi bhi vibhutiyukta, kantiyukta athava shaktiyukta vastu hai, usako tuma mere teja ke ansha se hi utpanna hui jano
verses.english_meaning: Whatever being there is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to be a manifestation of a part of My splendor

verses.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।

विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्
verses.transliteration:
atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣhṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛitsnam ekānśhena sthito jagat
verses.hinglish_meaning: Athava he arjuna ! bahuta janane se tumhara kya prayojana hai? main isa sampurna jagat ko apane eka ansha matra se dharana karake sthita hun
verses.english_meaning: But, of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I exist, supporting this whole world with one part of Myself

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।

यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
mad-anugrahāya paramaṁ guhyam adhyātma-sanjñitam
yat tvayoktaṁ vachas tena moho ’yaṁ vigato mama
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- mujha para anugraha karane ke lie jo parama gopaniya, adhyatmavishayaka vachana apake dvara kaha gaya, usase mera moha dura ho gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, By this explanation of the highest secret concerning the Self which Thou hast spoken, for the sake of blessing me, my delusion has been dispelled

verses.sanskrit:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।

त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śhrutau vistaraśho mayā
tvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣha māhātmyam api chāvyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kamalanayana ! mainne bhuton ki utpatti aura pralaya apase vistarapurvaka sune hain tatha apaka avyaya mahatmaya bhi suna hai
verses.english_meaning: The origin and destruction of beings have been heard in detail from You, O lotus-eyed Lord, and also Your inexhaustible greatness

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर।

द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration:
evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśhvara
draṣhṭum ichchhāmi te rūpam aiśhwaraṁ puruṣhottama
verses.hinglish_meaning: He parameshvara ! apa apane ko jaisa kahate ho, yaha thika aisa hi hai. he purushottama ! main apake ishvariya rupa ko pratyaksha dekhana chahata hun
verses.english_meaning: Now, O Supreme Lord, as Thou hast thus described Thyself, O Supreme Person, I wish to behold Thy divine form

verses.sanskrit:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।

योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्
