verses.transliteration:
manyase yadi tach chhakyaṁ mayā draṣhṭum iti prabho
yogeśhvara tato me tvaṁ darśhayātmānam avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He prabho ! yadi apa manate hain ki mere dvara vaha apaka rupa dekha jana sanbhava hai, to he yogeshvara ! apa apane avyaya rupa ka darshana karaiye
verses.english_meaning: If Thou, O Lord, thinkest it possible for me to see it, do Thou, then, O Lord of the Yogis, show me Thy imperishable Self

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।

नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
paśhya me pārtha rūpāṇi śhataśho ’tha sahasraśhaḥ
nānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛitīni cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- he partha ! mere saikadaon tatha sahasron nana prakara ke aura nana varna tatha akriti vale divya rupon ko dekho
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, forms of Mine, by the hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, divine, and of various colors and shapes."

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्िवनौ मरुतस्तथा।

बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत
verses.transliteration:
paśhyādityān vasūn rudrān aśhvinau marutas tathā
bahūny adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvāṇi paśhyāśhcharyāṇi bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! adityon, vasuon, rudron tatha ashvinikumaron aura marudganon ko dekho, tatha aura bhi aneka isake purva kabhi na dekhe hue ashcharyon ko dekho
verses.english_meaning: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts; behold many wonders never before seen, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।

मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
ihaika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ paśhyādya sa-charācharam
mama dehe guḍākeśha yach chānyad draṣhṭum ichchhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: He gudakesha ! aja isa mere sharira men eka sthana para sthita hue charachara sahita sampurna jagat ko dekho tatha aura bhi jo kuchha tuma dekhana chahate ho, use bhi dekho
verses.english_meaning: Now, behold, O Arjuna, in this My body, the entire universe centered in one, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatever else you desire to see

verses.sanskrit:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।

दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
na tu māṁ śhakyase draṣhṭum anenaiva sva-chakṣhuṣhā
divyaṁ dadāmi te chakṣhuḥ paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu tuma apane inhin netron ke dvara mujhe dekhane men samartha nahin ho; main tumhen divyachakshu deta hun, jisase tuma mere ishvariya 'yoga' ko dekho
verses.english_meaning: But you are not able to behold Me with these your own eyes; I give you the divine eye; behold My lordly Yoga

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः।

दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
evam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśhvaro hariḥ
darśhayām āsa pārthāya paramaṁ rūpam aiśhwaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- he rajan ! mahayogeshvara hari ne isa prakara kahakara phira arjuna ke lie parama aishvaryayukta rupa ko darshaya
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken, O king, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari , showed Arjuna His supreme form as the Lord

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्।

अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्
verses.transliteration:
aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśhanam
aneka-divyābharaṇaṁ divyānekodyatāyudham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa aneka mukha aura netron se yukta tatha aneka adbhuta darshanon vale evan bahuta se divya bhushanon se yukta aura bahuta se divya shastaron ko hathon men uthaye huye
verses.english_meaning: With numerous mouths and eyes, with numerous wondrous sights, with numerous divine adornments, with numerous divine weapons uplifted, such a form He showed

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्।

सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.transliteration:
divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṁ divya-gandhānulepanam
sarvāśhcharya-mayaṁ devam anantaṁ viśhvato-mukham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Divya mala aura vastaron ko dharana kiye huye aura divya gandha ka lepana kiye huye evan samasta prakara ke ashcharyon se yukta ananta, vishvatomukha parama deva
verses.english_meaning: Wearing divine garlands and apparel, anointed with divine unguents, the all-wonderful, resplendent Being is endless with faces on all sides

verses.sanskrit:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता।

यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā
yadi bhāḥ sadṛiśhī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Akasha men sahasra suryon ke eka satha udaya hone se utpanna jo prakasha hoga, vaha usa paramatma ke prakasha ke sadrisha hoga
verses.english_meaning: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out simultaneously in the sky, that would be the splendour of that mighty being

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा।

अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tatraika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ pravibhaktam anekadhā
apaśhyad deva-devasya śharīre pāṇḍavas tadā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Panduputra arjuna ne usa samaya aneka prakara se vibhakta hue sampurna jagat ko devon ke deva shrikrishna ke sharira men eka sthana para sthita dekha
verses.english_meaning: There, in the body of the God of gods, Arjuna then saw the entire universe resting in one, with its myriad of divisions

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः।

प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣhṭo hṛiṣhṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ
praṇamya śhirasā devaṁ kṛitāñjalir abhāṣhata
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usake uparanta vaha ashcharyachakita hua harshita romon vala dhananjaya arjuna vishvarupa deva ko shira se pranama karake hatha jodakara bola
verses.english_meaning: Then, Arjuna, filled with wonder and his hair standing on end, bowed his head to the God and spoke with palms joined

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे

सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।

ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ

मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
paśhyāmi devāns tava deva dehe
sarvāns tathā bhūta-viśheṣha-saṅghān
brahmāṇam īśhaṁ kamalāsana-stham
ṛiṣhīnśh cha sarvān uragānśh cha divyān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he deva! main apake sharira men samasta devon ko tatha aneka bhutavisheshon ke samudayon ko aura kamalasana para sthita srishti ke svami brahmaji ko, rishiyon ko aura divya sarpon ko dekha raha hun
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O God, I see all the gods in Your body, as well as hosts of various classes of beings, Brahma the Lord seated on the lotus, all the sages, and the celestial serpents."

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं

पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्।

नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं

पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप
verses.transliteration:
aneka-bāhūdara-vaktra-netraṁ
paśhyāmi tvāṁ sarvato ’nanta-rūpam
nāntaṁ na madhyaṁ na punas tavādiṁ
paśhyāmi viśhveśhvara viśhva-rūpa
verses.hinglish_meaning: He vishveshvara! main apaki aneka bahu, udara, mukha aura netron se yukta tatha saba ora se ananta rupon vala dekhata hun. he vishvarupa! main apake na anta ko dekhata hun aura na madhya ko aura na adi ko
verses.english_meaning: I see You with boundless form on every side, with many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes; neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do I see, O Lord of the Universe, O Cosmic Form

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च

तेजोराशिं सर्वतोदीप्तिमन्तम्।

पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता

द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्
verses.transliteration:
kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakriṇaṁ cha
tejo-rāśhiṁ sarvato dīptimantam
paśhyāmi tvāṁ durnirīkṣhyaṁ samantād
dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main apaka mukutayukta, gadayukta aura chakradharana kiye huye tatha saba ora se prakashaman teja ka punja, dipta agni aura surya ke samana jyotirmaya, dekhane men ati kathina aura aprameyasvarupa saba ora se dekhata hun
verses.english_meaning: I see You with the diadem, club, and discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, very hard to look at, blazing all around like a burning fire and the sun, and immeasurable

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं

त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।

त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता

सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे
verses.transliteration:
tvam akṣharaṁ paramaṁ veditavyaṁ
tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam
tvam avyayaḥ śhāśhvata-dharma-goptā
sanātanas tvaṁ puruṣho mato me
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apa hi janane yogya parama akshara hain; apa hi isa vishva ke parama ashraya hain ! apa hi shashvata dharma ke rakshaka hain aura apa hi sanatana purusha hain,aisa mera mata hai
verses.english_meaning: You are the Imperishable, the Supreme Being, worthy of being known. You are the great treasure-house of this universe; You are the imperishable protector of the eternal Dharma; You are the Primal Person, I believe

verses.sanskrit:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य

मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्।

पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम्

स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्
verses.transliteration: स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् || 19||
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main apako adi, anta aura madhya se rahita tatha ananta sarmathya se yukta aura ananta bahuon vala tatha chandarasuryarupi netron vala aura dipta agnirupi mukha vala tatha apane teja se isa vishva ko tapate hue dekhata hun
verses.english_meaning: I see You without beginning, middle, or end, infinite in power, with endless arms, the sun and moon as Your eyes, the burning fire Your mouth, heating the entire universe with Your radiance

verses.sanskrit:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि

व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः।

दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं

लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्
verses.transliteration:
dyāv ā-pṛithivyor idam antaraṁ hi
vyāptaṁ tvayaikena diśhaśh cha sarvāḥ
dṛiṣhṭvādbhutaṁ rūpam ugraṁ tavedaṁ
loka-trayaṁ pravyathitaṁ mahātman
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahatman ! svarga aura prithvi ke madhya ka yaha akasha tatha samasta dishaen akele apa se hi vyapta hain; apake isa adbhuta aura ugra rupa ko dekhakara tinon loka ativyatha ko prapta ho rahe hain
verses.english_meaning: This space between the earth and the heavens, and all the quarters, is filled by You alone; having seen this, Your wonderful and terrible form, the three worlds are trembling with fear, O great-souled Being

verses.sanskrit:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्ति

केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति।

स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः

स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः
verses.transliteration:
amī hi tvāṁ sura-saṅghā viśhanti
kechid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛiṇanti
svastīty uktvā maharṣhi-siddha-saṅghāḥ
stuvanti tvāṁ stutibhiḥ puṣhkalābhiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ye samasta devataon ke samuha apa men hi pravesha kara rahe hain aura kai eka bhayabhita hokara hatha jodae hue apa ki stuti karate hain; maharshi aura siddhon ke samudaya 'kalyana hove' aisa kahakara, uttama sroton dvara apaki stuti karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Verily, these hosts of gods enter into Thee; some extol Thee with joined palms in fear, saying, 'May it be well!' Bands of great sages and perfected ones praise Thee with complete hymns

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या

विश्वेऽश्िवनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च।

गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा

वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे
verses.transliteration:
rudrādityā vasavo ye cha sādhyā
viśhve ’śhvinau marutaśh choṣhmapāśh cha
gandharva-yakṣhāsura-siddha-saṅghā
vīkṣhante tvāṁ vismitāśh chaiva sarve
verses.hinglish_meaning: Rudragana, aditya, vasu aura sadhyagana, vishvedeva tatha do ashvinikumara, marudgana aura ushmapa, gandharva, yaksha, asura aura siddhaganon ke samudaya- ye saba hi vismita hote hue apako dekhate hain
verses.english_meaning: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, Visvedevas, the two Asvins, Maruts, the Manus, and the hosts of celestial singers, Yakshas, demons, and the perfected ones, all look upon Thee with great amazement

verses.sanskrit:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं

महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्।

बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं

दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्
verses.transliteration:
rūpaṁ mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraṁ
mahā-bāho bahu-bāhūru-pādam
bahūdaraṁ bahu-danṣhṭrā-karālaṁ
dṛiṣhṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahabaho! apake bahuta mukha tatha netra vale, bahuta bahu, uru tatha pairon vale, bahuta-nnsi udaron vale tatha bahutasi vikarala dadhaon vale mahan rupa ko dekhakara saba loga vyathita ho rahe hain aura usi prakara main bhi
verses.english_meaning: Having seen Your immeasurable form with many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed one, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs and fearsome with many teeth, the worlds are terrified, and so am I

verses.sanskrit:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं

व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्।

दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा

धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो
verses.transliteration:
nabhaḥ-spṛiśhaṁ dīptam aneka-varṇaṁ
vyāttānanaṁ dīpta-viśhāla-netram
dṛiṣhṭvā hi tvāṁ pravyathitāntar-ātmā
dhṛitiṁ na vindāmi śhamaṁ cha viṣhṇo
verses.hinglish_meaning: He vishno! akasha ke satha sparsha kiye hue dedipyamana aneka rupon se yukta tatha vistarita mukha aura prakashamana vishala netron se yukta apako dekhakara bhayabhita hua main dhairya aura shanti ko nahin prapta ho raha hun
verses.english_meaning: On seeing Thee, touching the sky, shining in many colors, with mouths wide open, with large fiery eyes, I am terrified at heart and find neither courage nor peace, O Vishnu

verses.sanskrit:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि

दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि।

दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म

प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
verses.transliteration:
danṣhṭrā-karālāni cha te mukhāni
dṛiṣhṭvaiva kālānala-sannibhāni
diśho na jāne na labhe cha śharma
prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apake vikarala dadhaon vale aura pralayagni ke samana prajvalita mukhon ko dekhakara, main na dishaon ko jana pa raha hun aura na shanti ko prapta ho raha hun; isalie he devesha! he jagannivasa! apa prasanna ho jaie
verses.english_meaning: Having seen Thy mouths fearful with teeth blazing like the fires of cosmic dissolution, I know not the four quarters, nor do I find peace. Have mercy, O Lord of the gods, O abode of the universe

verses.sanskrit:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः

सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः।

भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ

सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः
verses.transliteration:
amī cha tvāṁ dhṛitarāśhtrasya putrāḥ
sarve sahaivāvani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ
bhīṣhmo droṇaḥ sūta-putras tathāsau
sahāsmadīyair api yodha-mukhyaiḥ
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśhanti
danṣhṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni
kechid vilagnā daśhanāntareṣhu
sandṛiśhyante chūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura ye samasta dhritarashtara ke putra rajaon ke samudaya sahita apa men pravesha karate hain. bhishma, drona tatha karna aura hamare paksha ke bhi pradhana yoddhaon ke sahita
verses.english_meaning: All the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of kings of the earth, Bhishma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the chief among our warriors

verses.sanskrit:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति

दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि।

केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु

संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः
verses.transliteration: vaktrāṇi te  tvaramāṇā   viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni    bhayānakāni kecid   vilagnā daśanāntareṣu   sandṛśyante cūrṇitair   uttamāṅgaiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tivra vega se apake vikarala dadhaon vale bhayanaka mukhon men pravesha karate hain aura kai eka churnita shiron sahita apake danton ke bicha men phanse hue dikha rahe hain
verses.english_meaning: Some hurry into Your mouths with their terrible teeth, fearful to behold. Some are found stuck in the gaps between the teeth, their heads crushed to powder

verses.sanskrit:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः

समुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति।

तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा

विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति
verses.transliteration:
yathā nadīnāṁ bahavo ’mbu-vegāḥ
samudram evābhimukhā dravanti
tathā tavāmī nara-loka-vīrā
viśhanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise nadiyon ke bahuta se jalapravaha samudra ki ora vega se bahate hain, vaise hi manushyaloka ke ye vira yoddhagana apake prajvalita mukhon men pravesha karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Verily, just as many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so too these heroes in the world of men enter Thy flaming mouths

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा

विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः।

तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका

स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः
verses.transliteration:
yathā pradīptaṁ jvalanaṁ pataṅgā
viśhanti nāśhāya samṛiddha-vegāḥ
tathaiva nāśhāya viśhanti lokās
tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛiddha-vegāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaise patange apane nasha ke lie prajvalita agni men ativega se pravesha karate hain, vaise hi ye loga bhi apane nasha ke lie apake mukhon men ativega se pravesha karate hain
verses.english_meaning: As moths hurriedly rush into a blazing fire, leading to their own destruction, so too these creatures hurry into Your mouths, leading to their own destruction

verses.sanskrit:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता

ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः।

तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं

भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो
verses.transliteration:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl
lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ
tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṁ
bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣhṇo
verses.hinglish_meaning: He vishno! apa prajvalita mukhon ke dvara ina samasta lokon ka grasana karate hue asvada le rahe hain, apaka ugra prakasha sampurna jagat ko teja ke dvara paripurna karake tapa raha hai
verses.english_meaning: Thou lickest up, devouring all the worlds on every side with Thy flaming mouths. Thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, burn, O Vishnu!

verses.sanskrit:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो

नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद।

विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं

न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्
verses.transliteration:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugra-rūpo
namo ’stu te deva-vara prasīda
vijñātum ichchhāmi bhavantam ādyaṁ
na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛittim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mere prati kahiye, ki ugrarupa vale apa kauna hain? he devon men shreshtha! apako namaskara hai, apa prasanna hoiye. adi svarupa apako main janana chahata hun, kyonki apaki pravritti ko main nahin samajha pa raha hun
verses.english_meaning: Tell me, who you are, so fierce of form. I offer my salutations to you, O God Supreme; have mercy on me. I desire to know you, the original Being. I do not indeed know your workings

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो

लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।

ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे

येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
kālo ’smi loka-kṣhaya-kṛit pravṛiddho
lokān samāhartum iha pravṛittaḥ
ṛite ’pi tvāṁ na bhaviṣhyanti sarve
ye ’vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣhu yodhāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- main lokon ka nasha karane vala pravriddha kala hun. isa samaya, main ina lokon ka sanhara karane men pravritta hun. jo pratipakshiyon ki sena men sthita yoddha hain, ve saba tumhare bina bhi nahin rahenge
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "I am the full-grown, world-destroying Time, now engaged in destroying the worlds. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile armies will live."

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व

जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।

मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव

निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्
verses.transliteration:
tasmāt tvam uttiṣhṭha yaśho labhasva
jitvā śhatrūn bhuṅkṣhva rājyaṁ samṛiddham
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva
nimitta-mātraṁ bhava savya-sāchin
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isalie tuma utha khadae ho jao aura yasha ko prapta karo; shatruon ko jitakara samriddha rajya ko bhogo. ye saba pahale se hi mere dvara mare ja chuke hain. he savyasachin! tuma kevala nimitta hi bano
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, stand up and obtain fame. Conquer the enemies and enjoy the unparalleled kingdom. Verily, by Me they have already been slain; be thou a mere instrument, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च

कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्।

मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा

युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्
verses.transliteration:
droṇaṁ cha bhīṣhmaṁ cha jayadrathaṁ cha
karṇaṁ tathānyān api yodha-vīrān
mayā hatāṁs tvaṁ jahi mā vyathiṣhṭhā
yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Drona, bhishma, jayadratha, karna tatha aura bhi bahuta se mere dvara mare gaye vira yoddhaon ko tuma maro; bhaya mata karo; yuddha karo; tuma yuddha men shatruon ko jitoge
verses.english_meaning: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors have already been slain by Me; do not be distressed with fear; fight and you shall conquer your enemies in battle

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य

कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।

नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं

सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
etach chhrutvā vachanaṁ keśhavasya
kṛitāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī
namaskṛitvā bhūya evāha kṛiṣhṇaṁ
sa-gadgadaṁ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- keshava bhagavan ke isa vachana ko sunakara mukutadhari arjuna hatha jodae hue, kanpata hua namaskara karake puna: bhayabhita hua shrikrishna ke prati gadgad vani se bola
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said, Having heard that speech of Lord Krishna, Arjuna, with joined palms, trembling, prostrated himself, again addressing Krishna in a choked voice, bowing down, overwhelmed with fear

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या

जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च।

रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति

सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
sthāne hṛiṣhīkeśha tava prakīrtyā
jagat prahṛiṣhyaty anurajyate cha
rakṣhānsi bhītāni diśho dravanti
sarve namasyanti cha siddha-saṅghāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- yaha yogya hi hai ki apake kirtana se jagat ati harshita hota hai aura anuraga ko bhi prapta hota hai. bhayabhita rakshasa loga samasta dishaon men bhagate hain aura samasta siddhaganon ke samudaya apako namaskara karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "It is fitting, O Krishna, that the world delights and rejoices in Your praise; demons fly in fear in all directions and the hosts of the perfected ones bow to You."

verses.sanskrit:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्

गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे।

अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास

त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्
verses.transliteration:
kasmāch cha te na nameran mahātman
garīyase brahmaṇo ’py ādi-kartre
ananta deveśha jagan-nivāsa
tvam akṣharaṁ sad-asat tat paraṁ yat
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahatman ! brahma ke bhi adi karta aura sabase shreshtha apake lie ve kaise namaskara nahin karen? he ananta! he devesha! he jagannivasa! jo sat asat aura ina donon se pare aksharatattava hai, vaha apa hi hain
verses.english_meaning: And why should they not, O great Soul, bow to Thee Who art greater than all else, the primal cause even of the Creator , O Infinite Being, O Lord of the gods, O Abode of the universe; Thou art the imperishable, the Being, the non-being, and That which is supreme—that which is beyond the Being and the non-being

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण

स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।

वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम

त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप
verses.transliteration:
tvam ādi-devaḥ puruṣhaḥ purāṇas
tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam
vettāsi vedyaṁ cha paraṁ cha dhāma
tvayā tataṁ viśhvam ananta-rūpa
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apa adideva aura purana purusha hain. apa isa jagat ke parama ashraya, gyaata, gyaeya, aura parama dhama hain. he anantarupa apase hi yaha vishva vyapta hai
verses.english_meaning: You are the primal God, the ancient Purusha, the supreme refuge of this universe, the knower, the knowable, and the supreme Abode. Through You, the universe is pervaded, O Being of infinite forms

verses.sanskrit:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः

प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च।

नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः

पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते
verses.transliteration:
vāyur yamo ’gnir varuṇaḥ śhaśhāṅkaḥ
prajāpatis tvaṁ prapitāmahaśh cha
namo namas te ’stu sahasra-kṛitvaḥ
punaśh cha bhūyo ’pi namo namas te
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apa vayu, yama, agni, varuna, chandarama, prajapati aura prapitamaha hain; apake lie sahasra bara namaskara, namaskara hai, puna: apako barambara namaskara, namaskara hai
verses.english_meaning: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the moon, the Creator, and the great-grandfather. I offer my salutations to You a thousand times, and again I offer my salutations to You

verses.sanskrit:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते

नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व।

अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं

सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः
verses.transliteration:
namaḥ purastād atha pṛiṣhṭhatas te
namo ’stu te sarvata eva sarva
ananta-vīryāmita-vikramas tvaṁ
sarvaṁ samāpnoṣhi tato ’si sarvaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He anantasarmathya vale bhagavan! apake lie agrata: aura prishthata: namaskara hai, he sarvatman! apako saba ora se namaskara hai. apa amita vikramashali hain aura apa sabako vyapta kiye hue hain, isase apa sarvarupa hain
verses.english_meaning: Salutations to You in front and behind! Salutations to You on every side! O All! You, infinite in power and prowess, pervade all; therefore You are all

verses.sanskrit:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं

हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।

अजानता महिमानं तवेदं

मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि
verses.transliteration:
sakheti matvā prasabhaṁ yad uktaṁ
he kṛiṣhṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṁ tavedaṁ
mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bhagavan! apako sakha manakara apaki isa mahima ko na janate hue mere dvara pramada se athava prema se bhi "he krishna he! yadava he sakhe!" isa prakara jo kuchha balat kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: Whatever I have presumptuously said from carelessness or love, addressing You as O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend! regarding You merely as a friend, unknowing of Your greatness

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि

विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु।

एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं

तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्
verses.transliteration:
yach chāvahāsārtham asat-kṛito ’si
vihāra-śhayyāsana-bhojaneṣhu
eko ’tha vāpy achyuta tat-samakṣhaṁ
tat kṣhāmaye tvām aham aprameyam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura, he achyuta! jo apa mere dvara hansi ke liye bihara, shayya, asana aura bhojana ke samaya akele men athava anyon ke samaksha bhi apamanita kiye gaye hain, una saba ke lie aprameya svarupa apa se main kshamayachana karata hun
verses.english_meaning: In whatever way I may have insulted You for the sake of fun, while at play, reposing, sitting, or at meals, when alone , O Krishna, or in company, that I implore You, immeasurable one, to forgive

verses.sanskrit:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य

त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्।

न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो

लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव
verses.transliteration:
pitāsi lokasya charācharasya
tvam asya pūjyaśh cha gurur garīyān
na tvat-samo ’sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto ’nyo
loka-traye ’py apratima-prabhāva
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apa isa charachara jagat ke pita, pujaniya aura sarvashreshtha guru hain. he apritama prabhava vale bhagavan! tinon lokon men apake samana bhi koi nahin hain, to phira apase adhika shreshtha kaise hoga?
verses.english_meaning: Thou art the Father of this world, both moving and unmoving. Thou art to be adored by this world; Thou, the greatest Guru; for none exists who is equal to Thee; how then could there be another superior to Thee in the three worlds, O Being of unrivaled power?

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं

प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्।

पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः

प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṁ
prasādaye tvām aham īśham īḍyam
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ
priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isaliye he bhagavan! main sharira ke dvara sashtanga pranipata karake stuti ke yogya apa ishvara ko prasanna hone ke liye prarthana karata hun. he deva! jaise pita putra ke, mitra apane mitra ke aura priya apani priya ke, vaise hi apa bhi mere aparadhon ko kshama kijiye
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, I crave Thy forgiveness, O adorable Lord. As a father forgives his son, a friend his dear friend, a lover his beloved, even so may Thou forgive me, O God

verses.sanskrit:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा

भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे।

तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं

प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
verses.transliteration:
adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvaṁ hṛiṣhito ’smi dṛiṣhṭvā
bhayena cha pravyathitaṁ mano me
tad eva me darśhaya deva rūpaṁ
prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main apake isa adrishtapurva rupa ko dekhakara harshita ho raha hun aura mera mana bhaya se ativyakula bhi ho raha hain. isalie he deva! apa usa purvakala ko hi mujhe dikhaiye. he devesha! he jagannivasa! apa prasanna hoiye
verses.english_meaning: I am delighted, having seen something never seen before; yet my mind is distressed with fear. Show me that form only, O God; have mercy, O God of gods, O Abode of the universe

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त

मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव।

तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन

सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते
verses.transliteration:
kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakra-hastam
ichchhāmi tvāṁ draṣhṭum ahaṁ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa chatur-bhujena
sahasra-bāho bhava viśhva-mūrte
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main apako usi prakara mukutadhari, gada aura chakra hatha men lie hue dekhana chahata hun. he vishvamurte! he sahasrabaho! apa usa chaturbhujarupa ke hi bana jaie
verses.english_meaning: I desire to see You as before, crowned, bearing a mace, with the discus in hand, in Your former form only, having four arms, O thousand-armed, Cosmic Being

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं

रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्।

तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं

यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṁ
rūpaṁ paraṁ darśhitam ātma-yogāt
tejo-mayaṁ viśhvam anantam ādyaṁ
yan me tvad anyena na dṛiṣhṭa-pūrvam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna! tuma para prasanna hokara mainne apani yogashakti ke prabhava se yaha apana parama tejomaya, sabaka adi aura ananta vishvarupa tujhe darshaya hai, jise tumhare purva kisi ne nahin dekha hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this Cosmic Form has graciously been shown to you by Me through My own Yogic power. It is full of splendour, primeval, and infinite; this Cosmic Form of Mine has never been seen before by anyone other than you."

verses.sanskrit:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै

र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः।

एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके

द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर
verses.transliteration:
na veda-yajñādhyayanair na dānair
na cha kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ
evaṁ-rūpaḥ śhakya ahaṁ nṛi-loke
draṣhṭuṁ tvad anyena kuru-pravīra
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kurupravira! tumhare atirikta isa manushya loka men kisi anya ke dvara main isa rupa men, na vedadhyayana aura na yagyaa, na dana aura na kriyayon ke dvara aura na ugra tapon ke dvara hi dekha ja sakata hun
verses.english_meaning: Neither by the study of the Vedas, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, nor by severe austerities, can I be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than yourself, O great hero of the Kurus

verses.sanskrit:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो

दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्।

व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं

तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य
verses.transliteration:
mā te vyathā mā cha vimūḍha-bhāvo
dṛiṣhṭvā rūpaṁ ghoram īdṛiṅ mamedam
vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punas tvaṁ
tad eva me rūpam idaṁ prapaśhya
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara mere isa ghora rupa ko dekhakara tuma vyatha aura mudhabhava ko mata prapta ho. nirbhaya aura prasannachitta hokara tuma puna: mere usi rupa ko dekho
verses.english_meaning: Do not be afraid, nor be bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of Mine; with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart, now behold again this former form of Mine

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा

स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः।

आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं

भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
ity arjunaṁ vāsudevas tathoktvā
svakaṁ rūpaṁ darśhayām āsa bhūyaḥ
āśhvāsayām āsa cha bhītam enaṁ
bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapur mahātmā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- bhagavan vasudeva ne arjuna se isa prakara kahakara, puna: apane rupa ko darshaya, aura phira, saumyarupa mahatma shrikrishna ne isa bhayabhita arjuna ko ashvasta kiya
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Krishna again showed His own form. The great Soul, assuming His gentle form, then consoled Arjuna, who was terrified

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन।

इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
dṛiṣhṭvedaṁ mānuṣhaṁ rūpaṁ tava saumyaṁ janārdana
idānīm asmi saṁvṛittaḥ sa-chetāḥ prakṛitiṁ gataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he janardana! apake isa saumya manushya rupa ko dekhakara aba main shantachitta hua apane svabhava ko prapta ho gaya hun
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "Having seen this Thy gentle human form, O Krishna, now I am composed and have been restored to my own nature."

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।

देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
su-durdarśham idaṁ rūpaṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi yan mama
devā apy asya rūpasya nityaṁ darśhana-kāṅkṣhiṇaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- mera yaha rupa dekhane ko milana ati durlabha hai, jisako ki tumane dekha hai. devatagana bhi sada isa rupa ke darshana ke ichhuka rahate hain
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "It is very hard indeed to see this form of Mine which thou hast seen; even the gods are ever longing to behold it."

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।

शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा
verses.transliteration:
nāhaṁ vedair na tapasā na dānena na chejyayā
śhakya evaṁ-vidho draṣhṭuṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi māṁ yathā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Na vedon se, na tapa se, na dana se aura na yagyaa se hi main isa prakara dekha ja sakata hun, jaisa ki tumane mujhe dekha hai
verses.english_meaning: Neither by the Vedas, nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrifice can I be seen in this form as thou hast seen Me so easily

verses.sanskrit:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।

ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप
verses.transliteration:
bhaktyā tv ananyayā śhakya aham evaṁ-vidho ’rjuna
jñātuṁ draṣhṭuṁ cha tattvena praveṣhṭuṁ cha parantapa
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu he parantapa arjuna! ananya bhakti ke dvara main tattavata: 'janane', 'dekhane' aura 'pravesha' karane ke lie bhi, shakya hun!
verses.english_meaning: But by single-minded devotion, I can be known, seen, and entered into in reality, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।

निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव
verses.transliteration:
mat-karma-kṛin mat-paramo mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ
nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣhu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava
verses.hinglish_meaning: He pandava! jo purusha mere lie hi karma karane vala hai, aura mujhe hi parama lakshaya manata hai, jo mera bhakta hai tatha sangarahita hai, jo bhutamatra ke prati nirvaira hai, vaha mujhe prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He who does all actions for Me, who regards Me as the Supreme, who is devoted to Me, who is free from attachment, who bears no enmity towards any creature, he comes to Me, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
evaṁ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṁ paryupāsate
ye chāpy akṣharam avyaktaṁ teṣhāṁ ke yoga-vittamāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- jo bhakta, satata yukta hokara isa prakara se apaki upasana karate hain aura jo bhakta akshara, aura avyakta ki upasana karate hain, una donon men kauna uttama yogavit hai
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "Which of them are better versed in Yoga—those who steadfastly worship You, or those who worship the imperishable and the unmanifested?"

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
mayy āveśhya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate
śhraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- mujhamen mana ko ekagra karake nityayukta hue jo bhaktajana parama shraddha se yukta hokara meri upasana karate hain, ve, mere mata se, yuktatama hain arthat shreshtha hain
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "In My opinion, those who fix their minds on Me, worship Me ever steadfastly, and are endowed with supreme faith, are the best in Yoga."

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration:
ye tv akṣharam anirdeśhyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate
sarvatra-gam achintyañcha kūṭa-stham achalandhruvam
sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ
te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu jo bhakta akshara ,anirdeshya, avyakta, sarvagata, achintaya, kutastha, achala aura dhruva ki upasana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the omnipresent, the unthinkable, the immovable, and the eternal

verses.sanskrit: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.transliteration: sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ  sarvatra    sama-buddhayaḥ  te  prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite    ratāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Indariya samudaya ko samyak prakara se niyamita karake, sarvatra samabhava vale, bhutamatra ke hita men rata ve bhakta mujhe hi prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Having restrained all the senses, being even-minded everywhere, and intent on the welfare of all beings, they verily come unto Me

verses.sanskrit:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।

अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते
verses.transliteration:
kleśho ’dhikataras teṣhām avyaktāsakta-chetasām
avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṁ dehavadbhir avāpyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu una avyakta men asakta hue chitta vale purushon ko klesha adhika hota hai, kyonki dehadhariyon se avyakta ki gati kathinaipurvaka prapta ki jati hai
verses.english_meaning: Greater is their trouble whose minds are set on the unmanifested, for the goal of the unmanifested is very hard for the embodied to reach

verses.sanskrit: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते
verses.transliteration:
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ
ananyenaiva yogena māṁ dhyāyanta upāsate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu jo bhaktajana mujhe hi parama lakshaya samajhate hue saba karmon ko mujhe arpana karake ananyayoga ke dvara mera hi dhyana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: But to those who worship Me, renouncing all actions in Me, regarding Me as the supreme goal, meditating on Me with single-minded yoga

verses.sanskrit: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣhām ahaṁ samuddhartā mṛityu-saṁsāra-sāgarāt
bhavāmi na chirāt pārtha mayy āveśhita-chetasām
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jinaka chitta mujhamen hi sthira hua hai aise bhakton ka main shighra hi mrityurupa sansara sagara se uddhara karane vala hota hun
verses.english_meaning: To those whose minds are set on Me, O Arjuna, verily I soon become the savior out of the ocean of Samsara

verses.sanskrit: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśhaya
nivasiṣhyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṁ na sanśhayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tuma apane mana aura buddhi ko mujhamen hi sthira karo, taduparanta tuma mujhamen hi nivasa karoge, isamen koi sanshaya nahin hai
verses.english_meaning: Fix your mind on Me, and your intellect in Me. Then you will certainly live in Me alone hereafter

verses.sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय
verses.transliteration:
atha chittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śhaknoṣhi mayi sthiram
abhyāsa-yogena tato mām ichchhāptuṁ dhanañjaya
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dhananjaya ! yadi tuma apane mana ko mujhamen sthira karane men samartha nahin ho, to abhyasayoga ke dvara tuma mujhe prapta karane ki ichha karo
verses.english_meaning: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then seek to reach Me through the yoga of constant practice, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration:
abhyāse ’py asamartho ’si mat-karma-paramo bhava
mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yadi tuma abhyasa men bhi asamartha ho to matkarma parayana bano; isa prakara mere lie karmon ko karate hue bhi tuma siddhi ko prapta karoge
verses.english_meaning: If you are unable to practice even this Abhyasa Yoga, be intent on doing actions for My sake; even by doing actions for My sake, you will attain perfection

verses.sanskrit: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
athaitad apy aśhakto ’si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśhritaḥ
sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura yadi isako bhi karane ke lie tuma asamartha ho, to atmasanyama se yukta hokara meri prapti rupa yoga ka ashraya lekara, tuma samasta karmon ke phala ka tyaga karo
verses.english_meaning: If you are unable to do even this, then, resort to union with Me and renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
śhreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśhiṣhyate
dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāch chhāntir anantaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Abhyasa se gyaana shreshtha hai; gyaana se shreshtha dhyana hai aura dhyana se bhi shreshtha karmaphala tyaga hai tyaga; se tatkala hi shanti milati hai
verses.english_meaning: Better indeed is knowledge than practice; better than knowledge is meditation; better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of actions: peace immediately follows renunciation

verses.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी
verses.transliteration:
adveṣhṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva cha
nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣhamī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhutamatra ke prati jo dvesharahita hai tatha sabaka mitra tatha karunavan hai; jo mamata aura ahankara se rahita, sukha aura du:kha men sama aura kshamavan hai
verses.english_meaning: He who hates no creature, is friendly and compassionate to all, is free from attachment and egoism, is balanced in pleasure and pain, and is forgiving

verses.sanskrit: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration:
santuṣhṭaḥ satataṁ yogī yatātmā dṛiḍha-niśhchayaḥ
mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sanyatatma, dridhanishchayi yogi sada santushta hai, jo apane mana aura buddhi ko mujhamen arpana kiye hue hai, jo aisa mera bhakta hai, vaha mujhe priya hai
verses.english_meaning: Ever content, steady in meditation, self-controlled, possessing firm conviction, with the mind and intellect dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration:
yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate cha yaḥ
harṣhāmarṣha-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa cha me priyaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisase koi loka udvega ko prapta nahin hota aura jo svayan bhi kisi vyakti se udvega anubhava nahin karata tatha jo harsha, amarsha bhaya aura udvegon se mukta hai,vaha bhakta mujhe priya hai
verses.english_meaning: He whom the world does not agitate, and who cannot be agitated by the world, and who is freed from joy, anger, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me

verses.sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration:
anapekṣhaḥ śhuchir dakṣha udāsīno gata-vyathaḥ
sarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo apeksharahita, shuddha, daksha, udasina, vyatharahita aura sarvakarmon ka sannyasa karane vala mera bhakta hai, vaha mujhe priya hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is free from wants, pure, expert, unconcerned, and free from pain, renouncing all undertakings and commencements, he who is devoted to Me is dear to Me

verses.sanskrit: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration:
yo na hṛiṣhyati na dveṣhṭi na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
śhubhāśhubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo na harshita hota hai aura na dvesha karata hai; na shoka karata hai aura na akanksha; tatha jo shubha aura ashubha ko tyaga deta hai, vaha bhaktiman purusha mujhe priya hai
verses.english_meaning: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves nor desires, renouncing both good and evil, and who is full of devotion, is dear to Me

verses.sanskrit: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
samaḥ śhatrau cha mitre cha tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha shatru aura mitra men tatha mana aura apamana men sama hai; jo shita-ushna va sukhadu:khadika dvandavon men sama hai aura asakti rahita hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is the same to foe and friend, and also in honor and dishonor, who is the same in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः
verses.transliteration:
tulya-nindā-stutir maunī santuṣhṭo yena kenachit
aniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisako ninda aura stuti donon hi tulya hai, jo mauni hai, jo kisi alpa vastu se bhi santushta hai, jo aniketa hai, vaha sthira buddhi ka bhaktiman purusha mujhe priya hai
verses.english_meaning: He to whom censure and praise are equal, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, of a steady mind, and full of devotion; that man is dear to me

verses.sanskrit: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः
verses.transliteration:
ye tu dharmyāmṛitam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate
śhraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te ’tīva me priyāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo bhakta shraddhavan tatha mujhe hi parama lakshaya samajhane vale hain aura isa yathokta dharmamaya amrita ka arthat dharmamaya jivana ka palana karate hain, ve mujhe atishaya priya hain
verses.english_meaning: They who follow this immortal Dharma, endowed with faith and regarding Me as their supreme goal, are exceedingly dear to Me

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च।

एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva kṣhetraṁ kṣhetra-jñam eva cha
etad veditum ichchhāmi jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ cha keśhava
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he keshava ! main, prakriti aura purusha, kshetra aura kshetragyaa tatha gyaana aura gyaeya ko janana chahata hun
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "I wish to learn about Nature and the Spirit, the field and the knower of the field, knowledge and that which ought to be known, O Kesava."

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
idaṁ śharīraṁ kaunteya kṣhetram ity abhidhīyate
etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣhetra-jña iti tad-vidaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- he kaunteya ! yaha sharira kshetra kaha jata hai aura isako jo janata hai, use tattavagyaa jana, kshetragyaa kahate hain
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this body is called the field; he who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who know them."

verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।

क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम
verses.transliteration:
kṣhetra-jñaṁ chāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣhetreṣhu bhārata
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor jñānaṁ yat taj jñānaṁ mataṁ mama
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! tuma samasta kshetron men kshetragyaa mujhe hi jano. kshetra aura kshetragyaa ka jo gyaana hai, vahi gyaana hai , aisa mera mata hai
verses.english_meaning: Do thou also know Me as the knower of the field in all fields, O Arjuna. Knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is considered by Me to be the knowledge

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु
verses.transliteration:
tat kṣhetraṁ yach cha yādṛik cha yad-vikāri yataśh cha yat
sa cha yo yat-prabhāvaśh cha tat samāsena me śhṛiṇu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isaliye, vaha kshetra jo hai aura jaisa hai tatha jina vikaron vala hai, aura jisa se jo hua hai tatha vaha bhi jo hai aura jisa prabhava vala hai, vaha sankshepa men mujhase suno
verses.english_meaning: Hear from Me in brief what the field is, of what nature it is, what its modifications are, whence it is, who He is, and what His powers are

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः
verses.transliteration:
ṛiṣhibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chhandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛithak
brahma-sūtra-padaiśh chaiva hetumadbhir viniśhchitaiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Rishiyon dvara vibhinna aura vividha chhandon men bahuta prakara se gaya gaya hai, tatha samyak prakara se nishchita kiye huye yuktiyukta brahmasutra ke padon dvara bhi
verses.english_meaning: Sages have sung in many ways, with various distinctive chants and also with suggestive words indicative of the Absolute, full of reasoning and decisive

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः
verses.transliteration:
mahā-bhūtāny ahankāro buddhir avyaktam eva cha
indriyāṇi daśhaikaṁ cha pañcha chendriya-gocharāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Pancha mahabhuta, ahankara, buddhi, avyakta , dasa indariyan, eka mana, indariyon ke pancha vishaya
verses.english_meaning: The great elements, egoism, intellect, and also the Unmanifested Nature, the ten senses, and one mind, and the five objects of the senses

verses.sanskrit: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
ichchhā dveṣhaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaśh chetanā dhṛitiḥ
etat kṣhetraṁ samāsena sa-vikāram udāhṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ichha, dvesha, sukha, dukha, sanghata , chetana tatha dhriti - isa prakara yaha kshetra vikaron ke sahita sankshepa men kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate , intelligence, and fortitude—the field has thus been briefly described with its modifications

verses.sanskrit: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः
verses.transliteration:
amānitvam adambhitvam ahinsā kṣhāntir ārjavam
āchāryopāsanaṁ śhauchaṁ sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Amanitva, adambhitva, ahinsa, kshama, arjava, acharya ki seva, shuddhi, sthirata aura atmasanyama
verses.english_meaning: Humility, unpretentiousness, non-injury, forgiveness, uprightness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
indriyārtheṣhu vairāgyam anahankāra eva cha
janma-mṛityu-jarā-vyādhi-duḥkha-doṣhānudarśhanam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Indariyon ke vishaya ke prati vairagya, ahankara ka abhava, janma, mrityu, vriddhavastha, vyadhi aura dukha men dosha darshana.
verses.english_meaning: Indifference to the objects of the senses and also absence of egoism; perceiving the evil in birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain

verses.sanskrit: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु
verses.transliteration:
asaktir anabhiṣhvaṅgaḥ putra-dāra-gṛihādiṣhu
nityaṁ cha sama-chittatvam iṣhṭāniṣhṭopapattiṣhu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Asakti tatha putra, patni, griha adi men anabhishvanga ; aura ishta aura anishta ki prapti men samachittata
verses.english_meaning: Non-attachment, non-identification of the Self with son, wife, home, and the rest, and constant even-mindedness in the face of the attainment of both desirable and undesirable

verses.sanskrit: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी।विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि
verses.transliteration:
mayi chānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhichāriṇī
vivikta-deśha-sevitvam aratir jana-sansadi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ananyayoga ke dvara mujhamen avyabhicharini bhakti; ekanta sthana men rahane ka svabhava aura janon ke samudaya men aruchi
verses.english_meaning: Unswerving devotion to Me through the Yoga of non-separation, resorting to solitary places, and a distaste for the company of people

verses.sanskrit: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा
verses.transliteration:
adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvaṁ tattva-jñānārtha-darśhanam
etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṁ yad ato ’nyathā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Adhyatmagyaana men nityatva arthat sthirata tatha tattavagyaana ke artha rupa paramatma ka darshana, yaha saba to gyaana kaha gaya hai, aura jo isase viparita hai, vaha agyaana hai
verses.english_meaning: Constancy in Self-knowledge, the perception of the end of true knowledge—this is declared to be knowledge, and what is opposed to it is ignorance

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛitam aśhnute
anādi mat-paraṁ brahma na sat tan nāsad uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main usa gyaeya vastu ko spashta kahunga jise janakara manushya amritatva ko prapta karata hai. vaha gyaeya hai - anadi, parama brahma, jo na sat aura na asat hi kaha ja sakata hai
verses.english_meaning: I will declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality; the beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is neither being nor non-being

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration:
sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādaṁ tat sarvato ’kṣhi-śhiro-mukham
sarvataḥ śhrutimal loke sarvam āvṛitya tiṣhṭhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha saba ora hatha-paira vala hai aura saba ora se netra, shira aura mukhavala tatha saba ora se shrotravala hai; vaha jagat men sabako vyapta karake sthita hai
verses.english_meaning: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, He exists in the worlds, enveloping all

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च
verses.transliteration:
sarvendriya-guṇābhāsaṁ sarvendriya-vivarjitam
asaktaṁ sarva-bhṛich chaiva nirguṇaṁ guṇa-bhoktṛi cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vaha samasta indariyon ke guno ke dvara prakashita hone vala, parantu samasta indariyon se rahita hai; asakti rahita tatha guna rahita hote hue bhi sabako dharanaposhana karane vala aura gunon ka bhokta hai
verses.english_meaning: Shining by the functions of all the senses, yet without being attached to them; unattached, yet supporting all; devoid of qualities, yet the experiencer of them

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्
verses.transliteration:
bahir antaśh cha bhūtānām acharaṁ charam eva cha
sūkṣhmatvāt tad avijñeyaṁ dūra-sthaṁ chāntike cha tat
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhuta matra ke antarbahya sthita hai; vaha chara hai aura achara bhi. sukshama hone se vaha avigyaeya hai; vaha sudura aura atyanta samipastha bhi hai
verses.english_meaning: It is within and without all beings, both the unmoving and the moving; It is subtle and unknowable, and It is near and far away

verses.sanskrit: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च
verses.transliteration:
avibhaktaṁ cha bhūteṣhu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam
bhūta-bhartṛi cha taj jñeyaṁ grasiṣhṇu prabhaviṣhṇu cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura vaha avibhakta hai, tathapi vaha bhuton men vibhakta ke samana sthita hai. vaha gyaeya brahma bhutamatra ka bharta, sanharakarta aura utpatti karta hai
verses.english_meaning: Undivided yet, It exists as if divided in beings; It is to be known as the supporter of beings; It devours and It generates

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration:
jyotiṣhām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param uchyate
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñāna-gamyaṁ hṛidi sarvasya viṣhṭhitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jyotiyon ki bhi jyoti aura andhakara se pare kaha jata hai. vaha gyaana gyaeya aura gyaana ke dvara janane yogya hai. vaha sabhi ke hridaya men sthita hai
verses.english_meaning: That Light of all lights is said to be beyond darkness: knowledge, the knowable, and the goal of knowledge, seated in the hearts of all

verses.sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते
verses.transliteration:
iti kṣhetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ choktaṁ samāsataḥ
mad-bhakta etad vijñāya mad-bhāvāyopapadyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara, kshetra, gyaana aura gyaeya ko sankshepata: kaha gaya. ise tattava se janakara mera bhakta mere svarupa ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Thus, the field, as well as knowledge and the knowable, have been briefly stated. My devotee, knowing this, enters into My being

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्
verses.transliteration:
prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api
vikārānśh cha guṇānśh chaiva viddhi prakṛiti-sambhavān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prakriti aura purusha ina donon ko hi tuma anadi jano. aura tuma yaha bhi jano ki sabhi vikara aura guna prakriti se hi utpanna hue hain
verses.english_meaning: Know that Nature and the Spirit are both beginningless, and know also that all modifications and qualities are born from Nature

verses.sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
kārya-kāraṇa-kartṛitve hetuḥ prakṛitir uchyate
puruṣhaḥ sukha-duḥkhānāṁ bhoktṛitve hetur uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karya aura karana ke utpanna karane men hetu prakriti kahi jati hai aura purusha sukha-du:kha ke bhoktritva men hetu kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: In the production of the effect and the cause, Nature is said to be the cause; in the experience of pleasure and pain, the soul is said to be the one responsible

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु
verses.transliteration:
puruṣhaḥ prakṛiti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛiti-jān guṇān
kāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo ’sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prakriti men sthita purusha prakriti se utpanna gunon ko bhogata hai. ina gunon ka sanga hi isa purusha ke shubha aura ashubha yoniyon men janma lene ka karana hai
verses.english_meaning: The soul seated in Nature experiences the qualities born of Nature; attachment to the qualities is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs

verses.sanskrit: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः
verses.transliteration:
upadraṣhṭānumantā cha bhartā bhoktā maheśhvaraḥ
paramātmeti chāpy ukto dehe ’smin puruṣhaḥ paraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parama purusha hi isa deha men upadrashta, anumanta ,bharta, bhokta, maheshvara aura paramatma kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Supreme Soul in this body is also called the observer, the permitter, the sustainer, the enjoyer, the great Lord, and the Supreme Self

verses.sanskrit: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration:
ya evaṁ vetti puruṣhaṁ prakṛitiṁ cha guṇaiḥ saha
sarvathā vartamāno ’pi na sa bhūyo ’bhijāyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara purusha aura gunon ke sahita prakriti ko jo manushya janata hai, vaha saba prakara se rahata hua bhi puna: nahin janmata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who thus knows the Spirit and Matter together with their qualities, in whatever condition he may be, he is not reborn

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे
verses.transliteration:
dhyānenātmani paśhyanti kechid ātmānam ātmanā
anye sānkhyena yogena karma-yogena chāpare
verses.hinglish_meaning: Koi purusha dhyana ke abhyasa se atma ko atma men atma ke dvara dekhate hain; anya loga sankhya yoga ke dvara tatha koi sadhaka karmayoga se
verses.english_meaning: Some behold the Self within themselves through meditation, others through the Yoga of knowledge, and still others through the Yoga of action

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः
verses.transliteration:
anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śhrutvānyebhya upāsate
te ’pi chātitaranty eva mṛityuṁ śhruti-parāyaṇāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu, anya loga jo svayan isa prakara na janate hue, dusaron se sunakara hi upasana karate hain, ve shrutiparayana loga bhi mrityu ko ni:sandeha tara jate hain
verses.english_meaning: Others, too, who do not know thus, worship, having heard of It from others; they, too, cross beyond death, regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge

verses.sanskrit: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
yāvat sañjāyate kiñchit sattvaṁ sthāvara-jaṅgamam
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajña-sanyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣhabha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata shreshtha ! yavanmatra jo kuchha bhi sthavara jangama vastu utpanna hoti hai, usa sabako tuma kshetra aura kshetragyaa ke sanyoga se utpanna hui jano
verses.english_meaning: Wherever a being is born, whether unmoving or moving, know thou, O best of the Bharatas , that it is from the union of the field and its knower

verses.sanskrit: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.transliteration:
samaṁ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu tiṣhṭhantaṁ parameśhvaram
vinaśhyatsv avinaśhyantaṁ yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha samasta nashvara bhuton men anashvara parameshvara ko samabhava se sthita dekhata hai, vahi dekhata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who sees the Supreme Lord existing truly in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable, sees indeed

verses.sanskrit: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram
na hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Nishchaya hi, vaha purusha sarvatra sama bhava se sthita parameshvara ko samana hua atma ke dvara atma ka nasha nahin karata hai, isase vaha parama gati ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: For he who truly sees the same Lord dwelling everywhere does not destroy the Self by the self; rather, he attains the highest goal

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति
verses.transliteration:
prakṛityaiva cha karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśhaḥ
yaḥ paśhyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha samasta karmon ko sarvasha: prakriti dvara hi kiye gaye dekhata hai tatha atma ko akarta dekhata hai, vahi dekhata hai
verses.english_meaning: He sees, who sees that all actions are performed solely by Nature and that the Self is without action

verses.sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा
verses.transliteration:
yadā bhūta-pṛithag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśhyati
tata eva cha vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha purusha jaba bhuton ke prithak bhavon ko eka men sthita dekhata hai tatha usa se hi yaha vistara hua janata hai, taba vaha brahma ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: When a person sees all beings as resting in the One and emanating from the One alone, they then become Brahman

verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration:
anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ
śharīra-stho ’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! anadi aura nirguna hone se yaha paramatma avyaya hai. sharira men sthita hua bhi, vastuta:, vaha na karata hai aura na lipta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Being without beginning, devoid of any qualities, the Supreme Self, imperishable, though dwelling in the body, O Arjuna, neither acts nor is tainted

verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते
verses.transliteration:
yathā sarva-gataṁ saukṣhmyād ākāśhaṁ nopalipyate
sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa prakara sarvagata akasha sukshama hone ke karana lipta nahin hota, usi prakara sarvatra deha men sthita atma lipta nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted, due to its subtlety, so the Self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted either

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत
verses.transliteration:
yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ
kṣhetraṁ kṣhetrī tathā kṛitsnaṁ prakāśhayati bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! jisa prakara eka hi surya isa sampurna loka ko prakashita karata hai, usi prakara eka hi kshetri sampurna kshetra ko prakashita karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Just as the one sun illuminates the entire world, so too does the Lord of the field illuminate the entire field, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्
verses.transliteration:
kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor evam antaraṁ jñāna-chakṣhuṣhā
bhūta-prakṛiti-mokṣhaṁ cha ye vidur yānti te param
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara, jo purusha gyaanachakshu ke dvara kshetra aura kshetragyaa ke bheda ko tatha prakriti ke vikaron se moksha ko janate hain, ve parama brahma ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: They who, by the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the field and its knower, as well as the liberation from the Nature of being, go to the Supreme

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣhyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam
yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- samasta gyaanon men uttama parama gyaana ko main puna: kahunga, jisako janakara sabhi munijana isa se jakara parama siddhi ko prapta hue hain
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "I will again declare to thee that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have gone to supreme perfection after this life."

verses.sanskrit: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ
sarge ’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa gyaana ka ashraya lekara mere svarupa ko prapta purusha srishti ke adi men janma nahin lete aura pralayakala men vyakula bhi nahin hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Those who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained unity with Me, are neither born at the time of creation nor disturbed at the time of dissolution

verses.sanskrit: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत
verses.transliteration:
mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham
sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tato bhavati bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! meri mahad brahmarupa prakriti, yoni hai, jisamen main garbhadhana karata hun; isase samasta bhuton ki utpatti hoti hai
verses.english_meaning: My womb is the great Brahma; in it I place the germ; thence, O Arjuna, is the birth of all beings

verses.sanskrit: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता
verses.transliteration:
sarva-yoniṣhu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ
tāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! samasta yoniyon men jitani murtiyan utpanna hoti hain, una sabaki yoni arthat garbha hai mahadbrahma aura main bija ki sthapana karane vala pita hun
verses.english_meaning: Whatever forms are produced, O Arjuna, in any womb whatsoever, the great Brahma is their womb, and I am the seed-giving father

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ
nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahabaho ! sattava, raja aura tama ye prakriti se utpanna tinon guna dehi atma ko deha ke satha bandha dete hain
verses.english_meaning: These qualities, O Arjuna, born of Nature, bind fast in the body of the embodied, the indestructible: purity, passion, and inertia

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ
verses.transliteration:
tatra sattvaṁ nirmalatvāt prakāśhakam anāmayam
sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena chānagha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He nishpapa arjuna ! ina men, sattavaguna nirmala hone se prakashaka aura anamaya hai; sukha ki asakti se aura gyaana ki asakti se bandha deta hai
verses.english_meaning: Of these, sattva, which is luminous and healthy due to its stainlessness, binds one by attachment to happiness and knowledge, O sinless one

verses.sanskrit: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्
verses.transliteration:
rajo rāgātmakaṁ viddhi tṛiṣhṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam
tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! rajoguna ko ragasvarupa jano, jisase trishna aura asakti utpanna hoti hai. vaha dehi atma ko karmon ki asakti se bandhata hai
verses.english_meaning: Know, O Arjuna, that Rajas is of the nature of passion, the source of thirst and attachment; it binds fast the embodied one by attachment to action

verses.sanskrit: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत
verses.transliteration:
tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām
pramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura he bharata ! tamoguna ko agyaana se utpanna jano; jo samasta dehadhariyon ko mohita karane vala hai. vaha pramada, alasya aura nidra ke dvara jiva ko bandhata hai
verses.english_meaning: But know thou Tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, O Arjuna, through heedlessness, indolence, and sleep

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत
verses.transliteration:
sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
jñānam āvṛitya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! sattavaguna sukha men asakta kara deta hai aura rajoguna karma men, kintu tamoguna gyaana ko avritta karake jiva ko pramada se yukta kara deta hai
verses.english_meaning: Sattva attaches to happiness, Rajas to action, O Arjuna, while Tamas, verily shrouding knowledge, attaches to heedlessness

verses.sanskrit: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata
rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaśh chaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! kabhi raja aura tama ko abhibhuta karake sattavaguna ki vriddhi hoti hai, kabhi raja aura sattava ko dabakara tamoguna ki vriddhi hoti hai, to kabhi tama aura sattava ko abhibhuta kara rajoguna ki vriddhi hoti hai
verses.english_meaning: Now, O Arjuna, Sattva prevails, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas; then Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and then Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas

verses.sanskrit: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत
verses.transliteration:
sarva-dvāreṣhu dehe ’smin prakāśha upajāyate
jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba isa deha ke dvaron arthat samasta indariyon men gyaanarupa prakasha utpanna hota hai, taba sattavaguna ko pravriddha hua jano
verses.english_meaning: When the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant

verses.sanskrit: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā
rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe bharatarṣhabha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata-shreshtha ! rajoguna ke pravriddha hone para lobha, pravritti karmon ka arambha, shama ka abhava tatha spriha, ye saba utpanna hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing—these arise when Rajas is predominant, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha
tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe kuru-nandana
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kurunandana ! tamoguna ke pravriddha hone para aprakasha, apravritti, pramada aura moha ye saba utpanna hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Darkness, inertia, carelessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominant, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration:
yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit
tadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba yaha jiva sattavaguna ki pravriddhi men mrityu ko prapta hota hai, taba uttama karma karane valon ke nirmala arthat svargadi lokon ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: If the embodied one meets death when Sattva is predominant, then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the Highest

verses.sanskrit: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते
verses.transliteration:
rajasi pralayaṁ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣhu jāyate
tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣhu jāyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Rajoguna ke pravriddha kala men mrityu ko prapta hokara karmasakti vale loka men vaha janma leta hai tatha tamoguna ke pravriddhakala men mudhayoni men janma leta hai
verses.english_meaning: Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the thoughtless

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛitasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam
rajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shubha karma ka phala satvika aura nirmala kaha gaya hai; rajoguna ka phala du;kha aura tamoguna ka phala agyaana hai
verses.english_meaning: They say that the fruit of good action is Sattvic and pure; indeed, the fruit of Rajas is pain, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च
verses.transliteration:
sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha
pramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato ’jñānam eva cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sattavaguna se gyaana utpanna hota hai. rajoguna se lobha tatha tamoguna se pramada, moha aura agyaana utpanna hota hai
verses.english_meaning: From Sattva arises knowledge, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from Tamas, and also ignorance

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ
jaghanya-guṇa-vṛitti-sthā adho gachchhanti tāmasāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sattavaguna men sthita purusha uchcha jate hain; rajasa purusha madhya men rahate hain aura tamoguna ki atyanta hina pravrittiyon men sthita tamasa loga adhogati ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Those seated in Sattva ascend; those of Rajasic nature dwell in the middle; and those of Tamasic nature, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, descend

verses.sanskrit: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
nānyaṁ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṁ yadā draṣhṭānupaśhyati
guṇebhyaśh cha paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so ’dhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba drashta purusha tinon gunon ke atirikta kisi anya ko karta nahin dekhata, arthat nahin samajhata hai aura tinon gunon se pare mere tatva ko janata hai, taba vaha mere svarupa ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows that which is higher than them, he attains to My Being

verses.sanskrit: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते
verses.transliteration:
guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān
janma-mṛityu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto ’mṛitam aśhnute
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha dehi purusha sharira ki utpatti ke karanarupa tinon gunon se atita hokara janma, mrityu, jara aura du:khon se vimukta hua amritatva ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The embodied one, having crossed beyond these three Gunas from which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains immortality

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho
kim āchāraḥ kathaṁ chaitāns trīn guṇān ativartate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he prabho ! ina tino gunon se atita hua purusha kina lakshanon se yukta hota hai ? vaha kisa prakara ke acharana vala hota hai ? aura, vaha kisa upaya se ina tinon gunon se atita hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities, O Lord? What is their conduct, and how do they go beyond these three qualities?"

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
prakāśhaṁ cha pravṛittiṁ cha moham eva cha pāṇḍava
na dveṣhṭi sampravṛittāni na nivṛittāni kāṅkṣhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- he pandava ! prakasha, pravritti aura moha ke pravritta hone para bhi unaka dvesha nahin karata tatha nivritta hone para unaki akanksha nahin karata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "When light, activity, and delusion are present, he does not hate them, nor does he long for them when they are absent

verses.sanskrit: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते
verses.transliteration:
udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate
guṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo ’vatiṣhṭhati neṅgate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo udasina ke samana asina hokara gunon ke dvara vichalita nahin kiya ja sakata aura "guna hi vyavahara karate hain" aisa janakara sthita rahata hai aura usa sthiti se vichalita nahin hota
verses.english_meaning: He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the dualities, and who, knowing that the dualities are active, is self-centered and does not move

verses.sanskrit: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः
verses.transliteration:
sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ sva-sthaḥ sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
tulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-sanstutiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo svastha , sukha-du:kha men samana rahata hai tatha mitti, patthara aura svarna men samadrishti rakhata hai; aisa vira purusha priya aura apriya ko tatha ninda aura atmastuti ko tulya samajhata hai
