verses.english_meaning: Who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the Self, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is firm, and to whom censure and praise are one and the same

verses.sanskrit: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣhayoḥ
sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo mana aura apamana men sama hai; shatru aura mitra ke paksha men bhi sama hai, aisa sarvarambha parityagi purusha gunatita kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Who is the same in honor and dishonor, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings, he is said to have transcended the dualities

verses.sanskrit: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्ितयोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration:
māṁ cha yo ’vyabhichāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate
sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha avyabhichari bhaktiyoga ke dvara meri seva arthat upasana karata hai, vaha ina tinon gunon ke atita hokara brahma banane ke liye yogya ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: And he who serves Me with unwavering devotion, he, crossing beyond the dualities, is fit for becoming Brahman

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣhṭhāham amṛitasyāvyayasya cha
śhāśhvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki main amrita, avyaya, brahma, shashvata dharma aura aikantika arthat paramarthika sukha ki pratishtha hun
verses.english_meaning: For I am the abode of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and everlasting Dharma, and absolute bliss

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śhākham aśhvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam
chhandānsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- urdhavamula aura adha:shakha vala ashvattha aura avyaya kahate hain; jisake parna chhanda arthat veda hain, aise ko jo janata hai, vaha vedavit hai
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said: They speak of the indestructible peepul tree, with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the meters or hymns; he who knows it is a knower of the Vedas

verses.sanskrit: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा     गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि     कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके
verses.transliteration:
adhaśh chordhvaṁ prasṛitās tasya śhākhā
guṇa-pravṛiddhā viṣhaya-pravālāḥ
adhaśh cha mūlāny anusantatāni
karmānubandhīni manuṣhya-loke
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa vriksha ki shakhaen gunon se pravriddha huin niche aura upara phaili huin hain; vishaya isake ankura hain; manushya loka men karmon ka anusarana karane vali isaki anya jadaen niche phaili huin hain
verses.english_meaning: Its branches spread below and above, nourished by the Gunas; its buds are sense-objects, and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men, originating action

verses.sanskrit: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल    मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा
verses.transliteration:
na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate
nānto na chādir na cha sampratiṣhṭhā
aśhvattham enaṁ su-virūḍha-mūlam
asaṅga-śhastreṇa dṛiḍhena chhittvā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa ka svarupa jaisa kaha gaya hai vaisa yahan upalabdha nahin hota hai, kyonki isaka na adi hai aura na anta aura na pratishtha hi hai. isa ati dridha mula vale ashvattha vriksha ko dridha asanga shastara se katakara.
verses.english_meaning: Its form is not perceived here as such, nor its end, origin, foundation, or resting place; having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment

verses.sanskrit: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये    यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ padaṁ tat parimārgitavyaṁ
yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tam eva chādyaṁ puruṣhaṁ prapadye
yataḥ pravṛittiḥ prasṛitā purāṇī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Usa pada ka anveshana karana chahie jisako prapta hue purusha puna: sansara men nahin lautate hain. "main usa adi purusha ki sharana hun, jisase yaha puratana pravritti prasrita hui hai"
verses.english_meaning: Then, that goal should be sought for, to which, having gone, none returns again. I seek refuge in that Primeval Purusha, from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy

verses.sanskrit: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा    अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै    र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्
verses.transliteration:
nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣhā
adhyātma-nityā vinivṛitta-kāmāḥ
dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-sanjñair
gachchhanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jinaka mana aura moha nivritta ho gaya hai, jinhonne sangadosha ko jita liya hai, jo adhyatma men sthita hain jinaki kamanaen nivritta ho chuki hain aura jo sukha-du:kha namaka dvandavon se vimukta ho gaye hain, aise sammoha rahita gyaanijana usa avyaya pada ko prapta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Free from pride and delusion, victorious over the evil of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self, their desires having completely turned away, freed from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they, the undeluded, reach the eternal goal

verses.sanskrit: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.transliteration:
na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
verses.hinglish_meaning: Use na surya prakashita kara sakata hai aura na chandarama aura na agni. jise prapta kara manushya puna: nahin lautate hain, vaha mera parama dhama hai
verses.english_meaning: Neither does the sun illuminate there, nor the moon, nor the fire; having gone there, they do not return; that is My supreme abode

verses.sanskrit: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति
verses.transliteration:
mamaivānśho jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥ-ṣhaṣhṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛiti-sthāni karṣhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa jiva loka men mera hi eka sanatana ansha jiva bana hai. vaha prakriti men sthita hua pancho indariyon tatha mana ko apani ora khincha leta hai arthat unhen ekatrita kara leta hai
verses.english_meaning: An eternal portion of Myself having become a living soul in the world of life, draws to itself the five senses, with the mind as the sixth, abiding in Nature

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्
verses.transliteration:
śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ
gṛihītvaitāni sanyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśhayāt
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jaba ishvara utkramana karata hai, taba ina ko grahana kara anya sharira men isa prakara le jata hai, jaise gandha ke ashraya se gandha ko vayu le jata hai
verses.english_meaning: When the Lord, as the individual soul, obtains a body and when He leaves it, He takes these with Him, just as the wind takes the scents from their seats

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते
verses.transliteration:
śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha
adhiṣhṭhāya manaśh chāyaṁ viṣhayān upasevate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shrotra, chakshu, sparshendariya, rasana aura ghrana ina indariyon tatha mana ko ashraya karake arthat inake dvara vishayon ka sevana karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and mind, it enjoys the objects of the senses

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः
verses.transliteration:
utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam
vimūḍhā nānupaśhyanti paśhyanti jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sharira ko tyagate huye, usamen sthita huye athava bhogate huye, gunon se samanvita atma ko vimudha loga nahin dekhate hain; gyaanachakshu vale purusha use dekhate hain
verses.english_meaning: The deluded do not see Him who departs, stays, and enjoys; but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold Him

verses.sanskrit: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः
verses.transliteration:
yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam
yatanto ‘py akṛitātmāno nainaṁ paśhyanty achetasaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yogijana prayatna karate huye hi apane hridaya men sthita atma ko dekhate hain, jaba ki ashuddha anta:karana vale aura aviveki loga yatna karate huye bhi ise nahin dekhate hain
verses.english_meaning: The yogis striving for perfection behold Him dwelling in the Self; but, the unrefined and unintelligent, even though striving, do not see Him

verses.sanskrit: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्
verses.transliteration:
yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate ’khilam
yach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo teja surya men sthita hokara sampurna jagat ko prakashita karata hai tatha jo teja chandarama men hai aura agni men hai, usa teja ko tuma mera hi jano
verses.english_meaning: That light which resides in the sun, illuminating the whole world; that which is in the moon and in the fire—know that light to be Mine

verses.sanskrit: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः
verses.transliteration:
gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā
puṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main hi prithvi men pravesha karake apane oja se bhutamatra ko dharana karata hun aura rasasvarupa chandarama banakara samasta aushadhiyon ka arthat vanaspatiyon ka poshana karata hun
verses.english_meaning: Permeating the earth, I support all beings with My energy; and having become the watery moon, I nourish all herbs

verses.sanskrit: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ
prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pachāmy annaṁ chatur-vidham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main hi samasta praniyon ke deha men sthita vaishvanara agnirupa hokara prana aura apana se yukta chara prakara ke anna ko pachata hun
verses.english_meaning: Having become the fire Vaisvanara, I abide in the bodies of living beings and, associated with the Prana and the Apana, digest the fourfold food

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो    वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvasya chāhaṁ hṛidi sanniviṣhṭo
mattaḥ smṛitir jñānam apohanaṁ cha
vedaiśh cha sarvair aham eva vedyo
vedānta-kṛid veda-vid eva chāham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Main hi samasta praniyon ke hridaya men sthita hun. mujhase hi smriti, gyaana aura apohana hota hai. samasta vedon ke dvara main hi vedya vastu hun tatha vedanta ka aura vedon ka gyaata bhi main hi hun
verses.english_meaning: And I am seated in the hearts of all; from Me come memory and knowledge, as well as their absence. I am verily That which has to be known by all the Vedas; I am indeed the author of the Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas

verses.sanskrit: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha
kṣharaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho ’kṣhara uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa loka men kshara aura akshara ye do purusha hain, samasta bhuta kshara hain aura 'kutastha' akshara kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Two Purushas there are in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are perishable, and the Kutastha—the unchanging—is called the imperishable

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ
yo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Parantu uttama purusha anya hi hai, jo paramatma kahalata hai aura jo tinon lokon men pravesha karake sabaka dharana karane vala avyaya ishvara hai
verses.english_meaning: But distinct is the Supreme Purusha, called the highest Self, indestructible and Lord, who pervades the three worlds and sustains them

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration:
yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ
ato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki main kshara se atita hun aura akshara se bhi uttama hun, isaliye loka men aura veda men bhi purushottama ke nama se prasiddha hun
verses.english_meaning: As I transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, I am declared to be the highest Purusha in the world and in the Vedas

verses.sanskrit: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत
verses.transliteration:
yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam
sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! isa prakara, jo, sanmoharahita, purusha mujha purushottama ko janata hai, vaha sarvagyaa hokara sampurna bhava se arthat purna hridaya se meri bhakti karata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who, undeluded, knows Me as the highest Purusha, he, knowing all, worships Me with his whole being , O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत
verses.transliteration:
iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha
etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He nishpapa bharata ! isa prakara yaha guhyatama shastara mere dvara kaha gaya, isako janakara manushya buddhimana aura kritakritya ho jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Thus, I have imparted to you this most secret science, O sinless one; by knowing this, one becomes wise, and all their duties are accomplished, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।

दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
abhayaṁ sattva-sanśhuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ
dānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- abhaya, anta:karana ki shuddhi, gyaanayoga men dridha sthiti, dana, dama, yagyaa, svadhyaya, tapa aura arjava
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, almsgiving, control of the senses, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्
verses.transliteration:
ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam
dayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ahinsa, satya, krodha ka abhava, tyaga, shanti, apaishunam , bhutamatra ke prati daya, alolupata , mardava , lajja, achanchalata
verses.english_meaning: Harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion for beings, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and absence of fickleness

verses.sanskrit:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।

भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत
verses.transliteration:
tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā
bhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! teja, kshama, dhairya, shaucha , adroha aura atimana ka abhava ye saba daivi sanpada ko prapta purusha ke lakshana hain
verses.english_meaning: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, absence of pride—these belong to one born for a divine state, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha
ajñānaṁ chābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! dambha, darpa, abhimana, krodha, kathora vani aura agyaana yaha saba asuri sampada hai
verses.english_meaning: Hypocrisy, arrogance, and self-conceit, anger, harshness, and ignorance—these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state, O Partha

verses.sanskrit: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव
verses.transliteration:
daivī sampad vimokṣhāya nibandhāyāsurī matā
mā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava
verses.hinglish_meaning: He pandava ! daivi sampada moksha ke lie aura asuri sampada bandhana ke lie mani gayi hai, tuma shoka mata karo, kyonki tuma daivi sampada ko prapta hue ho
verses.english_meaning: The divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation, and the demonic to bondage. Grieve not, O Arjuna, for you are born with divine endowments

verses.sanskrit: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु
verses.transliteration:
dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha
daivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! isa loka men do prakara ki bhutisrishti hai, daivi aura asuri. unamen devon ka svabhava vistarapurvaka kaha gaya hai; aba asuron ke svabhava ko vistarasha: mujhase suno
verses.english_meaning: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been described at length; hear from Me, O Arjuna, about the demoniacal

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ
na śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Asuri svabhava ke loga na pravritti ko; janate hain aura na nivritti ko unamen na shuddhi hoti hai, na sadachara aura na satya hi hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from; they have neither purity, nor right conduct, nor truth

verses.sanskrit: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्
verses.transliteration:
asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram
aparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ve kahate hain ki yaha jagat ashrayarahita, asatya aura ishvara rahita hai, yaha paraspara kamuka sanbandha se hi utpanna hua hai, aura kya ho sakata hai?
verses.english_meaning: They say, "This universe is without truth, without a moral basis, without a God, brought about by mutual union, with lust as its cause; what else?"

verses.sanskrit: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः
verses.transliteration:
etāṁ dṛiṣhṭim avaṣhṭabhya naṣhṭātmāno ’lpa-buddhayaḥ
prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣhayāya jagato ’hitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa drishti ka avalambana karake nashtasvabhava ke alpa buddhi vale, ghora karma karane vale loga jagat ke shatru ke rupa men usaka nasha karane ke lie utpanna hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Holding this view, these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds come forth as enemies of the world, intent on its destruction

verses.sanskrit: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः
verses.transliteration:
kāmam āśhritya duṣhpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ
mohād gṛihītvāsad-grāhān pravartante ’śhuchi-vratāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Dambha, mana aura mada se yukta kabhi na purna hone vali kamanaon ka ashraya liye, mohavasha mithya dharanaon ko grahana karake ye ashuddha sankalpon ke loga jagat men karya karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Filled with insatiable desires, full of hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, holding evil ideas due to delusion, they work with impure intentions

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः
verses.transliteration:
chintām aparimeyāṁ cha pralayāntām upāśhritāḥ
kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niśhchitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Maranaparyanta rahane vali aparimita chintaon se grasta aura vishayopabhoga ko hi parama lakshaya manane vale ye asuri loga isa nishchita mata ke hote hain ki "itana hi hai"
verses.english_meaning: Giving themselves over to immeasurable cares that end only with death, regarding the gratification of lust as their highest aim, and feeling sure that that is all

verses.sanskrit: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्
verses.transliteration:
āśhā-pāśha-śhatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ
īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañchayān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saikadaon ashapashon se bandhe huye, kama aura krodha ke vasha men ye loga vishayabhogon ki purti ke liye anyayapurvaka dhana ka sangraha karane ke liye cheshta karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Bound by a hundred ties of hope, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain hoards of wealth by unlawful means for sensual enjoyment

verses.sanskrit: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्
verses.transliteration:
idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham
idam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mainne aja yaha paya hai aura isa manoratha ko bhi prapta karunga, mere pasa yaha itana dhana hai aura isase bhi adhika dhana bhavishya men hoga
verses.english_meaning: "I have gained this today; I will fulfill this desire of mine; this is mine, and this wealth will be mine in the future."

verses.sanskrit: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी
verses.transliteration:
asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api
īśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī
verses.hinglish_meaning: "yaha shatru mere dvara mara gaya hai aura dusare shatruon ko bhi main marunga", "main ishvara hun aura bhogi hun", "main siddha purusha hun", "main balavana aura sukhi hun",
verses.english_meaning: "I have slain that enemy, and I shall slay others too. I am the Lord; I enjoy, I am perfect, powerful, and happy."

verses.sanskrit: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration:
āḍhyo ’bhijanavān asmi ko ’nyo ’sti sadṛiśho mayā
yakṣhye dāsyāmi modiṣhya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ
aneka-chitta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛitāḥ
prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣhu patanti narake ’śhuchau
verses.hinglish_meaning: "main dhanavan aura shreshthakula men janma hun. mere samana dusara kauna hai?",'main yagyaa karunga', 'main dana dunga', 'main mauja karunga' - isa prakara ke agyaana se ve mohita hote hain
verses.english_meaning: "I am wealthy and born into a noble family. Who is my equal? I shall perform sacrifices, give charity, and rejoice," thus deluded by ignorance

verses.sanskrit: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ
verses.transliteration: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aneka prakara se bhramita chitta vale, moha jala men phanse tatha vishayabhogon men asakta ye loga ghora, apavitra naraka men girate hain
verses.english_meaning: Bewildered by many fancies, entangled in the snare of delusion, addicted to the gratification of lust, they fall into a foul hell

verses.sanskrit: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration:
ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ
yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apane apa ko hi shreshtha manane vale, stabdha , dhana aura mana ke mada se yukta loga shastaravidhi se rahita kevala namamatra ke yagyaon dvara dambhapurvaka yajana karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Self-conceited, stubborn, filled with pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinances

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः
verses.transliteration:
ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ
mām ātma-para-deheṣhu pradviṣhanto ’bhyasūyakāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ahankara, bala, darpa, kama aura krodha ke vashibhuta hue paraninda karane vale ye loga apane aura dusaron ke sharira men sthita mujha se dvesha karane vale hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Given over to egoism, power, haughtiness, lust, and anger, these malicious people hate Me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others

verses.sanskrit: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु
verses.transliteration:
tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān
kṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aise una dvesha karane vale, krurakarmi aura naradhamon ko main sansara men barambara asuri yoniyon men hi girata hun arthat utpanna karata hun
verses.english_meaning: Those cruel haters, the worst among men in the world, I hurl those evil-doers into the wombs of demons only

verses.sanskrit: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! ve mudha purusha janmajanmantara men asuri yoni ko prapta hote hain aura mujhe prapta na hokara adhama gati ko prapta hote hai
verses.english_meaning: Entering into demoniacal wombs and deluded, birth after birth, they do not attain Me, thus falling, O Arjuna, into a condition still lower than that

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration:
tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśhanam ātmanaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kama, krodha aura lobha ye atmanasha ke trividha dvara hain, isalie ina tinon ko tyaga dena chahie
verses.english_meaning: There are three gates to this hell, destructive of the self: lust, anger, and greed; therefore, one should abandon these three

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ
ācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! naraka ke ina tinon dvaron se vimukta purusha apane kalyana ke sadhana ka acharana karata hai aura isa prakara para gati ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: A person who is liberated from these three gates of darkness, O Arjuna, practices what is beneficial for them and thus goes to the Supreme Goal

verses.sanskrit: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya vartate kāma-kārataḥ
na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha shastaravidhi ko tyagakara apani kamana se prerita hokara hi karya karata hai, vaha na purnatva ki siddhi prapta karata hai, na sukha aura na para gati
verses.english_meaning: He who, having cast aside the ordinances of the scriptures, acts under the impulse of desire, does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the Supreme Goal

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tasmāch chhāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau
jñātvā śhāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isalie tumhare lie kartavya aura akartavya ki vyavastha men shastara hi pramana hai shastarokta vidhana ko janakara tumhen apane karma karane chahie
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, let the scripture be thy authority in determining what ought to be done and what ought not to be done. Having known what is said in the ordinance of the scriptures, thou shouldst act in this world

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
ye śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ
teṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he krishna ! jo loga shastaravidhi ko tyagakara shraddha yukta yagyaa karate hain, unaki sthiti kauna si hai ?kya vaha sattavika hai athava rajasika ya tamasika ?
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "What is the condition of those who, disregarding the injunctions of the scriptures, perform sacrifice with faith—is it Sattva, Rajas, or Tamas, O Krishna?"

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
tri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā
sāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shri bhagavan ne kaha -- dehadhariyon ki vaha svabhavika shraddha tina prakara ki - sattavika, rajasika aura tamasika - hoti hain, use tuma mujhase suno
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "There are threefold faiths inherent in the nature of the embodied: the sattvic , the rajasic , and the tamasic . Hear of them."

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः
verses.transliteration:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śhraddhā bhavati bhārata
śhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata sabhi manushyon ki shraddha unake sattava ke anurupa hoti hai. yaha purusha shraddhamaya hai, isalie jo purusha jisa shraddha vala hai vaha svayan bhi vahi hai arthat jaisi jisaki shraddha vaisa hi usaka svarupa hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The faith of each is in accordance with their nature, O Arjuna. People consist of their faith; as a person's faith is, so are they

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः
verses.transliteration:
yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣha-rakṣhānsi rājasāḥ
pretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sattavika purusha devataon ko pujate hain aura rajasa loga yaksha aura rakshason ko, tatha anya tamasi jana preta aura bhutaganon ko pujate hain
verses.english_meaning: The sattvic, or pure, men worship the gods; the rajasic, or passionate, worship the yakshas and rakshasas; the others, the tamasic or deluded people, worship ghosts and hosts of nature-spirits

verses.sanskrit: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः
verses.transliteration:
aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
dambhāhankāra-sanyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo loga shastaravidhi se rahita ghora tapa karate hain tatha dambha, ahankara, kama aura raga se bhi yukta hote hain
verses.english_meaning: Those men who practice terrific austerities not prescribed by the scriptures, given to hypocrisy and egoism, driven by the force of lust and attachment

verses.sanskrit: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्
verses.transliteration:
karṣhayantaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam achetasaḥ
māṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura sharirastha bhutasamudaya ko tatha mujha antaryami ko bhi krisha karane vale arthat kashta pahunchane vale jo aviveki loga hain, unhen tuma asuri nishchaya vale jano
verses.english_meaning: Know thou these to be of demonical resolves, senselessly torturing all the elements in the body and Me who dwell in the body

verses.sanskrit: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु
verses.transliteration:
āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ
yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saba ka priya bhojana bhi tina prakara ka hota hai? usi prakara yagyaa? tapa aura dana bhi tina prakara ke hote hain? unake bheda ko tuma mujhase suno
verses.english_meaning: The food that is dear to each is threefold, as well as sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Hear the distinction of these

verses.sanskrit: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
verses.transliteration:
āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ayu, sattava , bala, arogya, sukha aura priti ko pravriddha karane vale evan rasayukta, snigdha sthira tatha mana ko prasanna karane vale ahara arthat bhojya padartha sattavika purushon ko priya hote hain
verses.english_meaning: The foods that increase life, purity, strength, health, joy, and cheerfulness , which are savory, oily, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to the Sattvic people

verses.sanskrit: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः
verses.transliteration:
kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣhṇa- tīkṣhṇa-rūkṣha-vidāhinaḥ
āhārā rājasasyeṣhṭā duḥkha-śhokāmaya-pradāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kadave, khatte, lavanayukta, ati ushna, tikshana , rukhe. dahakaraka, du:kha, shoka aura roga utpanna karaka bhojya padartha rajasa purusha ko priya hote hain
verses.english_meaning: The foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning are liked by the Rajasic and are productive of pain, grief, and disease

verses.sanskrit: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat
uchchhiṣhṭam api chāmedhyaṁ bhojanaṁ tāmasa-priyam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ardhapakva, rasarahita, durgandhayukta, basi, uchhishta tatha apavitra anna tamasa janon ko priya hota hai
verses.english_meaning: That which is stale, tasteless, putrid, rotten, rejected, and impure is the food liked by the Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः
verses.transliteration:
aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yajño vidhi-driṣhṭo ya ijyate
yaṣhṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo yagyaa shastaravidhi se niyantarita kiya hua tatha jise "yaha mera kartavya hai" aisa mana ka samadhana kara phala ki akanksha nahin rakhane vale logon ke dvara kiya jata hai, vaha yagyaa sattavika hai
verses.english_meaning: That sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for reward, as enjoined by the ordinance , with a firm faith that doing so is their duty, is Sattvic or pure

verses.sanskrit: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
verses.transliteration:
abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat
ijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharatashreshtha arjuna ! jo yagyaa dambha ke lie tatha phala ki akanksha rakha kara kiya jata hai, usa yagyaa ko tuma rajasa samajho
verses.english_meaning: The sacrifice that is offered, O Arjuna, seeking a reward and for show, know that to be a Rajasic Yajna

verses.sanskrit: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्।श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते
verses.transliteration:
vidhi-hīnam asṛiṣhṭānnaṁ mantra-hīnam adakṣhiṇam
śhraddhā-virahitaṁ yajñaṁ tāmasaṁ parichakṣhate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shastaravidhi se rahita, annadana se rahita, bina mantaron, bina dakshina aura bina shraddha ke kiye hue yagyaa ko tamasa yagyaa kahate hain
verses.english_meaning: They declare that sacrifice to be Tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances of the scriptures, in which no food is distributed, and which is devoid of mantras, gifts, and faith

verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
deva-dwija-guru-prājña- pūjanaṁ śhaucham ārjavam
brahmacharyam ahinsā cha śhārīraṁ tapa uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Deva, dvija , guru aura gyaani janon ka pujana, shaucha, arjava , brahmacharya aura ahinsa, yaha sharira sanbandhi tapa kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Worship of the gods, the twice-born, the teachers, and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy, and non-injury are all called the austerities of the body

verses.sanskrit: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat
svādhyāyābhyasanaṁ chaiva vāṅ-mayaṁ tapa uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo vakya udvega utpanna karane vala nahin hai, jo priya, hitakaraka aura satya hai tatha vedon ka svadhyaya abhyasa vangmaya tapa kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Speech that causes no excitement, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial; the practice of studying the Vedas is called austerity of speech

verses.sanskrit: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṁ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ
bhāva-sanśhuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mana ki prasannata, saumyabhava, mauna atmasanyama aura anta:karana ki shuddhi yaha saba manasa tapa kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Serenity of mind, good-heartedness, self-control, and purity of nature—this is called mental austerity

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ित्रविधं नरैः।अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते
verses.transliteration:
śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ
aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṁ parichakṣhate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Phala ki akanksha na rakhane vale yukta purushon ke dvara parama shraddha se kiye gaye usa purvokta trividha tapa ko sattavika kahate hain
verses.english_meaning: This threefold austerity, practiced by steadfast men, with the utmost faith, desiring no reward, is called Sattvic

verses.sanskrit: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration:
satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṁ tapo dambhena chaiva yat
kriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ chalam adhruvam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo tapa satkara, mana aura puja ke lie athava kevala dambha se hi kiya jata hai, vaha anishchita aura kshanika tapa yahan rajasa kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: The austerity that is practiced with the aim of gaining good reception, honor, and worship, and with hypocrisy, is said to be Rajasic, unstable, and transient

verses.sanskrit: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ
parasyotsādanārthaṁ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo tapa mudhatapurvaka svayan ko pidaita karate hue athava anya logon ke nasha ke lie kiya jata hai, vaha tapa tamasa kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: That austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture, or for the purpose of destroying another, is declared to be of the Tamasic nature

verses.sanskrit: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration:
dātavyam iti yad dānaṁ dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe
deśhe kāle cha pātre cha tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: "dana dena hi kartavya hai" - isa bhava se jo dana yogya desha, kala ko dekhakara aise patra ko diya jata hai, jisase pratyupakara ki apeksha nahin hoti hai, vaha dana sattavika mana gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: That gift which is given to one who does nothing in return, knowing it to be a duty to give in a suitable place and time to a worthy person, is held to be Sattvic

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration:
yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ
dīyate cha parikliṣhṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura jo dana kleshapurvaka tatha pratyupakara ke uddeshya se athava phala ki kamana rakhakara diya jata hain, vaha dana rajasa mana gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: And, that gift which is given with the intention of receiving something in return, or expecting a reward, or begrudgingly, is considered to be Rajasic

verses.sanskrit: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate
asat-kṛitam avajñātaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo dana bina satkara kiye, athava tiraskarapurvaka, ayogya deshakala men, kupatron ke lie diya jata hai, vaha dana tamasa mana gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: The gift that is given in the wrong place and at the wrong time, to unworthy persons, without respect or with insult, is declared to be of a Tamasic nature

verses.sanskrit: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा
verses.transliteration:
oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ
brāhmaṇās tena vedāśh cha yajñāśh cha vihitāḥ purā
verses.hinglish_meaning: 'un, tat sat' aisa yaha brahma ka trividha nirdesha kaha gaya hai; usi se adikala men brahamna, veda aura yagyaa nirmita hue hain
verses.english_meaning: "Om Tat Sat": This has been declared to be the triple designation of Brahman. By that, the Brahmanas, the Vedas, and the sacrifices were created formerly

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmād oṁ ity udāhṛitya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isalie, brahmavadiyon ki shastara pratipadita yagyaa, dana aura tapa ki kriyayen sadaiva onkara ke uchcharana ke satha prarambha hoti hain
verses.english_meaning: Therefore, with the utterance of "Om," the acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity, as enjoined in the scriptures, are always begun by the students of Brahman

verses.sanskrit: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि
verses.transliteration:
tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṁ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ
dāna-kriyāśh cha vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣha-kāṅkṣhibhiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: 'tat' shabda ka uchcharana kara, phala ki ichha nahin rakhate hue, mumukshujana yagyaa, tapa, dana adi vividha karma karate hain
verses.english_meaning: Uttering "Tat," without aiming for the fruits, are the acts of sacrifice, austerity, and the various acts of gifts performed by those seeking liberation

verses.sanskrit: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
verses.transliteration:
sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate
praśhaste karmaṇi tathā sach-chhabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! satya bhava va sadhubhava men 'sat' shabda ka prayoga kiya jata hai, aura prashasta karma men 'sat' shabda prayukta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: The word "Sat" is used to refer to reality and goodness; likewise, O Arjuna, the word "Sat" is used to refer to an auspicious act

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते
verses.transliteration:
yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate
karma chaiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yagyaa, tapa aura dana men dridha sthiti bhi sat kahi jati hai, aura usa ke lie kiya gaya karma bhi sat hi kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and gift is also called 'Sat', and action in connection with these, or for the sake of the Supreme, is also called 'Sat'

verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
verses.transliteration:
aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat
asad ity uchyate pārtha na cha tat pretya no iha
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jo yagyaa, dana, tapa aura karma ashraddhapurvaka kiya jata hai, vaha 'asat' kaha jata hai; vaha na isa loka men aura na marana ke pashchat labhadayaka hota hai
verses.english_meaning: Whatever is sacrificed, given, or performed, and whatever austerity is practiced without faith, it is called 'Asat', O Arjuna; it is of no value here or hereafter

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्।

त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam ichchhāmi veditum
tyāgasya cha hṛiṣhīkeśha pṛithak keśhi-niṣhūdana
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he mahabaho ! he hrishikesha ! he keshanishudana ! main sannyasa aura tyaga ke tattava ko prithak-prithak janana chahata hun
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "O mighty-armed Hrishikesa, I desire to know the essence or truth of renunciation and abandonment severally, O slayer of Kesi."

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः।

सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ
sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ prāhus tyāgaṁ vichakṣhaṇāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shribhagavan ne kaha -- kavi jana kamya karmon ke tyaga ko "sannyasa" samajhate hain aura vicharashila jana samasta karmon ke phalon ke tyaga ko "tyaga" kahate hain
verses.english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said, "The sages understand sannyasa to be the renunciation of action with desire; the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all actions to be tyaga."

verses.sanskrit:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।

यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे
verses.transliteration:
tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ
yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti chāpare
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kuchha manishi jana kahate hain ki samasta karma doshayukta hone ke karana tyajya hain; aura anya jana kahate hain ki yagyaa, dana aura taparupa karma tyajya nahin hain
verses.english_meaning: Some philosophers declare that actions should be abandoned as evil; while others declare that acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be relinquished

verses.sanskrit: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration:
niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama
tyāgo hi puruṣha-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharatasattama ! usa tyaga ke vishaya men tuma mere nirnaya ko suno. he purusha shreshtha ! vaha tyaga tina prakara ka kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: Hear from Me the conclusion or the final truth about this abandonment, O best of the Bharatas; abandonment, indeed, O best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat
yajño dānaṁ tapaśh chaiva pāvanāni manīṣhiṇām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yagyaa, dana aura taparupa karma tyajya nahin hai, kintu vaha ni:sandeha kartavya hai; yagyaa, dana aura tapa ye manishiyon ko pavitra karane vale hain
verses.english_meaning: Acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be abandoned, but should be performed; for sacrifice, gift, and austerity are the purifiers of the wise

verses.sanskrit: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्िचतं मतमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha
kartavyānīti me pārtha niśhchitaṁ matam uttamam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! ina karmon ko bhi, phala aura asakti ko tyagakara karana chahie, yaha mera nishchaya kiya hua uttama mata hai
verses.english_meaning: But even these actions should be performed, leaving aside attachment and the desire for rewards, O Arjuna; this is my certain and most assured conviction

verses.sanskrit: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration:
niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate
mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Niyata karma ka tyaga uchita nahin hai; mohavasha usaka tyaga karana "tamasa tyaga" kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: Verily, the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper; the abandonment of the same out of delusion is declared to be Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्।स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration:
duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet
sa kṛitvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo manushya, karma ko du:kha samajhakara sharirika kashta ke bhaya se tyaga deta hai, vaha purusha usa rajasika tyaga ko karake kadapi tyaga ke phala ko prapta nahin hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He who abandons action out of fear of bodily trouble , does not obtain the merit of renunciation by performing such Rajasic renunciation

verses.sanskrit: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन।सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः
verses.transliteration:
kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate ‘rjuna
saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ chaiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna ! "karma karana kartavya hai" aisa samajhakara jo niyata karma asakti aura phala ko tyagakara kiya jata hai, vahi sattavika tyaga mana gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: Whatever obligatory action is done, O Arjuna, merely because it ought to be done, abandoning attachment and also the desire for reward, that renunciation is regarded as sattvic

verses.sanskrit: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते।त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः
verses.transliteration:
na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate
tyāgī sattva-samāviṣhṭo medhāvī chhinna-sanśhayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha akushala karma se dvesha nahin karata aura kushala karma men asakta nahin hota, vaha sattavaguna se sampanna purusha sanshayarahita, medhavi aura tyagi hai
verses.english_meaning: The man of renunciation, pervaded by purity, intelligent, and with his doubts cut asunder, does not hate an unpleasant task nor is he attached to a pleasant one

verses.sanskrit: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration:
na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ
yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Kyonki dehadhari purusha ke dvara ashesha karmon ka tyaga sanbhava nahin hai, isalie jo karmaphala tyagi hai, vahi purusha tyagi kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Indeed, it is not possible for an embodied being to completely abandon actions; however, he who relinquishes the rewards of actions is truly called a man of renunciation

verses.sanskrit: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्।भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्
verses.transliteration:
aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam
bhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvachit
verses.hinglish_meaning: Karmon ke shubha, ashubha aura mishra ye trividha phala kevala atyagi janon ko marana ke pashchat bhi prapta hote hain; parantu sannyasi purushon ko kadapi nahin
verses.english_meaning: The threefold fruit of action accrues after death to those who do not abandon it, but never to those who do

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे।सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration:
pañchaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me
sānkhye kṛitānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām
verses.hinglish_meaning: He mahabaho ! samasta karmon ki siddhi ke lie ye pancha karana sankhya siddhanta men kahe gaye hain, jinako tuma mujhase bhalibhanti jano
verses.english_meaning: Learn from Me, O mighty-armed Arjuna, these five causes, as declared in the Sankhya system, for the accomplishment of all actions

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्
verses.transliteration:
adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham
vividhāśh cha pṛithak cheṣhṭā daivaṁ chaivātra pañchamam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Adhishthana , karta ,vividha karana ,vividha aura prithak-prithak cheshtaen tatha panchava hetu daiva hai
verses.english_meaning: The body, the doer, the various senses, the different functions of various kinds, and the presiding deity—the fifth

verses.sanskrit: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः।न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः
verses.transliteration:
śharīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ
nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañchaite tasya hetavaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Manushya apane sharira, vani aura mana se jo koi nyayya ya viparita karma karata hai, usake ye pancha karana hi hain
verses.english_meaning: Whatever action a person performs with their body, speech, and mind, whether right or wrong, these five are its causes

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः।पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration:
tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ
paśhyaty akṛita-buddhitvān na sa paśhyati durmatiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aba isa sthiti men jo purusha asanskrita buddhi hone ke karana, kevala shuddha atma ko karta samajhata hain, vaha durmati purusha nahin dekhata hai
verses.english_meaning: Now, such being the case, verily he who, owing to an untrained understanding, looks upon his Self, which is isolated, as the agent, he of perverted intelligence does not see

verses.sanskrit: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते
verses.transliteration:
yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate
hatvā ‘pi sa imāl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa purusha men ahankara ka bhava nahin hai aura buddhi kisi se lipta nahin hoti, vaha purusha ina saba lokon ko marakara bhi vastava men na marata hai aura na bandhata hai
verses.english_meaning: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose intelligence is not tainted by good or evil, though he slays these people, he does not slay, nor is he bound by the action

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना।करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration:
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-chodanā
karaṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Gyaana, gyaeya aura parigyaata ye trividha karma preraka hain, aura, karana, karma. karta ye trividha karma sangraha hain
verses.english_meaning: Knowledge, the knowable, and the knower form the threefold impulse for action; the organ, the action, and the agent form the threefold basis of action

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि
verses.transliteration:
jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ
prochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api
verses.hinglish_meaning: Gyaana, karma aura karta bhi gunon ke bheda se sankhyashastara men trividha hi kahe gaye hain; unako bhi tuma mujha se yathavat shravana karo
verses.english_meaning: Knowledge, action, and actor are declared in the science of the Gunas to be of three kinds only, according to the distinction of the Gunas. Of these, hear duly

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्
verses.transliteration:
sarva-bhūteṣhu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣhate
avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa gyaana se manushya, vibhakta rupa men sthita samasta bhuton men eka avibhakta aura avinashi svarupa ko dekhata hai, usa gyaana ko tuma sattavika jano
verses.english_meaning: That by which one sees the indestructible Reality in all beings, not separate in any of them—know that knowledge to be Sattvic

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्
verses.transliteration:
pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān
vetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa gyaana ke dvara manushya samasta bhuton men nana bhavon ko prithak-prithak janata hai, usa gyaana ko tuma rajasa jano
verses.english_meaning: But that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as being distinct from one another, know thou that knowledge to be Rajasic

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्।अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam
atattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura jisa gyaana ke dvara manushya eka karya men hi asakta ho jata hai, mano vaha purna vastu ho tatha jo heturahita , tattavartha se rahita tatha sankuchita hai, vaha tamasa hai
verses.english_meaning: But that which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, without any foundation in Truth, and is trivial—that is declared to be Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्।अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣhataḥ kṛitam
aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo karma niyata aura sangarahita hai, tatha phala ko na chahane vale purusha ke dvara bina kisi raga dvesha ke kiya gaya hai, vaha sattavika kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: An action that is ordained, free from attachment, done without love or hatred, and without desire for reward is declared to be Sattvic

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ
kriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura jo karma bahuta parishrama se yukta hai tatha phala ki kamana vale, ahankarayukta purusha ke dvara kiya jata hai, vaha karma rajasa kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: But that action which is done by one longing for the fulfillment of desires or gain with egotism or with much effort is declared to be Rajasic

verses.sanskrit: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते
verses.transliteration:
anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham
mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo karma parinama, hani, hinsa aura sarmathya ka vichara na karake kevala mohavasha arambha kiya jata hai, vaha karma tamasa kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: That action which is undertaken from delusion, without regard for the consequences, loss, injury, and one's own ability, is declared to be Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
mukta-saṅgo ‘nahaṁ-vādī dhṛity-utsāha-samanvitaḥ
siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo karta sangarahita, ahanmanyata se rahita, dhairya aura utsaha se yukta evan karya ki siddhi aura asiddhi men nirvikara rahata hai, vaha karta sattavika kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: An agent who is free from attachment, non-egoistic, endowed with firmness and enthusiasm, and unaffected by success or failure, is considered to be of a Sattvic nature

verses.sanskrit: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration:
rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hinsātmako ‘śhuchiḥ
harṣha-śhokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ragi, karmaphala ka ichhuka, lobhi, hinsaka svabhava vala, ashuddha aura harshashoka se yukta karta rajasa kahalata hai
verses.english_meaning: Passionate, desiring to obtain the reward of their actions, greedy, cruel, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an agent is said to be Rajasic

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः।विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते
verses.transliteration:
ayuktaḥ prākṛitaḥ stabdhaḥ śhaṭho naiṣhkṛitiko ‘lasaḥ
viṣhādī dīrgha-sūtrī cha kartā tāmasa uchyate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ayukta, prakrita, stabdha, shatha, naishkritika, alasi, vishadi aura dirghasutri karta tamasa kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Unsteady, vulgar, inflexible, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating—such an agent is called Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु।प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय
verses.transliteration:
buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu
prochyamānam aśheṣheṇa pṛithaktvena dhanañjaya
verses.hinglish_meaning: He dhananjaya ! mere dvara asheshata: aura prithakata: kahe jane vale, gunon ke karana utpanna hue buddhi aura dhriti ke trividha bheda ko suno
verses.english_meaning: Hear thou the threefold division of intellect and firmness, according to the Gunas, as I declare them fully and distinctly, O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये।बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
verses.transliteration:
pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye
bandhaṁ mokṣhaṁ cha yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jo buddhi pravritti aura nivritti, karya aura akarya, bhaya aura abhaya tatha bandha aura moksha ko tattavata janati hai, vaha buddhi satviki hai
verses.english_meaning: The intellect which knows the path of work and renunciation, what should be done and what should not be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation—that intellect is Sattvic , O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च।अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी
verses.transliteration:
yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha
ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! jisa buddhi ke dvara manushya dharma aura adharma ko tatha kartavya aura akartavya ko yathavat nahin janata hai, vaha buddhi rajasi hai
verses.english_meaning: That by which one wrongly understands dharma and adharma, and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done—that intellect, O Arjuna, is rajasic

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता।सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी
verses.transliteration:
adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā
sarvārthān viparītānśh cha buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! tamas se avrita jo buddhi adharma ko hi dharma manati hai aura sabhi padarthon ko viparita rupa se janati hai, vaha buddhi tamasi hai
verses.english_meaning: That intellect, O Arjuna, which is enveloped in darkness and sees Adharma as Dharma and all things perverted, is Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
verses.transliteration:
dhṛityā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ
yogenāvyabhichāriṇyā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sattaviki hai
verses.english_meaning: The unwavering firmness, through which Yoga restrains the functions of the mind, life-force, and senses—that firmness, O Arjuna, is Sattvic

verses.sanskrit: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन।प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी
verses.transliteration:
yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛityā dhārayate ‘rjuna
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣhī dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.hinglish_meaning: He prithaputra arjuna ! karmaphala ka ichhuka purusha ati asakti se jisa dhriti ke dvara dharma, artha aura kama ko dharana karata hai, vaha dhriti rajasi hai
verses.english_meaning: But that, O Arjuna, by which one holds fast to Dharma , enjoyment of pleasures, and earning of wealth, on account of attachment and desire for reward—that firmness, O Arjuna, is Rajasic

verses.sanskrit: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च।न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी
verses.transliteration:
yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śhokaṁ viṣhādaṁ madam eva cha
na vimuñchati durmedhā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ho partha ! durbuddhi purusha jisa dharana ke dvara, svapna, bhaya, shoka, vishada aura mada ko nahin tyagata hai, vaha dhriti tamasi hai
verses.english_meaning: That firmness, O Arjuna, by which a stupid man does not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and conceit, is Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ।अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu me bharatarṣhabha
abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ cha nigachchhati
yat tad agre viṣham iva pariṇāme ‘mṛitopamam
tat sukhaṁ sāttvikaṁ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharatashreshtha ! aba tuma trividha sukha ko mujhase suno, jisamen abhyasa se ramata hai aura du:khon ke anta ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: And now, O Arjuna, hear from Me of the threefold pleasure, in which one rejoices through practice and surely comes to the end of pain

verses.sanskrit: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्।तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्
verses.transliteration: yat  tad agre    viṣam   iva pariṇāme    'mṛtopamam  tat sukhaṁ  sāttvikaṁ   proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sukha prathama visha ke samana hai, parantu parinama men amrita ke samana hai, vaha atmabuddhi ke prasada se utpanna sukha sattavika kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: That which is like poison at first but in the end like nectar—that happiness is declared to be sattvic, born of the purity of one's own mind due to self-realization

verses.sanskrit: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्।परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration:
viṣhayendriya-sanyogād yat tad agre ’mṛitopamam
pariṇāme viṣham iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sukha vishayon aura indariyon ke sanyoga se utpanna hota hai, vaha prathama to amrita ke samana, parantu parinama men visha tulya hota hai, vaha sukha rajasa kaha gaya hai
verses.english_meaning: That happiness which arises from the contact of the senses with the objects, which is initially like nectar but eventually like poison, is said to be Rajasic

verses.sanskrit: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ
nidrālasya-pramādotthaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo sukha prarambha men aura parinama men bhi atma ko mohita karane vala hota hai, vaha nidra, alasya aura pramada se utpanna sukha tamasa kaha jata hai
verses.english_meaning: That happiness which at first, as well as in the end, deludes the self, and which arises from sleep, indolence, and heedlessness—that is declared to be Tamasic

verses.sanskrit: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ित्रभिर्गुणैः
verses.transliteration:
na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ
sattvaṁ prakṛiti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Prithvi para athava svarga ke devataon men aisa koi prani nahin hai jo prakriti se utpanna ina tina gunon se mukta ho
verses.english_meaning: There is no being on earth or in heaven among the gods that is liberated from the three qualities born of Nature

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇa-kṣhatriya-viśhāṁ śhūdrāṇāṁ cha parantapa
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He parantapa! brahmanon, kshatriyon, vaishyon aura shudron ke karma, svabhava se utpanna gunon ke anusara vibhakta kiye gaye hain
verses.english_meaning: Of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras, O Arjuna, the duties are distributed according to the qualities born of their own nature

verses.sanskrit: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्
verses.transliteration:
śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha
jñānaṁ vijñānam āstikyaṁ brahma-karma svabhāva-jam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shama, dama, tapa, shaucha, kshanti, arjava, gyaana, vigyaana aura astikya - ye brahmana ke svabhavika karma hain
verses.english_meaning: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, and uprightness, as well as knowledge, realization, and belief in God, are the duties of Brahmanas, born of their own nature

verses.sanskrit: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्
verses.transliteration:
śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam
dānam īśhvara-bhāvaśh cha kṣhātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Shaurya, teja, dhriti, dakshaya , yuddha se palayana na karana, dana aura ishvara bhava - ye saba kshatriya ke svabhavika karma hain
verses.english_meaning: Prowess, splendor, firmness, dexterity, and not fleeing from battle, generosity, and lordliness are the duties of the Kshatriyas, born of their own nature

verses.sanskrit: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛiṣhi-gau-rakṣhya-vāṇijyaṁ vaiśhya-karma svabhāva-jam
paricharyātmakaṁ karma śhūdrasyāpi svabhāva-jam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Krishi, gaupalana tatha vanijya - ye vaishya ke svabhavika karma hain, aura shudra ka svabhavika karma hai paricharya arthat seva karana
verses.english_meaning: Agriculture, cattle-rearing, and trade are the duties of the Vaisya , born of their own nature; and service is the duty of the Sudra , born of their own nature

verses.sanskrit: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु
verses.transliteration:
sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ
sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tach chhṛiṇu
verses.hinglish_meaning: Apane-apane svabhavika karma men abhirata manushya sansiddhi ko prapta kara leta hai. svakarma men rata manushya kisa prakara siddhi prapta karata hai, use tuma suno
verses.english_meaning: Each person devoted to their own duty attains perfection. How they attain perfection while being engaged in their own duty, hear now

verses.sanskrit: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः
verses.transliteration:
yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jisa se bhutamatra ki pravritti arthat utpatti hui hai aura jisase yaha sampurna jagat vyapta hai, usa ki svakarma dvara puja karake manushya siddhi ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He from whom all the beings have evolved and by whom all this is pervaded, worshipping Him with his own duty, one attains perfection

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration:
śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt
svabhāva-niyataṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
verses.hinglish_meaning: Samyak anushthita paradharma ki apeksha gunarahita svadharma shreshtha hai. svabhava se niyata kiye gaye karma ko karate hue manushya papa ko nahin prapta karata
verses.english_meaning: Better is one's own duty, even if it is destitute of merits, than the duty of another well performed. He who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no sin

verses.sanskrit: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः
verses.transliteration:
saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet
sarvārambhā hi doṣheṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛitāḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! doshayukta hone para bhi sahaja karma ko nahin tyagana chahie; kyonki sabhi karma dosha se avrita hote hai, jaise dhuyen se agni
verses.english_meaning: One should not, O Arjuna, abandon the duty to which one is born, though it may be faulty; for, all undertakings are enveloped by evil, just as fire is by smoke

verses.sanskrit: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛihaḥ
naiṣhkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ sannyāsenādhigachchhati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sarvatra asakti rahita buddhi vala vaha purusha jo spriharahita tatha jitatma hai, sannyasa ke dvara parama nairshakamya siddhi ko prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his self, from whom desire has fled, he attains the supreme state of freedom from action through renunciation

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा
verses.transliteration:
siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣhṭhā jñānasya yā parā
verses.hinglish_meaning: Siddhi ko prapta purusha kisa prakara brahma ko prapta hota hai, tatha gyaana ki para nishtha ko bhi tuma mujhase sankshepa men jano
verses.english_meaning: Learn from Me, O Arjuna, in brief how one who has attained perfection reaches Brahman—the Eternal, that supreme state of knowledge

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च
verses.transliteration:
buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha
śhabdādīn viṣhayāns tyaktvā rāga-dveṣhau vyudasya cha
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vishuddha buddhi se yukta, dhriti se atmasanyama kara, shabdadi vishayon ko tyaga kara aura raga-dvesha ka parityaga kara.
verses.english_meaning: Endowed with a pure intellect, controlling the self through firmness, relinquishing sound and other objects and abandoning attraction and hatred

verses.sanskrit: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration:
vivikta-sevī laghv-āśhī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ
dhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṁ vairāgyaṁ samupāśhritaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vivikta sevi, laghvashi jisane apane sharira, vani aura mana ko sanyata kiya hai, dhyanayoga ke abhyasa men sadaiva tatpara tatha vairagya para samashrita
verses.english_meaning: Dwelling in solitude, eating sparingly, with speech, body, and mind subdued, always engaged in meditation and concentration, and resorting to dispassion

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration:
ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham
vimuchya nirmamaḥ śhānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
verses.hinglish_meaning: Ahankara, bala, darpa, kama, krodha aura parigraha ko tyaga kara mamatvabhava se rahita aura shanta purusha brahma prapti ke yogya bana jata hai
verses.english_meaning: Having abandoned egoism, strength, arrogance, desire, anger, and covetousness, and being free from the notion of 'mine' and peaceful, he is fit for becoming Brahman

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्
verses.transliteration:
brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati
samaḥ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Brahmabhuta , prasanna mana vala purusha na ichha karata hai aura na shoka, samasta bhuton ke prati sama hokara vaha meri para bhakti ko prapta karata hai
verses.english_meaning: Becoming Brahman, serene in the Self, he neither grieves nor desires; he is the same to all beings, and obtains supreme devotion to Me

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ
tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśhate tad-anantaram
verses.hinglish_meaning: Bhakti ke dvara mujhe vaha tattavata: janata hai ki main kitana hun tatha main kya hun. tattavata: janane ke pashchat tatkala hi vaha mujhamen pravesha kara jata hai, arthat matsvarupa bana jata hai
verses.english_meaning: By devotion, he knows Me in truth, who and what I am; then, having known Me in truth, he immediately enters into the Supreme

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśhrayaḥ
mat-prasādād avāpnoti śhāśhvataṁ padam avyayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha madashrita hokara sadaiva samasta karmon ko karata hai, vaha mere prasada se shashvata, avyaya pada ko prapta kara leta hai
verses.english_meaning: Having taken refuge in Me and doing all actions, by My grace he obtains the eternal, indestructible state of being

verses.sanskrit: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव
verses.transliteration:
chetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ
buddhi-yogam upāśhritya mach-chittaḥ satataṁ bhava
verses.hinglish_meaning: Mana se samasta karmon ka sannyasa mujhamen karake matparayana hokara buddhiyoga ka ashraya lekara tuma satata machchitta bano
verses.english_meaning: Mentally renouncing all actions in Me, having Me as the highest goal, and resorting to the yoga of discrimination, do thou ever fix thy mind on Me

verses.sanskrit: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
mach-chittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣhyasi
atha chet tvam ahankārān na śhroṣhyasi vinaṅkṣhyasi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Machchitta hokara tuma meri kripa se samasta kathinaiyon ko para kara jaoge; aura yadi ahankaravasha nahin sunoge, to tuma nashta ho jaoge
verses.english_meaning: Fixing your mind on Me, you shall, by My grace, overcome all obstacles; but if you will not hear Me due to egoism, you shall perish

verses.sanskrit: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration:
yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase
mithyaiṣha vyavasāyas te prakṛitis tvāṁ niyokṣhyati
verses.hinglish_meaning: Aura ahankaravasha tuma jo yaha socha rahe ho, "main yuddha nahin karunga", yaha tumhara nishchaya mithya hai, prakriti hi tumhen pravritta karegi
verses.english_meaning: If, filled with egoism, thou thinkest, "I will not fight," then thy resolve is vain; nature will compel thee

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्
verses.transliteration:
swbhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā
kartuṁ nechchhasi yan mohāt kariṣhyasy avaśho ’pi tat
verses.hinglish_meaning: He kaunteya ! tuma apane svabhavika karmon se bandhe ho, mohavashat jisa karma ko tuma karana nahin chahate ho, vahi tuma vivasha hokara karoge
verses.english_meaning: O Arjuna, bound by your own Karma born of your own nature, that which from delusion you wish not to do, even that you shall do helplessly

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया
verses.transliteration:
īśhvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ hṛid-deśhe ‘rjuna tiṣhṭhati
bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
verses.hinglish_meaning: He arjuna yantara para arudha samasta bhuton ko ishvara apani maya se ghumata hua bhutamatra ke hridaya men sthita rahata hai
verses.english_meaning: The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, causing all beings, by His illusory power, to revolve as if mounted on a machine

verses.sanskrit: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration:
tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata
tat-prasādāt parāṁ śhāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śhāśhvatam
verses.hinglish_meaning: He bharata ! tuma sampurna bhava se usi ki sharana men jao. usake prasada se tuma parama shanti aura shashvata sthana ko prapta karoge
verses.english_meaning: Fly to Him for refuge with all your being, O Arjuna; by His grace you will obtain supreme peace and the eternal abode

verses.sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration:
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā
vimṛiśhyaitad aśheṣheṇa yathechchhasi tathā kuru
verses.hinglish_meaning: Isa prakara samasta gopaniyon se adhika guhya gyaana mainne tumase kaha; isa para purna vichara karane ke pashchat tumhari jaisi ichha ho, vaisa tuma karo
verses.english_meaning: Thus, wisdom more secret than secrecy itself has been declared to you by me. Reflect on it fully, then act as you wish

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
verses.transliteration:
sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
iṣhṭo ‘si me dṛiḍham iti tato vakṣhyāmi te hitam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Puna: eka bara tuma mujhase samasta guhyon men guhyatama parama vachana ko suno. tuma mujhe atishaya priya ho, isalie main tumhen tumhare hita ki bata kahunga
verses.english_meaning: Hear again My supreme word, most secret of all; for you are dearly beloved of Me, I will tell you what is good

verses.sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे
verses.transliteration:
