man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
mām evaiṣhyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo ‘si me
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tuma machchita, madbhakta aura mere pujaka bano aura mujhe namaskara karo; tuma mujhe hi prapta hoge; yaha main tumhe satya vachana deta hun, tuma mere priya ho
verses.english_meaning: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. You will come to Me; I truly promise you this, for you are dear to Me

verses.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः
verses.transliteration:
sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Saba dharmon ka parityaga karake tuma eka meri hi sharana men ao, main tumhen samasta papon se mukta kara dunga, tuma shoka mata karo
verses.english_meaning: Abandon all duties and take refuge in Me alone; I will liberate you from all sins; do not grieve

verses.sanskrit: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ te nātapaskyāya nābhaktāya kadāchana
na chāśhuśhruṣhave vāchyaṁ na cha māṁ yo ‘bhyasūtayi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Yaha gyaana aise purusha se nahin kahana chahie, jo atapaska hai, aura na use jo abhakta hai; use bhi nahin jo ashushrushu hai aura usa purusha se bhi nahin kahana chahie, jo mujha se asuya karata hai, arthat mujha men dosha dekhata hai
verses.english_meaning: Never speak this to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion, who does not render service, who does not desire to listen, or who cavils at Me

verses.sanskrit: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः
verses.transliteration:
ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati
bhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛitvā mām evaiṣhyaty asanśhayaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha mujhase parama prema karake isa parama guhya gyaana ka upadesha mere bhakton ko deta hai, vaha ni:sandeha mujhe hi prapta hota hai
verses.english_meaning: He who, with supreme devotion to Me, teaches this supreme secret to My devotees, shall undoubtedly come to Me

verses.sanskrit: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि
verses.transliteration:
na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ
bhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
verses.hinglish_meaning: Na to usase badhakara mera atishaya priya karya karane vala manushyon men koi hai aura na usase badhakara mera priya isa prithvi para dusara koi hoga
verses.english_meaning: There is no one among men who does service dearer to Me, nor shall there be anyone on earth dearer to Me than him

verses.sanskrit: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration:
adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ
jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jo purusha, hama donon ke isa dharmamaya sanvada ka pathana karega, usake dvara main gyaanayagyaa se pujita hounga - aisa mera mata hai
verses.english_meaning: And he who studies this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped through the sacrifice of wisdom; such is my conviction

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration:
śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ
so ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām
verses.hinglish_meaning: Tatha jo shraddhavan aura anasuyu purusha isaka shravanamatra bhi karega, vaha bhi mukta hokara punyakarmiyon ke shubha lokon ko prapta kara lega
verses.english_meaning: Also, the man who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds, and be liberated

verses.sanskrit: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय
verses.transliteration:
kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā
kachchid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣhṭas te dhanañjaya
verses.hinglish_meaning: He partha ! kya ise tumane ekagrachitta hokara shravana kiya ? aura he dhananjaya ! kya tumhara agyaana janita sanmoha purnataya nashta hua ?
verses.english_meaning: Has this been heard, O Arjuna, with one-pointed focus? Has the delusion of your ignorance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta
sthito ‘smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava
verses.hinglish_meaning: Arjuna ne kaha -- he achyuta ! apake kripaprasada se mera moha nashta ho gaya hai, aura mujhe smriti prapta ho gayi hai? aba main sanshayarahita ho gaya hun aura main apake vachana ka palana karunga
verses.english_meaning: Arjuna said, "My delusion has been destroyed, for I have gained my knowledge through Your grace, O Krishna. I am now free from doubts. I will act according to Your word."

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ
saṁvādam imam aśhrauṣham adbhutaṁ roma-harṣhaṇam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Sanjaya ne kaha -- isa prakara mainne bhagavan vasudeva aura mahatma arjuna ke isa adbhuta aura romanchaka sanvada ka varnana kiya
verses.english_meaning: Sanjaya said, Thus, I have heard this wonderful dialogue between Krishna and the high-souled Arjuna, which causes one's hair to stand on end

verses.sanskrit: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्।योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration:
vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param
yogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam
verses.hinglish_meaning: Vyasa ji ki kripa se mainne isa param guhya yoga ko sakshat kahate hue svayan yogoshvara shrikrishna bhagavan se suna
verses.english_meaning: Through the grace of Vyasa, I have heard this supreme and most secret Yoga, directly from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, Himself declaring it

verses.sanskrit: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration:
rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam
keśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He rajan ! bhagavan keshava aura arjuna ke isa adbhuta aura punya sanvada ko smarana karake main barambara harshita hota hun
verses.english_meaning: O King, remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I continually rejoice

verses.sanskrit:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः।

विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ
vismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ
verses.hinglish_meaning: He rajana ! shri hari ke ati adbhuta rupa ko bhi puna: puna: smarana karake mujhe mahan vismaya hota hai aura main barambara harshita ho raha hun
verses.english_meaning: And, remembering again and again that most wonderful form of Hari, I am filled with great wonder, O King; and I rejoice again and again

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।

तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।18.78।
verses.transliteration:
yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ
tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama
verses.hinglish_meaning: Jahan yogeshvara shrikrishna hain aura jahan dhanurdhari arjuna hai vahin para shri, vijaya, vibhuti aura dhruva niti hai, aisa mera mata hai
verses.english_meaning: Wherever Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, is; and wherever Arjuna, the wielder of the bow, is; there is prosperity, victory, happiness, and a firm policy; this is my conviction
